	PROCEDURE Init
		**** David **********
		lParameters cId_Articulo,vVnt_DocuSel,dFechaVtoMaximo
		**** David **********
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtADescargar","Tg_ViewArtADescargar")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtADescargarDetallado","Tg_ViewArtADescargarDetallado")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Alias
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Value=""
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Enabled=.F.
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		******** david ********
		Thisform.oTxbFecVtoDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTxbFecVtoHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value = SPACE(5)
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.Value = SPACE(5)
		
		
		ThisForm.OldClienteDesde=Thisform.Tg_clientes1.Value
		ThisForm.OldClienteHasta=Thisform.Tg_clientes2.Value
		ThisForm.OldSucCliente=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Value
		thisform.OldFecVtoDesde=Thisform.oTxbFecVtoDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFecVtoHasta=Thisform.oTxbFecVtoHasta.Value
		******** david ********
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		thisform.OldFormato=ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(4)
		
		******* david ********
		if type("cId_Articulo")<> "L"
		   thisform.Ocultar= .t.
		   thisform.RefrescarConsulta(cId_Articulo,@vVnt_DocuSel,dFechaVtoMaximo)
		else
		  thisform.Ocultar= .f.
		endif
		******* david ********
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
		
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
		
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		***** david ****
		Local lRetorna
		
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
		    if thisform.Ocultar
		       thisform.Hide
		    else
		       thisform.Release
		    endif      
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
		****** david *****
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters cId_Articulo,vVnt_DocuSel,dFechaVtoMaximo
		local mmpp, i, vDeposito1
		
		Dimension vDepositos1 [1]
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		
		if type("cId_Articulo")<> "L"
		   thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.value= 2
		   Thisform.oTxbFecVtoHasta.Value= dFechaVtoMaximo
		   thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde= cId_Articulo
		   thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta= cId_Articulo
		   thisform.Id_Marca=    "TD"
		   thisform.Id_Rubro=    "TD"
		   thisform.Id_SubRubro= "TD"
		   =aCopy(vVnt_DocuSel,vComprobantes)
		   =aCopy(vVnt_DocuSel,thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems )
		
		
		   For i=1 to alen(thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.vItems, 1)
		  		thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems[i,2] = .f.
		   Endfor
		   For mmpp=1 to thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.tg_ListBox1.ListCount
			    thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.tg_listbox1.Picture(mmpp)=thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.PictureDesMarcado	
		   endfor
		   For mmpp=1 to thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.tg_ListBox1.ListCount
			   For i=1 to alen(thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.vItems, 1)
				   if thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.Tg_ListBox1.ListItem(mmpp,2) = thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems[i,1]
				  		thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.tg_listbox1.Picture(mmpp)=thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.PictureMarcado
				  		thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems[i,2] = .t.
				   endif		                       
			   Endfor
		   Endfor
		else
		   =aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		endif
		
		i = 0
		if type("thisform.oDepositosFormulas")="O"
			**trabajo con los depósitos seleccionados por el botón de depósitos, solamente tomaré el STOCK de los artículos de estos depósitos
			thisform.oDepositosFormulas.oViewDepositos.IrPrimero()
			do while !thisform.oDepositosFormulas.oViewDepositos.EsEof()
				if thisform.oDepositosFormulas.oViewDepositos.Leer("lSeleccionado") = 1
				i = i + 1
				Dimension thisform.vDepositos [i,2]
					thisform.vDepositos[i,1] = 1
					thisform.vDepositos[i,2] = thisform.oDepositosFormulas.oViewDepositos.Leer("Id_Deposito")
				endif	
				thisform.oDepositosFormulas.oViewDepositos.IrSiguiente()
			enddo
			if thisform.vDepositos[1,1] = 1  &&me indica que tengo algún depósito seleccionado
			    =aCopy(thisform.vDepositos, vDepositos1)  && paso los depositos seleccionados a la VISTA RESPECTIVA
			endif
		endif	
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1
		
			thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro,ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),thisform.oTxbFecVtoDesde.Value,thisform.oTxbFecVtoHasta.Value,@vDepositos1,ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.Value,ThisForm.Tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Value)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Alias
		Else

			thisform.Id_articuloHasta<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;

	PROCEDURE Init
		**** David **********
		lParameters cId_Articulo,vVnt_DocuSel,dFechaVtoMaximo
		**** David **********
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtADescargar","Tg_ViewArtADescargar")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtADescargarDetallado","Tg_ViewArtADescargarDetallado")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Alias
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Value=""
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Enabled=.F.
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		******** david ********
		Thisform.oTxbFecVtoDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTxbFecVtoHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value = SPACE(5)
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.Value = SPACE(5)
		
		
		ThisForm.OldClienteDesde=Thisform.Tg_clientes1.Value
		ThisForm.OldClienteHasta=Thisform.Tg_clientes2.Value
		ThisForm.OldSucCliente=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Value
		thisform.OldFecVtoDesde=Thisform.oTxbFecVtoDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFecVtoHasta=Thisform.oTxbFecVtoHasta.Value
		******** david ********
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		thisform.OldFormato=ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(4)
		
		******* david ********
		if type("cId_Articulo")<> "L"
		   thisform.Ocultar= .t.
		   thisform.RefrescarConsulta(cId_Articulo,@vVnt_DocuSel,dFechaVtoMaximo)
		else
		  thisform.Ocultar= .f.
		endif
		******* david ********
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
		
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
		
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		***** david ****
		Local lRetorna
		
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
		    if thisform.Ocultar
		       thisform.Hide
		    else
		       thisform.Release
		    endif      
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
		****** david *****
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters cId_Articulo,vVnt_DocuSel,dFechaVtoMaximo
		local mmpp, i, vDeposito1
		
		Dimension vDepositos1 [1]
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		
		if type("cId_Articulo")<> "L"
		   thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.value= 2
		   Thisform.oTxbFecVtoHasta.Value= dFechaVtoMaximo
		   thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde= cId_Articulo
		   thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta= cId_Articulo
		   thisform.Id_Marca=    "TD"
		   thisform.Id_Rubro=    "TD"
		   thisform.Id_SubRubro= "TD"
		   =aCopy(vVnt_DocuSel,vComprobantes)
		   =aCopy(vVnt_DocuSel,thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems )
		
		
		   For i=1 to alen(thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.vItems, 1)
		  		thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems[i,2] = .f.
		   Endfor
		   For mmpp=1 to thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.tg_ListBox1.ListCount
			    thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.tg_listbox1.Picture(mmpp)=thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.PictureDesMarcado	
		   endfor
		   For mmpp=1 to thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.tg_ListBox1.ListCount
			   For i=1 to alen(thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.vItems, 1)
				   if thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.Tg_ListBox1.ListItem(mmpp,2) = thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems[i,1]
				  		thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.tg_listbox1.Picture(mmpp)=thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.PictureMarcado
				  		thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems[i,2] = .t.
				   endif		                       
			   Endfor
		   Endfor
		else
		   =aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		endif
		
		i = 0
		if type("thisform.oDepositosFormulas")="O"
			**trabajo con los depósitos seleccionados por el botón de depósitos, solamente tomaré el STOCK de los artículos de estos depósitos
			thisform.oDepositosFormulas.oViewDepositos.IrPrimero()
			do while !thisform.oDepositosFormulas.oViewDepositos.EsEof()
				if thisform.oDepositosFormulas.oViewDepositos.Leer("lSeleccionado") = 1
				i = i + 1
				Dimension thisform.vDepositos [i,2]
					thisform.vDepositos[i,1] = 1
					thisform.vDepositos[i,2] = thisform.oDepositosFormulas.oViewDepositos.Leer("Id_Deposito")
				endif	
				thisform.oDepositosFormulas.oViewDepositos.IrSiguiente()
			enddo
			if thisform.vDepositos[1,1] = 1  &&me indica que tengo algún depósito seleccionado
			    =aCopy(thisform.vDepositos, vDepositos1)  && paso los depositos seleccionados a la VISTA RESPECTIVA
			endif
		endif	
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1
		
			thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro,ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),thisform.oTxbFecVtoDesde.Value,thisform.oTxbFecVtoHasta.Value,@vDepositos1,ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.Value,ThisForm.Tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Value)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Alias
		Else
		
			thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro,ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),thisform.oTxbFecVtoDesde.Value,thisform.oTxbFecVtoHasta.Value,@vDepositos1,ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.Value,ThisForm.Tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Value)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias
		Endif	
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.Tg_commandbutton1.Enabled=thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionardepositos

	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_cliente
		
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtADescargarCliente","Tg_ViewArtADescargarCliente")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtADescargarClienteDetallado","Tg_ViewArtADescargarClienteDetallado")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarCliente.Alias
		thisform.tg_clientes1.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDAEXISTENCIA 
		ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.DesHabilitar()
		
		
		If Type("cId_cliente")<>T_LOGICAL
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Value=cId_cliente
		*!*		thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Valid
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Enabled=.f.
		Endif
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtADescargarClienteDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarClienteDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarClienteDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarClienteDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtADescargarClienteDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarClienteDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarClienteDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarClienteDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_Deposito
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionardeposito1.vItems,vDepositos)
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1
			thisform.oViewArtADescargarCliente.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_clientes1.Value,@vComprobantes,@vDepositos)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarCliente.Alias
		Else
			thisform.oViewArtADescargarClienteDetallado.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_clientes1.Value,@vComprobantes)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarClienteDetallado.Alias
		Endif	
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.Valid
		local lValida
		lValida=tg_textclave::valid()
		thisform.ClienteValidado=.f.
		if lValida.and.!this.FormDesactivado && .and.!thisform.ClienteValidado
				
				thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(this.Value)
				ThisForm.RazonSocial.Value=thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social")
				
				thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
				thisform.oTbxMoneda.Value=thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Nombre")
				thisform.ClienteValidado=.t.
		endif
		If !this.FormDesactivado
			thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		Endif	
		
		If (thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida).and.!this.FormDesactivado
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Habilitar()
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.t.
		Else
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.DesHabilitar()
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.f.
			
		Endif	
		
		Return thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		**** David **********
		lParameters cId_Articulo,vVnt_DocuSel,dFechaVtoMaximo
		**** David **********
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtADescargar","Tg_ViewArtADescargar")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtADescargarDetallado","Tg_ViewArtADescargarDetallado")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Alias
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Value=""
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Enabled=.F.
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		******** david ********
		Thisform.oTxbFecVtoDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTxbFecVtoHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value = SPACE(5)
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.Value = SPACE(5)
		
		
		ThisForm.OldClienteDesde=Thisform.Tg_clientes1.Value
		ThisForm.OldClienteHasta=Thisform.Tg_clientes2.Value
		ThisForm.OldSucCliente=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Value
		thisform.OldFecVtoDesde=Thisform.oTxbFecVtoDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFecVtoHasta=Thisform.oTxbFecVtoHasta.Value
		******** david ********
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		thisform.OldFormato=ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(4)
		
		******* david ********
		if type("cId_Articulo")<> "L"
		   thisform.Ocultar= .t.
		   thisform.RefrescarConsulta(cId_Articulo,@vVnt_DocuSel,dFechaVtoMaximo)
		else
		  thisform.Ocultar= .f.
		endif
		******* david ********
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
		
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
		
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		***** david ****
		Local lRetorna
		
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
		    if thisform.Ocultar
		       thisform.Hide
		    else
		       thisform.Release
		    endif      
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
		****** david *****
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters cId_Articulo,vVnt_DocuSel,dFechaVtoMaximo
		local mmpp, i, vDeposito1
		
		Dimension vDepositos1 [1]
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		
		if type("cId_Articulo")<> "L"
		   thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.value= 2
		   Thisform.oTxbFecVtoHasta.Value= dFechaVtoMaximo
		   thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde= cId_Articulo
		   thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta= cId_Articulo
		   thisform.Id_Marca=    "TD"
		   thisform.Id_Rubro=    "TD"
		   thisform.Id_SubRubro= "TD"
		   =aCopy(vVnt_DocuSel,vComprobantes)
		   =aCopy(vVnt_DocuSel,thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems )
		
		
		   For i=1 to alen(thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.vItems, 1)
		  		thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems[i,2] = .f.
		   Endfor
		   For mmpp=1 to thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.tg_ListBox1.ListCount
			    thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.tg_listbox1.Picture(mmpp)=thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.PictureDesMarcado	
		   endfor
		   For mmpp=1 to thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.tg_ListBox1.ListCount
			   For i=1 to alen(thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.vItems, 1)
				   if thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.Tg_ListBox1.ListItem(mmpp,2) = thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems[i,1]
				  		thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.tg_listbox1.Picture(mmpp)=thisform.Tg_SeleccionarComprobantes1.PictureMarcado
				  		thisform.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems[i,2] = .t.
				   endif		                       
			   Endfor
		   Endfor
		else
		   =aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		endif
		
		i = 0
		if type("thisform.oDepositosFormulas")="O"
			**trabajo con los depósitos seleccionados por el botón de depósitos, solamente tomaré el STOCK de los artículos de estos depósitos
			thisform.oDepositosFormulas.oViewDepositos.IrPrimero()
			do while !thisform.oDepositosFormulas.oViewDepositos.EsEof()
				if thisform.oDepositosFormulas.oViewDepositos.Leer("lSeleccionado") = 1
				i = i + 1
				Dimension thisform.vDepositos [i,2]
					thisform.vDepositos[i,1] = 1
					thisform.vDepositos[i,2] = thisform.oDepositosFormulas.oViewDepositos.Leer("Id_Deposito")
				endif	
				thisform.oDepositosFormulas.oViewDepositos.IrSiguiente()
			enddo
			if thisform.vDepositos[1,1] = 1  &&me indica que tengo algún depósito seleccionado
			    =aCopy(thisform.vDepositos, vDepositos1)  && paso los depositos seleccionados a la VISTA RESPECTIVA
			endif
		endif	
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1
		
			thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro,ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),thisform.oTxbFecVtoDesde.Value,thisform.oTxbFecVtoHasta.Value,@vDepositos1,ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.Value,ThisForm.Tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Value)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Alias
		Else
		
			thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro,ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),thisform.oTxbFecVtoDesde.Value,thisform.oTxbFecVtoHasta.Value,@vDepositos1,ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.Value,ThisForm.Tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Value)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias
		Endif	
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.Tg_commandbutton1.Enabled=thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionardepositos
		Local lSeleccionaTodos
		
		lSeleccionaTodos = .t.  && por DEFAULT me aparecen todos los depositos seleccionados

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		If Type("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos","TG_FrmFiltroArticulos")				
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Show()
		
		IF  thisform.Id_articuloDesde<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde or ;
			thisform.Id_articuloHasta<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;	
			thisform.id_Marca<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca  or;
			thisform.id_rubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro  or;
			thisform.id_Subrubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro  
		
		
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		Endif	
		
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		thisform.Id_articuloDesde=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde
		thisform.Id_articuloHasta=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta
		thisform.id_Marca=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca
		thisform.id_rubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro
		thisform.id_Subrubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro
		
		
	ENDPROC

		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidosDetallado","Tg_ViewArtVendidosDetallado")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidos","Tg_ViewArtVendidos")
		
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Alias
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		thisform.OldFormato=thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1
			THISFORM.REMOVEOBJECT("oViewArtVendidos")
			THISFORM.REMOVEOBJECT("oViewArtVendidosDetallado")
			thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidos","Tg_ViewArtVendidos")
			thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidosDetallado","Tg_ViewArtVendidosDetallado")
			thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro,ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Alias
		ELSE
			THISFORM.REMOVEOBJECT("oViewArtVendidos")
			THISFORM.REMOVEOBJECT("oViewArtVendidosDetallado")
			thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidosDetallado","Tg_ViewArtVendidosDetallado")
			thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidos","Tg_ViewArtVendidos")
			thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro,ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Alias
		Endif	
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		ThisForm.Tg_commandbutton1.Enabled=thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Alias
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Alias+".Detalle"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Alias+".Cantidad"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Alias+".PrecioUni"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Alias+".Total"
			
			&& Gustavo 29/1/2024
			
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=""
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=""
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=""
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=""
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=""
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=""
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column12.ControlSource=""
		
			&& Gustavo 29/1/24	
		
			
		*	thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.InputMask="9999999999." + replicate("9",Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Decimales_precio"))
		*	thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.InputMask="99999999999.99" 
		
		
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ColumnOrder=1
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ColumnOrder=2
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ColumnOrder=3
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ColumnOrder=4
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ColumnOrder=5
			
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(6)
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(6)
			
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.ScrollBars=2
		
			thisform.oTbxTotalPendiente.Value=Round(thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Sumar("Total",".t."),2)
			thisform.oTbxTotalArtVendidos.Value=Round(thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Sumar("Cantidad",".t."),2)
			
		
		Else
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Alias
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Alias+".Detalle"	
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Alias+".Cantidad"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Alias+".PrecioUni"	
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Alias+".Total"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Alias+".Id_Sucursal"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Alias+".ID_Comproba"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Alias+".Nro_Externo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Alias+".Fecha"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Alias+".Id_Cliente"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column12.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Alias+".Nombre"
		
		
			&& Gustavo 29/1/24	
			*thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.InputMask="9999999999." + replicate("9",Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Decimales_precio"))
			
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ColumnOrder=1
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ColumnOrder=2
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ColumnOrder=7
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ColumnOrder=8
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ColumnOrder=9	
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ColumnOrder=12
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ColumnOrder=3
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ColumnOrder=4
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ColumnOrder=5
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ColumnOrder=6
			
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ColumnOrder=10
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column12.ColumnOrder=11	
			
			thisform.oTbxTotalPendiente.Value=Round(thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Sumar("Total",".t."),2)
			thisform.oTbxTotalArtVendidos.Value=Round(thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Sumar("Cantidad",".t."),2)
			thisform.tg_grid1.ScrollBars=3
		
		
		Endif
		
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Parent.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oOpgTipoComprobante.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFormato
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFormato=this.Value
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbsucursales1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Sucursal
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbvendedores1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Vendedor
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local oAbmGen
		
		oAbmGen=CreateObject("tg_FormConsulta","Clientes",.f.,thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Cliente"))
		oAbmGen.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		If Type("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos","TG_FrmFiltroArticulos")				
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Show()
		
		IF  thisform.Id_articuloDesde<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde or ;
			thisform.Id_articuloHasta<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;	
			thisform.id_Marca<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca  or;
			thisform.id_rubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro  or;
			thisform.id_Subrubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro  
		
		
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.Id_articuloDesde=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde
		thisform.Id_articuloHasta=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta
		thisform.id_Marca=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca
		thisform.id_rubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro
		thisform.id_Subrubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Init
		dodefault("Remunerativo=.t. and !Cobranza",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled =this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_cliente
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidosCliente","Tg_ViewArtVendidosCliente")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado","Tg_ViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosCliente.Alias
		thisform.tg_clientes1.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDAEXISTENCIA 
		ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.DesHabilitar()
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=Ctod("  /  /  ")
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=Ctod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		
		If Type("cId_cliente")<>T_LOGICAL
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Value=cId_cliente
		*!*		thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Valid
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Enabled=.f.
		Endif
		thisform.OldFormato=thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value
		
		thisform.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1
			THISFORM.REMOVEOBJECT("oViewArtVendidosCliente")
			THISFORM.REMOVEOBJECT("oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado")
			thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidosCliente","Tg_ViewArtVendidosCliente")
			thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado","Tg_ViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado")
			thisform.oViewArtVendidosCliente.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_clientes1.Value,@vComprobantes,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosCliente.Alias
		ELSE
			THISFORM.REMOVEOBJECT("oViewArtVendidosCliente")
			THISFORM.REMOVEOBJECT("oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado")
			thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado","Tg_ViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado")
			thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidosCliente","Tg_ViewArtVendidosCliente")
			thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_clientes1.Value,@vComprobantes,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Alias
		Endif	
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
		
		
			
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosCliente.Alias
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosCliente.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosCliente.Alias+".Detalle"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosCliente.Alias+".Cantidad"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosCliente.Alias+".PrecioUni"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosCliente.Alias+".Total"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=""
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=""
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=""
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=""
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=""
			
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ColumnOrder=1
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ColumnOrder=2
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ColumnOrder=3
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ColumnOrder=4
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ColumnOrder=5
			
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(6)
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(6)
			
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.ScrollBars=2
		
			thisform.oTbxTotalPendiente.Value=Round(thisform.oViewArtVendidosCliente.Sumar("Total",".t."),2)
			thisform.oTbxTotalArtVendidos.Value=Round(thisform.oViewArtVendidosCliente.Sumar("Cantidad",".t."),2)
		Else
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Alias
			
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Alias+".Detalle"	
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Alias+".Cantidad"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Alias+".PrecioUni"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Alias+".Total"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Alias+".Id_Sucursal"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Alias+".ID_Comproba"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Alias+".Nro_Externo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Alias+".Fecha"
			
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ColumnOrder=1
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ColumnOrder=2
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ColumnOrder=3
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ColumnOrder=4
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ColumnOrder=5
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ColumnOrder=10
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ColumnOrder=6
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ColumnOrder=8
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ColumnOrder=7
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ColumnOrder=9
			
			thisform.oTbxTotalPendiente.Value=Round(thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Sumar("Total",".t."),2)
			thisform.oTbxTotalArtVendidos.Value=Round(thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Sumar("Cantidad",".t."),2)	
			thisform.tg_grid1.ScrollBars=3
		
		
		Endif
		
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdDatosCliente.Click
		Local oAbmGen
		
		oAbmGen=CreateObject("tg_FormConsulta","Clientes",.f.,thisform.tg_clientes1.Value)
		oAbmGen.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Parent.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdFiltroArticulos.Click
		If Type("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos","TG_FrmFiltroArticulos")				
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Show()
		
		IF  thisform.Id_articuloDesde<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde or ;
			thisform.Id_articuloHasta<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;	
			thisform.id_Marca<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca  or;
			thisform.id_rubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro  or;
			thisform.id_Subrubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro  
		
		
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.Id_articuloDesde=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde
		thisform.Id_articuloHasta=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta
		thisform.id_Marca=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca
		thisform.id_rubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro
		thisform.id_Subrubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oOpgTipoComprobante.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFormato
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFormato=this.Value
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		Dodefault()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.Valid
		local lValida
		lValida=tg_textclave::valid()
		thisform.CLienteValidado=.f.
		if lValida.and.!this.FormDesactivado && .and. !thisform.ClienteValidado
				
				thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(this.Value)
				ThisForm.RazonSocial.Value=thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social")
				
				thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
				thisform.oTbxMoneda.Value=thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Nombre")
				thisform.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .T.
				thisform.ClienteValidado=.t.
		endif
		*!*	If !this.FormDesactivado
		*!*		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		*!*	Endif	
		
		If (thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida).and.!this.FormDesactivado
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Habilitar()
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.t.
			thisform.oCmdFiltroArticulos.Enabled=.t.
			
		Else
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.DesHabilitar()
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.f.
			thisform.oCmdFiltroArticulos.Enabled=.f.
			
			
		Endif	
		
		
		Return thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.When
		
		
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

		** Matias S. 30/05/18 **

		**dodefault("Remunerativo=.t.",.t.)
		** Matias S. 30/05/18 **
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled =this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_cliente
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote","Tg_ViewArtVendidosClientePorLote")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Alias
		thisform.tg_clientes1.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDAEXISTENCIA 
		ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.DesHabilitar()
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=Ctod("  /  /  ")
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=Ctod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		
		If Type("cId_cliente")<>T_LOGICAL
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Value=cId_cliente
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Valid
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Enabled=.f.
		Endif
		
		thisform.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_clientes1.Value,@vComprobantes,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Alias
		
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Alias
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Alias+".Detalle"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Alias+".Cantidad"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Alias+".PrecioUni"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Alias+".Total"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Alias+".Id_Sucursal"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Alias+".ID_Comproba"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Alias+".Nro_Externo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Alias+".Fecha"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Alias+".Id_Lote"
		
			thisform.oTbxTotalPendiente.Value=Round(thisform.oViewArtVendidosClientePorLote.Sumar("Total",".t."),2)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdDatosCliente.Click
		Local oAbmGen
		
		oAbmGen=CreateObject("tg_FormConsulta","Clientes",.f.,thisform.tg_clientes1.Value)
		oAbmGen.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Parent.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdFiltroArticulos.Click
		If Type("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos","TG_FrmFiltroArticulos")				
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Show()
		
		IF  thisform.Id_articuloDesde<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde or ;
			thisform.Id_articuloHasta<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;	
			thisform.id_Marca<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca  or;
			thisform.id_rubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro  or;
			thisform.id_Subrubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro  
		
		
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.Id_articuloDesde=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde
		thisform.Id_articuloHasta=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta
		thisform.id_Marca=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca
		thisform.id_rubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro
		thisform.id_Subrubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.Valid
		local lValida
		lValida=tg_textclave::valid()
		thisform.CLienteValidado=.f.
		if lValida.and.!this.FormDesactivado && .and. !thisform.ClienteValidado
				
				thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(this.Value)
				ThisForm.RazonSocial.Value=thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social")
				
				thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
				thisform.oTbxMoneda.Value=thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Nombre")
				thisform.ClienteValidado=.t.
		endif
		If !this.FormDesactivado
			thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		Endif	
		
		If (thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida).and.!this.FormDesactivado
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Habilitar()
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.t.
			thisform.oCmdFiltroArticulos.Enabled=.t.
			thisform.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			
		Else
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.DesHabilitar()
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.f.
			thisform.oCmdFiltroArticulos.Enabled=.f.
			
			
		Endif	
		
		
		Return thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.When
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Init
		dodefault("Lotea=.t.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled =this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE configurarcolumnas
		Local nColumnas, nMesUltimo, nAnioUltimo, nCantMeses, nPrimerDia, nMesProximo, nAnioProximo, nPrimerDiaProximo
		Local nUltimoDiaUltimo, nUltimoDia, nPrimerDiaPeriodo, cNomMes
		Local vGrabacion, i , m
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		Thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.revertir()
		
		nColumnas = Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value + 3
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount = 2
		thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount = nColumnas
		thisform.tg_grid1.ScrollBars = 3
		
		nMesUltimo  = Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value
		nAnioUltimo = Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value
		nCantMeses  = Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value
		
		* este el el primer dia del mes ultimo a mostrar
		nPrimerDia        = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(nMesUltimo,2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(nAnioUltimo,4))
		
		* este es el mes proximo al ultimo mes a mostrar
		nMesProximo       = iif(nMesUltimo = 12, 1, nMesUltimo + 1)
		
		nAnioProximo      = iif(nMesUltimo <> 12, nAnioUltimo, nAnioUltimo + 1)
		nPrimerDiaProximo = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(nMesProximo,2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(nAnioProximo,4))
		
		* este es el ultimo dia del mes ultimo a mostrar
		nUltimoDiaUltimo        = nPrimerDiaProximo - 1
		
		* Este loop arma las columnas anteriores al ultimo periodo
		
		for i = 3 to nColumnas - 2
		 
		    nPrimerDiaPeriodo = nPrimerDia
		 
		    for m = (nColumnas - 2)  to i step -1
		        nUltimoDia = nPrimerDiaPeriodo - 1
		        nPrimerDiaPeriodo = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(Month(nUltimoDia),2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(year(nUltimoDia),4))
		    next
		
		    cNomMes = Thisform.DarMesAbreviado(Month(nUltimoDia))
		    
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).FontSize = 8
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.Caption = cNomMes+str(year(nPrimerDiaPeriodo),4)
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.Alignment = 2
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.FontSize = 8
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).ReadOnly = .t.
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Width = 67
		    
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaDesde", nPrimerDiaPeriodo)     
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaHasta", nUltimoDia)
		    
		    Thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		    
		next 
		
		* Columna Ultimo Periodo
		
		cNomMes = Thisform.DarMesAbreviado(Month(nPrimerDia))
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.Caption = cNomMes+str(year(nPrimerDiaPeriodo),4)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.Alignment = 2
		Thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).ReadOnly = .t.
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Width = 67
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaDesde", nPrimerDia)     
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaHasta", nUltimoDiaUltimo)
		   
		Thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		
		* Columna Total
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.Caption = "Total"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.Alignment = 2
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).ReadOnly = .t.
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Width = 67
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE darmesabreviado
		lParameters nMes
		
		Do Case 
		
		   Case nMes = 1
		        return("Ene")
		   Case nMes = 2
		        return("Feb")
		   Case nMes = 3
		        return("Mar")
		   Case nMes = 4
		        return("Abr")
		   Case nMes = 5
		        return("May")
		   Case nMes = 6
		        return("Jun")
		   Case nMes = 7
		        return("Jul")
		   Case nMes = 8
		        return("Ago")
		   Case nMes = 9
		        return("Set")
		   Case nMes = 10
		        return("Oct")
		   Case nMes = 11
		        return("Nov")
		   Case nMes = 12
		        return("Dic")
		
		EndCase
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidosDetallado","Tg_ViewArtVendidosDetallado")
		
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oCaj_Cashflow","tg_tabla","Caj_CashFlow","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion","tg_tabla","Aux_EstadisticasEvolucion","Codigo")
		
		Thisform.oCaj_Cashflow.SetearProp("BOT")
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.SetearProp("BOT")
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value = year(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Fecha"))
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value = Month(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Fecha"))
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value = 4
		
		Thisform.ConfigurarColumnas()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		*thisform.OldFormato=thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value
		*thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local dFechaDesde, dFechaHasta, nColumna, vGrabacion, mCampo, cId_Articulo, nCantidad, nImporte, cDetalle, nTotal
		Local nacumula, cId_cliente
		
		Local nPonezeta, cNada
		
		Thisform.ConfigurarColumnas()
		
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Revertir()
		
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Codigo")
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.IrPrimero()
		
		nColumna = 0
		
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 3
		   lPoneZeta=.t.
		   cNada = "Z"
		else
		   lPoneZeta=.f.
		   cNada = " "
		endif
		
		Do while !thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.EsEof()
		
		   dFechaDesde =  thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.Leer("FechaDesde")
		   dFechaHasta =  thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.Leer("FechaHasta")
		   
		   nColumna = nColumna + 1
		   
		   mCampo = "Campo"+alltrim(str(nColumna))
		  
		
		   THISFORM.REMOVEOBJECT("oViewArtVendidosDetallado")
		   thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidosDetallado","Tg_ViewArtVendidosDetallado")
			 
		   thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro,ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
		   
		   Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias
		   
		   thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.IrPrimero()
		   
		   do while !thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.EsEof()
		
		      cId_Cliente  = padr(thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Cliente"),15) 
		      nImporte     = thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Total") 
		      cDetalle     = thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nombre")  
		      
		      if Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Buscar(cNada+cId_Cliente,.f.,"Codigo")  
		         
		         nTotal = Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Leer("Total")
		         nAcumula = Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Leer(mCampo) 
		                  
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, mCampo    , nAcumula + nImporte )
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre"  , cDetalle)
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Total"   , nTotal + nImporte)
		         if lPoneZeta
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nada"   , "Z")
		         endif
		         Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		          
		      else
		      
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Codigo"  , cId_Cliente )      
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, mCampo    , nImporte )
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre"  , cDetalle)
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Total"   , nImporte)
		         if lPoneZeta
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nada"   , "Z")
		         endif
		         Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		      
		      endif
		      
		      thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.IrSiguiente()
		      
		   enddo 
		   
		   thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.IrSiguiente()
		    
		enddo
		
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 1
		   Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Codigo")
		endif
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 2
		   Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Nombre")
		endif
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 3
		   Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Total")
		endif
		
		
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		*ThisForm.Tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local nColumnas, mCampo
		
		nColumnas = Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value + 3
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Codigo"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Nombre"
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnas).ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Total"
		
		for i = 3 to nColumnas - 1
		    mCampo = ".Campo"+alltrim(str(i-2))
		    Thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(i).ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+mCampo
		next
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Parent.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbsucursales1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Sucursal
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbvendedores1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Vendedor
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		If Type("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos","TG_FrmFiltroArticulos")				
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Show()
		
		IF  thisform.Id_articuloDesde<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde or ;
			thisform.Id_articuloHasta<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;	
			thisform.id_Marca<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca  or;
			thisform.id_rubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro  or;
			thisform.id_Subrubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro  
		
		
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.Id_articuloDesde=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde
		thisform.Id_articuloHasta=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta
		thisform.id_Marca=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca
		thisform.id_rubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro
		thisform.id_Subrubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro
		
		
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_optiongroup1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFormato=this.Value
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Init
		dodefault("Remunerativo=.t. and Cobranza=.f.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled =this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox1.Valid
		if this.value >= 1980 and this.value <= 2079
		   return .t.
		else
		   return
		endif      
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox2.Valid
		if this.value >= 1 and this.value <= 12
		   return .t.
		else 
		   return .f.
		endif      
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox3.Valid
		if this.value >= 4 and this.value <= 36
		   return .t.
		else
		   return .f.
		endif
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE
