	PROCEDURE configurarcolumnas
		Local nColumnas, nMesUltimo, nAnioUltimo, nCantMeses, nPrimerDia, nMesProximo, nAnioProximo, nPrimerDiaProximo
		Local nUltimoDiaUltimo, nUltimoDia, nPrimerDiaPeriodo, cNomMes
		Local vGrabacion, i , m
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		Thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.revertir()
		
		nColumnas = Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value + 9
		
		*thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount = 2
		thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount = nColumnas
		thisform.tg_grid1.ScrollBars = 3
		
		nMesUltimo  = Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value
		nAnioUltimo = Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value
		nCantMeses  = Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value
		
		* este el el primer dia del mes ultimo a mostrar
		nPrimerDia        = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(nMesUltimo,2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(nAnioUltimo,4))
		
		* este es el mes proximo al ultimo mes a mostrar
		nMesProximo       = iif(nMesUltimo = 12, 1, nMesUltimo + 1)
		
		nAnioProximo      = iif(nMesUltimo <> 12, nAnioUltimo, nAnioUltimo + 1)
		nPrimerDiaProximo = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(nMesProximo,2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(nAnioProximo,4))
		
		* este es el ultimo dia del mes ultimo a mostrar
		nUltimoDiaUltimo        = nPrimerDiaProximo - 1
		
		* Este loop arma las columnas anteriores al ultimo periodo
		
		for i = 9 to nColumnas - 2
		 
		    nPrimerDiaPeriodo = nPrimerDia
		 
		    for m = (nColumnas - 2)  to i step -1
		        nUltimoDia = nPrimerDiaPeriodo - 1
		        nPrimerDiaPeriodo = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(Month(nUltimoDia),2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(year(nUltimoDia),4))
		    next
		
		    cNomMes = Thisform.DarMesAbreviado(Month(nUltimoDia))
		    
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).FontSize = 8
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.Caption = cNomMes+str(year(nPrimerDiaPeriodo),4)
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.Alignment = 2
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.FontSize = 8
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).ReadOnly = .t.
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Width = 67
		    
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaDesde", nPrimerDiaPeriodo)     
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaHasta", nUltimoDia)
		    
		    Thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		    
		next 
		
		* Columna Ultimo Periodo
		
		cNomMes = Thisform.DarMesAbreviado(Month(nPrimerDia))
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.Caption = cNomMes+str(year(nPrimerDiaPeriodo),4)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.Alignment = 2
		Thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).ReadOnly = .t.
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Width = 67
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaDesde", nPrimerDia)     
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaHasta", nUltimoDiaUltimo)
		   
		Thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		
		* Columna Total
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.Caption = "Total"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.Alignment = 2
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).ReadOnly = .t.
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Width = 67
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE darmesabreviado
		lParameters nMes
		
		Do Case 
		
		   Case nMes = 1
		        return("Ene")
		   Case nMes = 2
		        return("Feb")
		   Case nMes = 3
		        return("Mar")
		   Case nMes = 4
		        return("Abr")
		   Case nMes = 5
		        return("May")
		   Case nMes = 6
		        return("Jun")
		   Case nMes = 7
		        return("Jul")
		   Case nMes = 8
		        return("Ago")
		   Case nMes = 9
		        return("Set")
		   Case nMes = 10
		        return("Oct")
		   Case nMes = 11
		        return("Nov")
		   Case nMes = 12
		        return("Dic")
		
		EndCase
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidos","Tg_ViewArtVendidos")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidosDetallado","Tg_ViewArtVendidosDetallado")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		
		* ancla
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCategorias","tg_tabla","Categorias","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblProvincias","tg_tabla","Provincias","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblDescuentos","tg_tabla","Descuentos","clave")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oCaj_Cashflow","tg_tabla","Caj_CashFlow","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion","tg_tabla","Aux_EstadisticasEvolucion","Codigo")
		
		Thisform.oCaj_Cashflow.SetearProp("BOT")
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.SetearProp("BOT")
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value = year(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Fecha"))
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value = Month(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Fecha"))
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value = 4
		
		Thisform.ConfigurarColumnas()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		*thisform.OldFormato=thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value
		*thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local dFechaDesde, dFechaHasta, nColumna, vGrabacion, mCampo, cId_Articulo, nCantidad, nImporte, cDetalle, nTotal
		Local nacumula, cId_cliente, nDescHEb, nDescCad, nDescPan
		Local vTotalesMensuales, nTotalGeneral, lPonezeta, i
		
		Dimension vTotalesMensuales[1]
		
		Thisform.ConfigurarColumnas()
		
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Revertir()
		
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Codigo")
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.IrPrimero()
		
		nColumna = 0
		nTotalGeneral = 0
		
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 3
		   lPoneZeta=.t.
		   cNada = "Z"
		else
		   lPoneZeta=.f.
		   cNada = " "
		endif
		   
		Do while !thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.EsEof()
		   dFechaDesde =  thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.Leer("FechaDesde")
		   dFechaHasta =  thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.Leer("FechaHasta")
		   
		   nColumna = nColumna + 1
		   
		   mCampo = "Campo"+alltrim(str(nColumna))
		   
		   Dimension vTotalesMensuales[nColumna]
		   vTotalesMensuales[nColumna]=0
		   
		   thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro,ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
		   
		   thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.IrPrimero()
		   
		   do while !thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.EsEof()
		
		      cId_Cliente  = padr(thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Cliente"),15) 
		      nImporte     = thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Total") 
		      cDetalle     = thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nombre")  
		      
		      vTotalesMensuales[nColumna] = vTotalesMensuales[nColumna] + nImporte
		      nTotalGeneral = nTotalGeneral + nImporte
		      
		      if Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Buscar(cNada+cId_Cliente,.f.,"Codigo")  
		         
		         nTotal = Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Leer("Total")
		         nAcumula = Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Leer(mCampo) 
		                  
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, mCampo    , nAcumula + nImporte )
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre"  , cDetalle)
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Total"   , nTotal + nImporte)
		         if lPoneZeta
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nada"   , "Z")
		         endif
		         Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		          
		      else
		      
		         * como es el primer registro de cliente tomo los datos del abm
		         Thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(Substr(cId_Cliente,1,5),.f.,"Clave")  
		         
		         Thisform.oTblCategorias.Buscar(Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Categoria"),.f.,"Clave")  
		         
		         Thisform.oTblProvincias.Buscar(Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Provincia"),.f.,"Clave")  
		         
		         Thisform.oTblDescuentos.Buscar(Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_TipoDescuento")+"HEB",.f.,"Clave")  
		         nDescHeb = Thisform.oTblDescuentos.Leer("Descuento")
		         Thisform.oTblDescuentos.Buscar(Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_TipoDescuento")+"CAD",.f.,"Clave")  
		         nDescCad = Thisform.oTblDescuentos.Leer("Descuento")
		         Thisform.oTblDescuentos.Buscar(Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_TipoDescuento")+"PAN",.f.,"Clave")  
		         nDescPan = Thisform.oTblDescuentos.Leer("Descuento")
		      
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Codigo"      , cId_Cliente )      
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, mCampo        , nImporte )
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre"      , cDetalle)
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Total"       , nImporte)
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Categoria"   , Thisform.oTblCategorias.Leer("Nombre"))
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Provincia"   , Thisform.oTblProvincias.Leer("Nombre"))
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Localidad"   , Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Localidad"))
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Heb"         , nDescHeb )
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cad"         , nDescCad )
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Pan"         , nDescPan )
		         if lPoneZeta
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nada"   , "Z")
		         endif
		         
		         Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		      
		      endif
		      
		      thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.IrSiguiente()
		      
		   enddo 
		   
		   thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.IrSiguiente()
		    
		enddo
		
		* agrego los Totales generales por mes
		for i = 1 to alen(vTotalesMensuales)
		    mCampo = "Campo"+alltrim(str(i))
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, mCampo    , vTotalesMensuales[i])
		next
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Total" , nTotalGeneral)
		if !lPoneZeta
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nada"   , "Z")
		endif
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 1
		   Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Codigo")
		endif
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 2
		   Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Nombre")
		endif
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 3
		   Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Total")
		endif
		
		
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		*ThisForm.Tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local nColumnas, mCampo
		
		nColumnas = Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value + 9
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Categoria"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Cad"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Heb"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Pan"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Codigo"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Nombre"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Localidad"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Provincia"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnas).ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Total"
		
		for i = 9 to nColumnas - 1
		    mCampo = ".Campo"+alltrim(str(i-8))
		    Thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(i).ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+mCampo
		next
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Parent.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbsucursales1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Sucursal
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbvendedores1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Vendedor
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		If Type("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos","TG_FrmFiltroArticulos")				
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Show()
		
		IF  thisform.Id_articuloDesde<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde or ;
			thisform.Id_articuloHasta<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;	
			thisform.id_Marca<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca  or;
			thisform.id_rubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro  or;
			thisform.id_Subrubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro  
		
		
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.Id_articuloDesde=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde
		thisform.Id_articuloHasta=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta
		thisform.id_Marca=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca
		thisform.id_rubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro
		thisform.id_Subrubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_optiongroup1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFormato=this.Value
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Init
		dodefault("Remunerativo=.t. and Cobranza=.f.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled =this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox1.Valid
		if this.value >= 1980 and this.value <= 2079
		   return .t.
		else
		   return
		endif      
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox2.Valid
		if this.value >= 1 and this.value <= 12
		   return .t.
		else 
		   return .f.
		endif      
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox3.Valid
		if this.value >= 4 and this.value <= 36
		   return .t.
		else
		   return .f.
		endif
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE configurarcolumnas
		Local nColumnas, nMesUltimo, nAnioUltimo, nCantMeses, nPrimerDia, nMesProximo, nAnioProximo, nPrimerDiaProximo
		Local nUltimoDiaUltimo, nUltimoDia, nPrimerDiaPeriodo, cNomMes
		Local vGrabacion, i , m
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		Thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.revertir()
		** Lucas
		*nColumnas = Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value + 3
		nColumnas = Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value + 8
		** Lucas
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount = 2
		thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount = nColumnas
		thisform.tg_grid1.ScrollBars = 3
		
		nMesUltimo  = Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value
		nAnioUltimo = Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value
		nCantMeses  = Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value
		
		* este el el primer dia del mes ultimo a mostrar
		nPrimerDia        = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(nMesUltimo,2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(nAnioUltimo,4))
		
		* este es el mes proximo al ultimo mes a mostrar
		nMesProximo       = iif(nMesUltimo = 12, 1, nMesUltimo + 1)
		
		nAnioProximo      = iif(nMesUltimo <> 12, nAnioUltimo, nAnioUltimo + 1)
		nPrimerDiaProximo = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(nMesProximo,2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(nAnioProximo,4))
		
		* este es el ultimo dia del mes ultimo a mostrar
		nUltimoDiaUltimo        = nPrimerDiaProximo - 1
		
		* Este loop arma las columnas anteriores al ultimo periodo
		
		for i = 3 to nColumnas - 7
		 
		    nPrimerDiaPeriodo = nPrimerDia
		 
		    for m = (nColumnas - 7)  to i step -1
		        nUltimoDia = nPrimerDiaPeriodo - 1
		        nPrimerDiaPeriodo = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(Month(nUltimoDia),2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(year(nUltimoDia),4))
		    next
		
		    cNomMes = Thisform.DarMesAbreviado(Month(nUltimoDia))
		    
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).FontSize = 8
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.Caption = cNomMes+str(year(nPrimerDiaPeriodo),4)
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.Alignment = 2
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.FontSize = 8
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).BackColor = rgb(245,248,203)
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).ReadOnly = .t.
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Width = 67
		    
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaDesde", nPrimerDiaPeriodo)     
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaHasta", nUltimoDia)
		    
		    Thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		    
		next 
		
		* Columna Ultimo Periodo
		
		cNomMes = Thisform.DarMesAbreviado(Month(nPrimerDia))
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).Header1.Caption = cNomMes+str(year(nPrimerDiaPeriodo),4)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).Header1.Alignment = 2
		Thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).Header1.FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).BackColor = rgb(245,248,203)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).ReadOnly = .t.
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).Width = 67
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaDesde", nPrimerDia)     
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaHasta", nUltimoDiaUltimo)
		   
		Thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		
		* Columna Total
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).Header1.Caption = "Promedio"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).Header1.Alignment = 2
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).Header1.FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).ReadOnly = .t.
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).Width = 67
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).BackColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		
		** Lucas
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-4).FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-4).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-4).Header1.Caption = "Total"

	PROCEDURE darmesabreviado
		lParameters nMes
		
		Do Case 
		
		   Case nMes = 1
		        return("Ene")
		   Case nMes = 2
		        return("Feb")
		   Case nMes = 3
		        return("Mar")
		   Case nMes = 4
		        return("Abr")
		   Case nMes = 5
		        return("May")
		   Case nMes = 6
		        return("Jun")
		   Case nMes = 7
		        return("Jul")
		   Case nMes = 8
		        return("Ago")
		   Case nMes = 9
		        return("Set")
		   Case nMes = 10
		        return("Oct")
		   Case nMes = 11
		        return("Nov")
		   Case nMes = 12
		        return("Dic")
		
		EndCase
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidos","Tg_ViewArtVendidosEvolucion")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidosDetallado","Tg_ViewArtVendidosDetallado")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oCaj_Cashflow","tg_tabla","Caj_CashFlow","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion","tg_tabla","Aux_EstadisticasEvolucion","Codigo")
		
		Thisform.oCaj_Cashflow.SetearProp("BOT")
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.SetearProp("BOT")
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value = year(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Fecha"))
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value = Month(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Fecha"))
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value = 4
		
		Thisform.ConfigurarColumnas()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		
		** Lucas
		ThisForm.Tg_cmblistaprecios1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbprovincias1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_cmblistaprecios1.Value="TD"
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbprovincias1.Value="TD"
		
		ThisForm.OldId_ListaPrecios = ThisForm.Tg_cmblistaprecios1.Value
		ThisForm.OldId_Provincia	= ThisForm.Tg_cmbprovincias1.Value
		** Lucas
		
		*** Matias L. 24/08/2024 #1807
		thisform.tg_cmbgruposempresarios1.setearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbgruposempresarios1.Value = "TD"
		*** Matias L. 24/08/2024 #1807
		
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		thisform.OldFormato=thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value
		*thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local dFechaDesde, dFechaHasta, nColumna, vGrabacion, mCampo, cId_Articulo, nCantidad, nImporte, cDetalle, nTotal
		
		Local nPonezeta, cNada, nPromedioVta
		Local nPromedio, nStock,nCosto,nPrecioLista
		
		Thisform.ConfigurarColumnas()
		
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Revertir()
		
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Codigo")
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.IrPrimero()
		
		nColumna = 0
		
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 3
		   lPoneZeta=.t.
		   cNada = "Z"
		else
		   lPoneZeta=.f.
		   cNada = " "
		endif
		
		** Lucas
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionardeposito1.vItems,vDepositos)
		** Lucas
		
		
		Do while !thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.EsEof()
		
		   dFechaDesde =  thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.Leer("FechaDesde")
		   dFechaHasta =  thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.Leer("FechaHasta")
		   
		   nColumna = nColumna + 1
		   
		   mCampo = "Campo"+alltrim(str(nColumna))
		   
		   *** Matias L. 24/08/2024 #1807

	PROCEDURE configurarcolumnas
		Local nColumnas, nMesUltimo, nAnioUltimo, nCantMeses, nPrimerDia, nMesProximo, nAnioProximo, nPrimerDiaProximo
		Local nUltimoDiaUltimo, nUltimoDia, nPrimerDiaPeriodo, cNomMes
		Local vGrabacion, i , m
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		Thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.revertir()
		** Lucas
		*nColumnas = Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value + 3
		nColumnas = Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value + 8
		** Lucas
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount = 2
		thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount = nColumnas
		thisform.tg_grid1.ScrollBars = 3
		
		nMesUltimo  = Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value
		nAnioUltimo = Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value
		nCantMeses  = Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value
		
		* este el el primer dia del mes ultimo a mostrar
		nPrimerDia        = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(nMesUltimo,2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(nAnioUltimo,4))
		
		* este es el mes proximo al ultimo mes a mostrar
		nMesProximo       = iif(nMesUltimo = 12, 1, nMesUltimo + 1)
		
		nAnioProximo      = iif(nMesUltimo <> 12, nAnioUltimo, nAnioUltimo + 1)
		nPrimerDiaProximo = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(nMesProximo,2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(nAnioProximo,4))
		
		* este es el ultimo dia del mes ultimo a mostrar
		nUltimoDiaUltimo        = nPrimerDiaProximo - 1
		
		* Este loop arma las columnas anteriores al ultimo periodo
		
		for i = 3 to nColumnas - 7
		 
		    nPrimerDiaPeriodo = nPrimerDia
		 
		    for m = (nColumnas - 7)  to i step -1
		        nUltimoDia = nPrimerDiaPeriodo - 1
		        nPrimerDiaPeriodo = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(Month(nUltimoDia),2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(year(nUltimoDia),4))
		    next
		
		    cNomMes = Thisform.DarMesAbreviado(Month(nUltimoDia))
		    
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).FontSize = 8
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.Caption = cNomMes+str(year(nPrimerDiaPeriodo),4)
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.Alignment = 2
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.FontSize = 8
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).BackColor = rgb(245,248,203)
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).ReadOnly = .t.
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Width = 67
		    
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaDesde", nPrimerDiaPeriodo)     
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaHasta", nUltimoDia)
		    
		    Thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		    
		next 
		
		* Columna Ultimo Periodo
		
		cNomMes = Thisform.DarMesAbreviado(Month(nPrimerDia))
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).Header1.Caption = cNomMes+str(year(nPrimerDiaPeriodo),4)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).Header1.Alignment = 2
		Thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).Header1.FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).BackColor = rgb(245,248,203)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).ReadOnly = .t.
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-6).Width = 67
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaDesde", nPrimerDia)     
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaHasta", nUltimoDiaUltimo)
		   
		Thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		
		* Columna Total
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).Header1.Caption = "Promedio"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).Header1.Alignment = 2
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).Header1.FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).ReadOnly = .t.
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).Width = 67
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-5).BackColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		
		** Lucas
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-4).FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-4).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-4).Header1.Caption = "Total"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-4).Header1.Alignment = 2
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-4).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-4).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-4).Header1.FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-4).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-4).ReadOnly = .t.
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-4).BackColor = rgb(241,245,186)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-4).Width = 67
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-3).FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-3).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-3).Header1.Caption = "Stock"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-3).Header1.Alignment = 2
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-3).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-3).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-3).Header1.FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-3).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-3).ReadOnly = .t.
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-3).Width = 67

		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-2).Header1.Caption = "Costo Art."
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-2).Header1.Alignment = 2

	PROCEDURE darmesabreviado
		lParameters nMes
		
		Do Case 
		
		   Case nMes = 1
		        return("Ene")
		   Case nMes = 2
		        return("Feb")
		   Case nMes = 3
		        return("Mar")
		   Case nMes = 4
		        return("Abr")
		   Case nMes = 5
		        return("May")
		   Case nMes = 6
		        return("Jun")
		   Case nMes = 7
		        return("Jul")
		   Case nMes = 8
		        return("Ago")
		   Case nMes = 9
		        return("Set")
		   Case nMes = 10
		        return("Oct")
		   Case nMes = 11
		        return("Nov")
		   Case nMes = 12
		        return("Dic")
		
		EndCase
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidos","Tg_ViewArtVendidosEvolucion")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidosDetallado","Tg_ViewArtVendidosDetallado")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oCaj_Cashflow","tg_tabla","Caj_CashFlow","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion","tg_tabla","Aux_EstadisticasEvolucion","Codigo")
		
		Thisform.oCaj_Cashflow.SetearProp("BOT")
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.SetearProp("BOT")
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value = year(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Fecha"))
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value = Month(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Fecha"))
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value = 4
		
		Thisform.ConfigurarColumnas()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		
		** Lucas
		ThisForm.Tg_cmblistaprecios1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbprovincias1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_cmblistaprecios1.Value="TD"
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbprovincias1.Value="TD"
		
		ThisForm.OldId_ListaPrecios = ThisForm.Tg_cmblistaprecios1.Value
		ThisForm.OldId_Provincia	= ThisForm.Tg_cmbprovincias1.Value
		** Lucas
		
		
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		thisform.OldFormato=thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value
		*thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local dFechaDesde, dFechaHasta, nColumna, vGrabacion, mCampo, cId_Articulo, nCantidad, nImporte, cDetalle, nTotal
		
		Local nPonezeta, cNada, nPromedioVta
		Local nPromedio, nStock,nCosto,nPrecioLista
		
		Thisform.ConfigurarColumnas()
		
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Revertir()
		
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Codigo")
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.IrPrimero()
		
		nColumna = 0
		
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 3
		   lPoneZeta=.t.
		   cNada = "Z"
		else
		   lPoneZeta=.f.
		   cNada = " "
		endif
		
		** Lucas
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionardeposito1.vItems,vDepositos)
		** Lucas
		
		
		Do while !thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.EsEof()
		
		   dFechaDesde =  thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.Leer("FechaDesde")
		   dFechaHasta =  thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.Leer("FechaHasta")
		   
		   nColumna = nColumna + 1
		   
		   mCampo = "Campo"+alltrim(str(nColumna))
		   
		   thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro,ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),ThisForm.Tg_cmblistaprecios1.Value,ThisForm.Tg_cmbprovincias1.Value,@vDepositos)
		
		   thisform.oViewArtVendidos.IrPrimero()
		   
		   do while !thisform.oViewArtVendidos.EsEof()
		
		      cId_Articulo = thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Leer("Id_Articulo") 
		      nCantidad    = thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Leer("Cantidad") 
		      nImporte     = thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Leer("Total") 
		      cDetalle     = thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Leer("Detalle")  
		
		      nPromedio	   = thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Leer("Promedio") 
			  nStock	   = thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Leer("Stock") 
			  nCosto	   = thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Leer("CostoArt") 
			  nPrecioLista = thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Leer("PrecioLista") 
			  nPromedioVta = thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Leer("PrecioUni") 
			        
		      if Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Buscar(cNada+cId_Articulo,.f.,"Codigo")  
		         
		         nTotal = Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Leer("Total")
		                  
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, mCampo    , iif(ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1, nImporte, nCantidad))
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre"  , cDetalle)
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Total"   , iif(ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1, nTotal + nImporte, nTotal + nCantidad))
		         if lPoneZeta
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nada"   , "Z")
		         endif
		
			     =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Promedio" 		, iif(ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1, nTotal + nImporte, nTotal + nCantidad) / Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value)
				 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Stock" 	  		, nStock)	     
				 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CostoArt" 		, nCosto)	     
				 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "PrecioLista" 	, nPrecioLista)	  
				 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "PromedioVta" 	, nPromedioVta)	  
				   
		         Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		          
		      else
		      
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Codigo"  , cId_Articulo )      
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, mCampo    , iif(ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1, nImporte, nCantidad))
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre" , cDetalle)
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Total"   , iif(ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1, nImporte, nCantidad))
		         if lPoneZeta
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nada"   , "Z")
		         endif
		
			     =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Promedio" , iif(ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1, nImporte, nCantidad) / Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value)
				 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Stock" 	  		, nStock)	     
				 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CostoArt" 		, nCosto)	     
				 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "PrecioLista" 	, nPrecioLista)	     
				 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "PromedioVta" 	, nPromedioVta)	  
				 
		         Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		      
		      endif
		      
		      thisform.oViewArtVendidos.IrSiguiente()
		      
		   enddo 
		   
		   thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.IrSiguiente()
		   
		enddo
		
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 1
		   Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Codigo")
		endif   
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 2
		   Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Nombre")
		endif   
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 3
		   Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Total")
		endif   
		
		
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		*ThisForm.Tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local nColumnas, mCampo
		
		** Lucas
		nColumnas = Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value + 8
		*nColumnas = Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value + 3
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Codigo"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Nombre"
		
		*Thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnas).ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Total"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnas-5).ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Promedio"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnas-4).ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Total"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnas-3).ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Stock"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnas-2).ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".CostoArt"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnas-1).ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".PromedioVta"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnas).ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".PrecioLista"
		
		
		*for i = 3 to nColumnas - 1
		for i = 3 to nColumnas - 6
		    mCampo = ".Campo"+alltrim(str(i-2))
		    Thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(i).ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+mCampo
		next
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		** Lucas
		
		
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFormato=this.Value
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

		Endif

		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		If Type("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos","TG_FrmFiltroArticulos")				
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Show()
		
		IF  thisform.Id_articuloDesde<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde or ;
			thisform.Id_articuloHasta<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;	
			thisform.id_Marca<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca  or;
			thisform.id_rubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro  or;
			thisform.id_Subrubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro  
		
		
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.Id_articuloDesde=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde
		thisform.Id_articuloHasta=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta
		thisform.id_Marca=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca
		thisform.id_rubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro
		thisform.id_Subrubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro
		
		
	ENDPROC

			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFormato=this.Value
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox1.Valid
		if this.value >= 1980 and this.value <= 2079
		   return .t.
		else
		   return
		endif      
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox2.Valid
		if this.value >= 1 and this.value <= 12
		   return .t.
		else 
		   return .f.
		endif      
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox3.Valid
		if this.value >= 4 and this.value <= 36
		   return .t.
		else
		   return .f.
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE configurarcolumnas
		Local nColumnas, nMesUltimo, nAnioUltimo, nCantMeses, nPrimerDia, nMesProximo, nAnioProximo, nPrimerDiaProximo
		Local nUltimoDiaUltimo, nUltimoDia, nPrimerDiaPeriodo, cNomMes
		Local vGrabacion, i , m
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		Thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.revertir()
		
		nColumnas = Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value + 3
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount = 2
		thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount = nColumnas
		thisform.tg_grid1.ScrollBars = 3
		
		nMesUltimo  = Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value
		nAnioUltimo = Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value
		nCantMeses  = Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value
		
		* este el el primer dia del mes ultimo a mostrar
		nPrimerDia        = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(nMesUltimo,2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(nAnioUltimo,4))
		
		* este es el mes proximo al ultimo mes a mostrar
		nMesProximo       = iif(nMesUltimo = 12, 1, nMesUltimo + 1)
		
		nAnioProximo      = iif(nMesUltimo <> 12, nAnioUltimo, nAnioUltimo + 1)
		nPrimerDiaProximo = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(nMesProximo,2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(nAnioProximo,4))
		
		* este es el ultimo dia del mes ultimo a mostrar
		nUltimoDiaUltimo        = nPrimerDiaProximo - 1
		
		* Este loop arma las columnas anteriores al ultimo periodo
		
		for i = 3 to nColumnas - 2
		 
		    nPrimerDiaPeriodo = nPrimerDia
		 
		    for m = (nColumnas - 2)  to i step -1
		        nUltimoDia = nPrimerDiaPeriodo - 1
		        nPrimerDiaPeriodo = ctod("01/"+padl(alltrim(str(Month(nUltimoDia),2)),2,"0")+"/"+str(year(nUltimoDia),4))
		    next
		
		    cNomMes = Thisform.DarMesAbreviado(Month(nUltimoDia))
		    
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).FontSize = 8
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.Caption = cNomMes+str(year(nPrimerDiaPeriodo),4)
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.Alignment = 2
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.FontSize = 8
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).ReadOnly = .t.
		    thisform.tg_grid1.columns(i).Width = 67
		    
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaDesde", nPrimerDiaPeriodo)     
		    =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaHasta", nUltimoDia)
		    
		    Thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		    
		next 
		
		* Columna Ultimo Periodo
		
		cNomMes = Thisform.DarMesAbreviado(Month(nPrimerDia))
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.Caption = cNomMes+str(year(nPrimerDiaPeriodo),4)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.Alignment = 2
		Thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).ReadOnly = .t.
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas-1).Width = 67
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaDesde", nPrimerDia)     
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "FechaHasta", nUltimoDiaUltimo)
		   
		Thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		
		* Columna Total
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Inputmask = "999999999.99"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.Caption = "Total"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.Alignment = 2
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.BackColor = rgb(128,128,128)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.ForeColor = rgb(255,255,255)
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.FontSize = 8
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Header1.FontName = "Arial"
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).ReadOnly = .t.
		thisform.tg_grid1.columns(nColumnas).Width = 67
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE darmesabreviado
		lParameters nMes
		
		Do Case 
		
		   Case nMes = 1
		        return("Ene")
		   Case nMes = 2
		        return("Feb")
		   Case nMes = 3
		        return("Mar")
		   Case nMes = 4
		        return("Abr")
		   Case nMes = 5
		        return("May")
		   Case nMes = 6
		        return("Jun")
		   Case nMes = 7
		        return("Jul")
		   Case nMes = 8
		        return("Ago")
		   Case nMes = 9
		        return("Set")
		   Case nMes = 10
		        return("Oct")
		   Case nMes = 11
		        return("Nov")
		   Case nMes = 12
		        return("Dic")
		
		EndCase
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		&&&thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidos","Tg_ViewArtVendidos")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidosDetallado","Tg_ViewArtVendidosDetallado")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oCaj_Cashflow","tg_tabla","Caj_CashFlow","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion","tg_tabla","Aux_EstadisticasEvolucion","Codigo")
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Alias
		Thisform.oCaj_Cashflow.SetearProp("BOT")
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.SetearProp("BOT")
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value = year(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Fecha"))
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value = Month(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Fecha"))
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value = 4
		
		Thisform.ConfigurarColumnas()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		*thisform.OldFormato=thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value
		*thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local dFechaDesde, dFechaHasta, nColumna, vGrabacion, mCampo, cId_Articulo, nCantidad, nImporte, cDetalle, nTotal
		Local nacumula, cId_cliente
		
		Local nPonezeta, cNada
		
		Thisform.ConfigurarColumnas()
		
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Revertir()
		
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Codigo")
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.IrPrimero()
		
		nColumna = 0
		
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 3
		   lPoneZeta=.t.
		   cNada = "Z"
		else
		   lPoneZeta=.f.
		   cNada = " "
		endif
		
		Do while !thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.EsEof()
		
		   dFechaDesde =  thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.Leer("FechaDesde")
		   dFechaHasta =  thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.Leer("FechaHasta")
		   
		   nColumna = nColumna + 1
		   
		   mCampo = "Campo"+alltrim(str(nColumna))
		   
		   
		 
		
			THISFORM.REMOVEOBJECT("oViewArtVendidosDetallado")
			thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidosDetallado","Tg_ViewArtVendidosDetallado")
			thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro,ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Alias
			
		   thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.IrPrimero()
		   
		   do while !thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.EsEof()
		
		      cId_Cliente  = padr(thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Cliente"),15) 
		      nImporte     = thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Total") 
		      cDetalle     = thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nombre")  
		      
		      if Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Buscar(cNada+cId_Cliente,.f.,"Codigo")  
		         
		         nTotal = Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Leer("Total")
		         nAcumula = Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Leer(mCampo) 
		                  
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, mCampo    , nAcumula + nImporte )
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre"  , cDetalle)
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Total"   , nTotal + nImporte)
		         if lPoneZeta
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nada"   , "Z")
		         endif
		         Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		          
		      else
		      
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Codigo"  , cId_Cliente )      
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, mCampo    , nImporte )
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre"  , cDetalle)
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Total"   , nImporte)
		         if lPoneZeta
		            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nada"   , "Z")
		         endif
		         Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		      
		      endif
		      
		      thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.IrSiguiente()
		      
		   enddo 
		   
		   thisform.oCaj_CashFlow.IrSiguiente()
		    
		enddo
		
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 1
		   Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Codigo")
		endif
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 2
		   Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Nombre")
		endif
		if Thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value = 3
		   Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.FijarTag("Total")
		endif
		
		
		Thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		*ThisForm.Tg_commandbutton1.Enabled = thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local nColumnas, mCampo
		
		nColumnas = Thisform.Tg_TextBox3.Value + 3
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Codigo"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Nombre"
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(nColumnas).ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+".Total"
		
		for i = 3 to nColumnas - 1
		    mCampo = ".Campo"+alltrim(str(i-2))
		    Thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(i).ControlSource=thisform.oAux_EstadisticasEvolucion.Alias+mCampo
		next
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Parent.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbsucursales1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Sucursal
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbvendedores1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Vendedor
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		If Type("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos","TG_FrmFiltroArticulos")				
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Show()
		
		IF  thisform.Id_articuloDesde<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde or ;
			thisform.Id_articuloHasta<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;	
			thisform.id_Marca<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca  or;
			thisform.id_rubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro  or;
			thisform.id_Subrubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro  
		
		
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.Id_articuloDesde=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde
		thisform.Id_articuloHasta=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta
		thisform.id_Marca=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca
		thisform.id_rubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro
		thisform.id_Subrubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_optiongroup1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFormato=this.Value
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
	ENDPROC

		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox1.Valid
		if this.value >= 1980 and this.value <= 2079
		   return .t.
		else
		   return
		endif      
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox2.Valid
		if this.value >= 1 and this.value <= 12
		   return .t.
		else 
		   return .f.
		endif      
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox3.Valid
		if this.value >= 4 and this.value <= 36
		   return .t.
		else
		   return .f.
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabardatos
		LParameters cId_Articulo, nCantidadSemiElaborado
		Local nCantidad, nCostoHistorico, nCostoActual, nValuacionHistorica, nValuacionActual, vGrabacion
		store 0 to nCantidad, nCostoHistorico, nCostoActual, nValuacionHistorica, nValuacionActual
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		*nCantidad = thisform.oCstSistemaStock.ConsultarStockAFecha (cId_Articulo, @vAuxiliar, thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value)
		*nCostoHistorico = thisform.oCstSistemaStock.ConsultarCostoHistorico (cId_Articulo, thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value)
		*nValuacionHistorica = nCantidad * nCostoHistorico
		
		if thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar (cId_Articulo, .f., "CLAVE")
			if thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inventario")
			
				*nCostoActual = thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Costo"),thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_monedaCosto"),0,thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Id_MonedaPrincipal"),0,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value)
				*nValuacionActual = nCantidad * nCostoActual
		
				=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo"   , cId_Articulo)
				*=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Nombre"        , thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre"))
				=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Cantidad"      , nCantidadSemiElaborado)
				*=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "CostoHistorico", nCostoHistorico)
				*=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "CostoActual"   , nCostoActual)
				*=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "ValHistorica"  , nValuacionHistorica)
				*=fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "ValActual"     , nValuacionActual)
			
				thisform.oAux_Costos.AgregaryModificar (@vGrabacion, .t.)
			endif	
		endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtVendidos","Tg_ViewArtVendidos")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos"      , "tg_tabla", "Articulos"      ,"clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblCostoReposicion", "tg_tabla", "CostoReposicion","Id_Articul")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblStk_Kits"       , "tg_tabla", "Stk_Kits"       ,"clave")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_ConsCostoStockFormulas" , "tg_tabla", "Aux_ConsCostoStockFormulas", "ID_ARTICUL")
		thisform.AddObject("oAux_Costos" , "tg_tabla", "Aux_ConsCostoStockFormulas")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oCstSistemaStock", "Tg_SistemaStock")
		
		thisform.oTblAux_ConsCostoStockFormulas.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oAux_Costos.SetearProp ("BOT")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oCstConvMonUniversal","Tg_ConvMonUniversal")
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Alias
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		*thisform.OldFormato=thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		*!*	IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
		*!*		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
		*!*			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		*!*		Else
		*!*			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
		*!*		Endif	
		*!*	Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE recursivo2
		Lparameters cArticuloMp
		
		Local cId_Articulo, cStringAux, nReg, nCostoReposicion, nCostoActual, nCantidad
		
		Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		*!*	if thisform.oTblAux_ConsCostoStockFormulas.Buscar (cArticuloMp, .f., "ID_ARTICUL")
		*!*		** no hago nada porque ya lo tengo a este artículo 
		*!*	else
		*!*		**AQUI GRABO LA CANTIDAD DISPONIBLE Y LOS COSTOS RESPECTIVOS DEL ARTICULO
		*!*		thisform.GrabarDatos (cArticuloMp)
		*!*	endif
			
		nCantidad = Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Cantidad") 	
			
		if Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Buscar (cArticuloMp, .f., "CLAVE")
			**ES SEMIELABORADO
			
			**Pregunto si es Mano de Obra, para no ciclar infinito
			if thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar (cArticuloMp, .f., "CLAVE")
				
				if !thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer ("ManodeObra")
				
				   * como no es mano de obra lo agrego en la tabla auxiliar para calcular costo
				   
				   thisform.GrabarDatos(cArticuloMp, nCantidad)
				
					**no es mano de obra, por lo que tengo que seguir ciclando por las fórmulas
					do while !this.oTblStk_Kits.EsEof() and this.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_ArticuloKit") = cArticuloMp
			
						cId_Articulo    = this.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_Articulo")
						cStringAux      = "Recno('" + this.oTblStk_Kits.Alias + "')"
						nReg            = &cStringAux
				
					 	this.Recursivo2 (cId_Articulo)
					 	*Recursivo2 with Stk_Kits.Id_Articulo, nCantidadFinal, Stk_Kits.Id_ArticuloKit, nCosto
						this.oTblStk_Kits.IrRegistro (nReg)
		
						thisform.oTblStk_Kits.IrSiguiente()
					enddo
					
				endif	
				
			endif
			
		endif		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cStringAux, nReg, cId_Articulo, lOmiteManodeObra, cId_MonedaCostoArticulo
		Local nPorcfalla, nCostoHoraMo, nProdPorHora, nCostoMo, nCostoArticulo
		Local cId_ArticuloFormula, nCantidadArticuloFormula, cId_MonedaCostoArticuloformula, nCostoArticuloFormula
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro,ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion())
		
		* aca calculo la mano de obra de cada articulo si tiene formula
		
		Thisform.oViewArtVendidos.IrPrimero()
		
		Do while !Thisform.oViewArtVendidos.EsEof()
		
		   nCostoMo = 0
		   
		   if Thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Buscar(thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Leer("Id_Articulo"),.f.,"Clave")
		
		      * como aca empieza un nuevo articulo revierto el auxiliar de costos
		      Thisform.oAux_Costos.Revertir() 
		
			  * no lo grabo este articulo porque es el que averiguo el costo
			  * thisform.GrabarDatos (thisform.oViewConsCostoStockFormulas.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
		
		      * barro formula
		      
			  do while !thisform.oTblStk_Kits.EsEof() and thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_ArticuloKit") = thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Leer("Id_Articulo")
				
				 cId_articulo    = thisform.oTblStk_Kits.Leer("Id_Articulo")
				 cStringAux      = "Recno('" + this.oTblStk_Kits.Alias + "')"
				 nReg            = &cStringAux
			 	 this.Recursivo2 (cId_Articulo)
				 this.oTblStk_Kits.IrRegistro (nReg)
		
				 thisform.oTblStk_Kits.IrSiguiente()
				 
		 	  enddo
		  
		      * ahora debo recorre el archivo auxiliar reestructurando costos de abajo para arriba
		   
		      lOmiteManodeObra = Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("OmiteCostoMo")
		      
		      nCostoMo = 0  
		   
		      Thisform.oAux_Costos.IrUltimo()
		   
		      Do while !Thisform.oAux_Costos.EsBof()
		   
		         cId_Articulo = Thisform.oAux_Costos.Leer("Id_Articulo")
		      
		         Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave")
		      
		         cId_monedaCostoArticulo = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_MonedaCosto")
		      
		         nPorcfalla = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("PorcFalla")
		         nCostoHoraMo = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("CostoHoraMo")
		         nProdporHora = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("ProdPorHora")
		      
		         if nProdPorHora <> 0
		            nCostoMo = nCostoMo + (nCostoHoraMo / nProdPorHora)
		         else
		            nCostoMo = nCostoMo + 0
		         endif   
		     
		         Thisform.oAux_Costos.IrAnterior()
		      
		      Enddo && de recalcular los costos de todos los semielaborados que componen el articulo en cuestion
		
		      * ahora sumo si tiene la mano de obra del articulo vendido 
		
		      cId_Articulo = Thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Leer("Id_Articulo")
		      
		      Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_Articulo,.f.,"Clave")
		      
		      cId_monedaCostoArticulo = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_MonedaCosto")
		      
		      nPorcfalla = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("PorcFalla")
		      nCostoHoraMo = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("CostoHoraMo")
		      nProdporHora = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("ProdPorHora")
		      
		      if nProdPorHora <> 0
		         nCostoMo = nCostoMo + (nCostoHoraMo / nProdPorHora)
		      else
		         nCostoMo = nCostoMo + 0
		      endif   
		
		   endif
		   
		   * ahora lo grabo el costoMo y el total en la vista
		
		   =fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "PrecioUni"   , nCostoMo )
		   =fGrabar (@vGrabacion, "Total"       , nCostoMo * Thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Leer("Cantidad"))
		       
		   thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   
		   Thisform.oViewArtVendidos.IrSiguiente()
		   
		Enddo
		
		Thisform.oViewArtVendidos.IrPrimero()
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		*ThisForm.Tg_commandbutton1.Enabled=thisform.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Alias
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Alias+".Id_Articulo"

	ENDPROC

			thisform.Id_articuloHasta<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;

			thisform.id_Subrubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro  
		
		
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.Id_articuloDesde=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde
		thisform.Id_articuloHasta=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta

	ENDPROC
