	PROCEDURE inicializarcontroles
		
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value = Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oAux_VentasPorRubro.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.SetearValorInicial(Space(3))
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.SetearValorInicial(Space(3))
		ThisForm.Tg_articulos1.SetearValorInicial(Space(15))
		ThisForm.Tg_articulos2.SetearValorInicial(Space(15))
		ThisForm.Tg_marcas1.SetearValorInicial(Space(3))
		ThisForm.Tg_marcas2.SetearValorInicial(Space(3))
		ThisForm.Tg_rubros1.SetearValorInicial(Space(3))
		ThisForm.Tg_rubros2.SetearValorInicial(Space(3))
		ThisForm.Tg_subrubros1.SetearValorInicial(Space(3))
		ThisForm.Tg_subrubros2.SetearValorInicial(Space(3))
		
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Valida =TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.Valida =TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		ThisForm.Tg_articulos1.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		ThisForm.Tg_articulos2.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		ThisForm.Tg_marcas1.Valida	 =TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		ThisForm.Tg_marcas2.Valida	 =TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		ThisForm.Tg_rubros1.Valida	 =TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		ThisForm.Tg_rubros2.Valida	 =TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		ThisForm.Tg_subrubros1.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		ThisForm.Tg_subrubros2.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		
		Thisform.oTblListaPrecios.IrPrimero()
		ThisForm.Tg_cmblistaprecios1.Value = Thisform.oTblListaPrecios.Leer("Id_Lista")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewVentasPorRubro"	,"Tg_ViewVentasPorRubro")
		Thisform.AddObject("oCstConvMonUniversal"	,"Tg_ConvMonUniversal")
		Thisform.AddObject("oCstSisVentas"			,"Tg_SistemaVentas")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblListaPrecios"		,"tg_tabla","ListaPrecios","CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos"			,"tg_tabla","Articulos","CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_alicuotasIvas"	,"tg_tabla","Vnt_alicuotasIvas","CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Precios"		,"tg_tabla","Vnt_Precios","CLAVE")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros"			,"tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		
		thisform.AddObject("oAux_VentasPorRubro","tg_tabla","Aux_VentasPorRubro","CLAVE")
		thisform.oAux_VentasPorRubro.SetearProp("BOT")
		Thisform.oAux_VentasPorRubro.Revertir
		
		Thisform.InicializarControles()
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE obtenercosto
		lParameters cLstId_MonedaHasta
		local nCosto 
		
		nCosto = Thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.leer("costo")
		
		if Thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.Leer("Id_MonedaCosto") <> cLstId_MonedaHasta
			nCosto = Thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(Thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.leer("costo"),Thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.Leer("Id_MonedaCosto"),0,cLstId_MonedaHasta,0,,)
		endif 
		
		Return nCosto
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE obtenerpreciolista
		lParameters cLstId_Lista, cLstId_MonedaHasta, cId_articulo
		Local nPrecioLista, cId_MonedaDesdeLista, lIva_Incluido
		
		nPrecioLista = 0
		lIva_Incluido = .F.
		
		if Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.buscar(Thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.leer("id_articulo")+cLstId_Lista,.F.,"CLAVE")
			nPrecioLista = Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.leer("precio")
		
			if Thisform.oTblListaPrecios.buscar(cLstId_Lista,.F.,"CLAVE")
				cId_MonedaDesdeLista = Thisform.oTblListaPrecios.leer("id_moneda")
				lIva_Incluido 		 = Thisform.oTblListaPrecios.leer("iva_incluido")
				
				if cId_MonedaDesdeLista <> cLstId_MonedaHasta
					nPrecioLista = Thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(nPrecioLista,cId_MonedaDesdeLista,0,cLstId_MonedaHasta,0,,)
				endif
			
				if lIva_Incluido
					if Thisform.oTblArticulos.buscar(cId_articulo,.F.,"CLAVE")
						if Thisform.oTblVnt_alicuotasIvas.buscar(Thisform.oTblArticulos.leer("id_alicuotaiva"),.F.,"CLAVE")
							nPrecioLista = nPrecioLista / (1 + (Thisform.oTblVnt_alicuotasIvas.leer("porcentaje") / 100))
						endif 
					endif 
				endif 
			endif 
		
		endif 
		
		
		return nPrecioLista 
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		Thisform.oAux_VentasPorRubro.Revertir()
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		
		thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.Refrescar(Thisform.Tg_clientes1.Value, Thisform.Tg_clientes2.Value,;
											   thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,;
											   Thisform.Tg_articulos1.Value, Thisform.Tg_articulos2.Value,;
											   Thisform.Tg_marcas1.Value, Thisform.Tg_marcas2.Value,;
											   Thisform.Tg_rubros1.Value, Thisform.Tg_rubros2.Value,;
											   Thisform.Tg_subrubros1.Value, Thisform.Tg_subrubros2.Value,;
											   thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,;
											   @vComprobantes)
		
		
		 
		Thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While !Thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.EsEof()
		
			nCantTotal 		  = 0
			nCostoTotal 	  = 0
			nPrecioListaTotal = 0
			
			cId_rubroAnt 	  = Thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.Leer("Id_rubro")
			cNombreAnt 		  = Thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.Leer("nombre")
			
			Do While !Thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.EsEof() and Thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.Leer("Id_rubro") = cId_rubroAnt
				
				*nPrecioLista = round(Thisform.ObtenerPrecioLista(Thisform.Tg_cmblistaprecios1.Value, ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value, Thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.leer("id_articulo")),2)
				nPrecioLista = Thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.Leer("Cantidad") * Thisform.oCstSisVentas.ConsultarPrecio(Thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.leer("id_articulo"), Thisform.Tg_cmblistaprecios1.Value, ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value, .F., .F.)
				nCosto 		 = round(Thisform.obtenerCosto(ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value),2)
				
				nCantTotal 	 = nCantTotal + Thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.Leer("Cantidad")
				nCostoTotal  = nCostoTotal + nCosto * Thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.Leer("Cantidad")
				nPrecioListaTotal = nPrecioListaTotal + nPrecioLista
		
				Thisform.oViewVentasPorRubro.IrSiguiente()
			EndDo
			
			nRentabilidad = 0
			If nPrecioListaTotal <> 0
				nRentabilidad = round((nPrecioListaTotal / nCostoTotal * 100) - 100,2)
			Endif 
			
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Rubro" 	 , cId_rubroAnt)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Detalle" 	 , cNombreAnt)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cantidad" 	 , nCantTotal)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Costo" 		 , nCostoTotal)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Precio" 		 , nPrecioListaTotal)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Rentabilidad" , nRentabilidad)
			Thisform.oAux_VentasPorRubro.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion, .T.)
		EndDo
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oAux_VentasPorRubro.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oAux_VentasPorRubro.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_VentasPorRubro.Alias+".Id_Rubro"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_VentasPorRubro.Alias+".Detalle"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_VentasPorRubro.Alias+".Cantidad"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_VentasPorRubro.Alias+".Costo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_VentasPorRubro.Alias+".Precio"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_VentasPorRubro.Alias+".Rentabilidad"
		*thisform.oTbxTotalPendiente.Value=Round(thisform.oViewArtVendidos.Sumar("Total",".t."),2)
		
		thisform.oAux_VentasPorRubro.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Parent.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Init
		dodefault("Remunerativo=.t.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled =This.ExistenMarcados()
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE Init
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComADescargar","Tg_ViewComADescargar")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVendedores","tg_tabla","Vendedores","Usuario")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias
		thisform.AddObject("Tg_MenuLib1","tg_MenuLib")
		
		*!*	ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.DesHabilitar()
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		
		*** Chiara 27/08/2020
		thisForm.tg_cmbSuc_clientes1.Enabled = .F.
		thisForm.tg_cmbSuc_clientes1.SetearTodos()
		thisForm.tg_cmbSuc_clientes1.Value = "TD"
		thisForm.Oldcliente = thisForm.tg_clientes1.Value
		thisForm.OldSuc_cliente = thisForm.tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Value
		*** Chiara 27/08/2020
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		Thisform.oTbxVencimientoDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxVencimientoHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.oTbxReferencia.Value=0
		&& MATIAS L. 19/10/2018
		thisform.oTbxNumero.Value=Space(14)
		*!*	thisform.oTbxNumero.Value=Space(13)
		&& MATIAS L. 19/10/2018
		
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldVencimientoDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldVencimientoHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		
		thisform.OldReferencia=0
		&& MATIAS L. 19/10/2018
		thisform.OldNumero=Space(14)
		&& MATIAS L. 19/10/2018
		
		
		
		If Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("filtro_vendedorusuario") And !oApp.PerfilAdministrador()
			IF Thisform.oTblVendedores.Buscar(oApp.Usuario, .F., "USUARIO")
				Thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value = Thisform.oTblVendedores.Leer("id_vendedor")
				Thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Enabled = .F.
			Endif
		Endif
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarmenu
		Local vVector[2]
		
		vVector[1]="Consultar Comprobante..."
		vVector[2]="Consultar Pendiente...  "
		
		ThisForm.Tg_menulib1.ShowMenu(@vVector)
		
		Do case 
			Case Bar()=1
					thisform.MostrarComprobante
			Case Bar()=2
					thisform.MostrarPendiente
		
		EndCase	
		
		Return 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarpendiente
		if type("thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante","TG_ConsultarArtPendComprobante")
		
		Endif
		thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante.SetearConsulta(thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Nro_Referencia"))
		thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal,cId_vendedor
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal=""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		Endif
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
			cId_Vendedor=""
		Else
			cId_Vendedor=ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value
		Endif
		
		*** Chiara 27/07/2020
		IF thisForm.tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Value = "TD" OR EMPTY(thisForm.tg_clientes1.Value)
			cSuc_Cliente = ""
		ELSE 
			cSuc_Cliente = thisForm.tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Value
		ENDIF 
		*** Chiara 27/07/2020
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		*** Chiara 27/07/2020 Agregué cliente y suc cliente
		thisform.oViewComADescargar.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,thisForm.tg_clientes1.Value,cId_Sucursal,cId_vendedor,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),ThisForm.oTbxVencimientoDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxVencimientoHasta.Value,thisform.oTbxReferencia.Value,thisform.oTbxNumero.Value,cSuc_Cliente)
		*** Chiara 27/07/2020
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".TotalDeuda"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Pendiente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Id_cliente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Vencimiento"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".NombrePrioridad"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column12.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".TotalSinIva"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column13.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".NombreVendedor"
		*** PASAJE DE NO TASAS
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column14.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".NombreEstado"
		*** PASAJE DE NO TASAS
		*!*	thisform.oCmdDetalle.Enabled=!thisform.oViewComADescargar.EsTablaVacia()
		*** Chiara 27/08/2020
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column15.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias+".Suc_Cliente"
		*** Chiara 27/08/2020
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		thisform.oTbxTotalPendiente.Value=Round(thisform.oViewComADescargar.Sumar("Pendiente",".t."),2)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		thisform.tg_CommandButton1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.LostFocus
		*** Chiara 27/07/2020
		thisForm.tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Enabled = !EMPTY(this.Value)

			thisForm.tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Filtrar("Id_Cliente='" + This.Value + "' OR CodSucursal = 'TD'")
		ELSE 	
			thisForm.tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.Value = "TD"
		ENDIF

			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif
		thisform.oldCliente=this.Value
		*** Chiara 27/07/2020
	ENDPROC

				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
				ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarseleccion
		lParameters cId_Cliente,cId_Comproba,cId_moneda
		
		If Type("cId_cliente")<>T_LOGICAL
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Value=cId_cliente
			*** Martin
			thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
			Thisform.Id_Comproba	=	cId_Comproba
			Thisform.Id_Moneda		=	cId_Moneda
			*** Martin
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Valid
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Enabled=.f.
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Enabled=.f.
		    *** David ****
		    thisform.PaneldeControl= .T.
		    *** David ***
		    thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
		Else
			thisform.Id_Moneda		=	.f.
			Thisform.Id_Comproba	=	.f.	
			thisform.PaneldeControl =   .f.
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Enabled=.t.
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_cliente,cId_Comproba,cId_Moneda
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComADescargarCliente","Tg_ViewComADescargarCliente")

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT	
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewComADescargarCliente.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComADescargarCliente.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComADescargarCliente.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComADescargarCliente.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)

			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComADescargarCliente.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComADescargarCliente.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComADescargarCliente.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComADescargarCliente.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
		Endif

	ENDPROC

		vVector[2]="Consultar Pendiente...  "

		Do case 
			Case Bar()=1
					Set cursor on
					thisform.MostrarComprobante
			Case Bar()=2
					Set cursor on
					thisform.MostrarPendiente
		
		EndCase	
		
		Return 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		
		***** Martin
		If Type("Thisform.Id_Comproba") = "L"
			=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		Else
			dimension vComprobantes[2]
			vComprobantes[1]=Thisform.Id_Comproba
			vComprobantes[2]=.t.
		Endif	
		***** Martin
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComADescargarCliente.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_clientes1.Value,@vComprobantes,thisform.id_moneda,ThisForm.oTbxReferencia.value,ThisForm.oTbxNumero.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarCliente.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarCliente.Alias

		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarCliente.Alias+".Pendiente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarCliente.Alias+".NombreEstado"
		
		&& Tasas aca
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarCliente.Alias+".Id_Operacion"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarCliente.Alias+".NumeroOperacion"

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxNumero.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldNumero
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldNumero=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxReferencia.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldReferencia
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldReferencia=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.Valid
		local lValida
		lValida=tg_textclave::valid()
		thisform.ClienteValidado=.f.
		if lValida.and.!this.FormDesactivado &&.and.!thisform.ClienteValidado
				
				thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(this.Value)
				ThisForm.RazonSocial.Value=thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social")
				
				****** Martin
				If Type("Thisform.Id_Moneda") <> "L"	
					thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(thisform.Id_Moneda)
				Else
					thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
				endif	
				****** Martin
				
				thisform.oTbxMoneda.Value=thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Nombre")
				thisform.ClienteValidado=.t.
		endif
		If !this.FormDesactivado
			thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		Endif	
		
		If (thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida).and.!this.FormDesactivado
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Habilitar()
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.t.
		Else
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.DesHabilitar()
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.f.
		Endif	
		
		
		
		Return thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled =this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComADescargar","Tg_ViewComADescargar")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVendedores","tg_tabla","Vendedores","Usuario")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias
		thisform.AddObject("Tg_MenuLib1","tg_MenuLib")
		
		*!*	ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.DesHabilitar()
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		Thisform.oTbxVencimientoDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxVencimientoHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.oTbxReferencia.Value=0
		&& MATIAS L. 19/10/2018
		thisform.oTbxNumero.Value=Space(14)
		*!*	thisform.oTbxNumero.Value=Space(13)
		&& MATIAS L. 19/10/2018
		
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldVencimientoDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldVencimientoHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		
		thisform.OldReferencia=0
		&& MATIAS L. 19/10/2018
		thisform.OldNumero=Space(14)
		&& MATIAS L. 19/10/2018
		
		
		
		If Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("filtro_vendedorusuario") And !oApp.PerfilAdministrador()
			IF Thisform.oTblVendedores.Buscar(oApp.Usuario, .F., "USUARIO")
				Thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value = Thisform.oTblVendedores.Leer("id_vendedor")
				Thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Enabled = .F.
			Endif
		Endif
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarmenu
		Local vVector[2]
		
		vVector[1]="Consultar Comprobante..."
		vVector[2]="Consultar Pendiente...  "
		
		ThisForm.Tg_menulib1.ShowMenu(@vVector)
		
		Do case 
			Case Bar()=1
					thisform.MostrarComprobante
			Case Bar()=2
					thisform.MostrarPendiente
		
		EndCase	
		
		Return 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarpendiente
		if type("thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante","TG_ConsultarArtPendComprobante")
		
		Endif
		thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante.SetearConsulta(thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComADescargar.Leer("Nro_Referencia"))
		thisform.oFrmArtPendComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal,cId_vendedor
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal=""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		Endif
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
			cId_Vendedor=""
		Else
			cId_Vendedor=ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value
		Endif
		
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComADescargar.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",cId_Sucursal,cId_vendedor,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),ThisForm.oTbxVencimientoDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxVencimientoHasta.Value,thisform.oTbxReferencia.Value,thisform.oTbxNumero.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComADescargar.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE actualizararticulosdescargar
		LParameters cId_SucursalBase,cId_SistemaBase,cId_ComprobanteBase,nNro_ReferenciaBase,cId_Articulo,nCantidad,cNombre,cRenglonDescarga
		
		Local vGrabacion,mmpp,nCantADescargar,lPendiente,cRenglon
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		*** Martin
		thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Buscar(cId_SucursalBase+cId_SistemaBase+cId_ComprobanteBase+Str(nNro_ReferenciaBase,10))
		*** Martin
		
		*cRenglon = Thisform.oCstAdmRenglon.darNumeroOriginal(cRenglonDescarga,nNro_ReferenciaBase,cId_ComprobanteBase)
		cRenglon = cRenglonDescarga 
		 
		Thisform.oVnt_DocuCompDescargable.Buscar(cId_ComprobanteBase,.f.,"Clave")
		Thisform.VntCancela_Pendientes=Thisform.oVnt_DocuCompDescargable.Leer("Cancela_Pendientes")
		
		
		Thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Buscar(cId_SucursalBase+cId_SistemaBase+cId_ComprobanteBase+str(nNro_ReferenciaBase,10))
		nCantADescargar=nCantidad
		*!*				Do while thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_Comproba")=thisform.iD_ComprobanteBase.and.thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Nro_Referencia")=thisform.Nro_ComprobanteBase.And.nCantADescargar>=0
		Do while thisform.oVnt_Detalle.EsClaveIgual().And.nCantADescargar>=0
		
			if cId_Articulo=thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_Articulo") And ;
				Alltrim(Upper(cNombre))=Alltrim(Upper(thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Detalle"))) And ;
				cRenglon=thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Renglon")		
				
							
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cant_Pendiente",thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Cant_Pendiente")-nCantADescargar)				
				thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
				
				If thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Cant_Pendiente")<0
					nCantADescargar=-thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Cant_Pendiente")
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cant_Pendiente",0)				
					thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
				Else
					nCantADescargar=0
				Endif	
			Endif							
			
		
			thisform.oVnt_Detalle.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		*** Martin
		If thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("List_Com_Pen") And nCantADescargar=0 and thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Ac_Pendiente") <> 0 and !thisform.ConfComAut
			Thisform.CstAdmPendientes.descargarPendiente(cId_Articulo,thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Ac_Pendiente"),nCantidad )
		Endif
		*** Martin
		
		
		lPendiente=.f.	
		Thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Buscar(cId_SucursalBase+cId_SistemaBase+cId_ComprobanteBase+str(nNro_ReferenciaBase,10))
		Do while thisform.oVnt_Detalle.EsClaveIgual()
			if !thisform.Vacio(thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Id_Articulo")).and.thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("Cant_Pendiente")<>0
				lPendiente=.t.
				Exit
			Endif						
			thisform.oVnt_Detalle.IrSiguiente
		Enddo
		
		If lPendiente
			If Thisform.CliCancela_Pendientes and Thisform.VntCancela_Pendientes
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"cancela_aut",.t.)
				lPendiente=.f.
			Endif
		Endif
		
		*** Martin
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fec_Modi", Date() )
		
		if !lPendiente
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cancelado_Desc",.t.)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cancelado",.t..and.thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Leer("Cancelado_Cta"))
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oVnt_CabeceraBase.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		*** Martin	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE actualizarcomprobantedescargado
		Local vVector,vAux,i,nPos
		
		
		
		thisform.oDetalle.IrPrimero()
				
		Do while !thisform.oDetalle.EsEof()
			
			if !thisform.Vacio(thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Nombre")).and.!thisform.Vacio(thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Id_articulo")) And !Thisform.Vacio(thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Id_SucursalBase"))
				Thisform.ActualizarArticulosDescargar(thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Id_SucursalBase"),thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Id_SistemaBase"),thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Id_ComprobaBase"),thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Nro_ReferenciaBase"),thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Id_Articulo"),thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Cantidad"),thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Nombre"),thisform.oDetalle.Leer("Renglon"))
			Endif	
		
			thisform.oDetalle.IrSiguiente
			
		Enddo
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE arreglarpendientepiqueo
		
		&& Agregado de Edgardo 26-09-2005
		
		   * aca antes de distribuir el stock actualizo el campo pendiente piqueo
		Local vComprobantesPiqueo[1,2]
		i = 1
		Thisform.oVnt_Docu.IrPrimero()
		do while !Thisform.oVnt_Docu.EsEof()
		   if Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Ac_Piqueo")=1
		      Dimension vComprobantesPiqueo[i,2]
		      vComprobantesPiqueo[i,1]=Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		      vComprobantesPiqueo[i,2]=.t.
		      i = i + 1
		   endif
		   Thisform.oVnt_Docu.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
		
		=FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "PendientesPiqueo", 0)  
		thisform.oTblArticulos.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.,.t.)
		 
		*!*    *thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro,ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),thisform.oTxbFecVtoDesde.Value,thisform.oTxbFecVtoHasta.Value,@vDepositos1)
		thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Refrescar(@vComprobantesPiqueo,"",thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,ctod("  /  /  "),oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(),thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro,ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),ctod("  /  /  "),oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()) 
		thisform.oViewArtADescargar.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oViewArtADescargar.EsEof()
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Leer("Id_Articulo"),.f.,"Clave")
		   =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "PendientesPiqueo", thisform.oViewArtADescargar.Leer("Cant_Pendiente"))  
		   thisform.oTblArticulos.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		      
		   
		   thisform.oViewArtADescargar.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
		
		thisform.oViewArtADescargarPorDeposito.Refrescar(@vComprobantesPiqueo,"",thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,ctod("  /  /  "),oApp.TomarMaximaFecha(),thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro,ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),ctod("  /  /  "),oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()) 
		thisform.oViewArtADescargarPorDeposito.IrPrimero()
		Do while !thisform.oViewArtADescargarPorDeposito.EsEof()
		   if Thisform.oStk_Stock.Buscar(thisform.oViewArtADescargarPorDeposito.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+thisform.oViewArtADescargarPorDeposito.Leer("Id_Articulo")+Thisform.oViewArtADescargarPorDeposito.Leer("id_deposito"),.f.,"Clave")
		   
			   =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "PendientesPiqueo", thisform.oViewArtADescargarPorDeposito.Leer("Cant_Pendiente"))  
		   	   thisform.oStk_Stock.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   Endif   
		   
		   thisform.oViewArtADescargarPorDeposito.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularinternos
		
		Local nMontoInternos,mmpp
		nMontoInterno=0
		
		** GUSTAVO copiado tasas chequeado
		
		
		For mmpp=1 to alen(thisform.vTotales,1)
		
			if thisform.vTotales[mmpp,2]<>0
				*** Girolamo
				If thisform.oParametros.Leer("imp_int_costo") and thisform.vTotales[mmpp,4]>0
					nMontoInterno=nMontoInterno+thisform.vTotales[mmpp,2]*Round(thisform.vTotales[mmpp,5]*thisform.vTotales[mmpp,3]/100,thisform.DecimalesPrecio)
				Else
					nMontoInterno=nMontoInterno+thisform.vTotales[mmpp,2]*Round(thisform.vTotales[mmpp,4]*thisform.vTotales[mmpp,3]/100,thisform.DecimalesPrecio)
				Endif	
			endif	
		EndFor
		nBoniEquivalente=thisform.PorcBoni1+thisform.PorcBoni2-thisform.PorcBoni1*thisform.PorcBoni2/100
		nMontoInterno=nMontoInterno-nMontoInterno*nBoniEquivalente/100
		
		return Round(nMontoInterno,2)
		
		*!*	Local nMontoInternos,mmpp
		*!*	nMontoInterno=0
		
		*!*	For mmpp=1 to alen(thisform.vTotales,1)
		
		*!*		if thisform.vTotales[mmpp,2]<>0
		*!*			*** Girolamo
		*!*			If thisform.oParametros.Leer("imp_int_costo") and thisform.vTotales[mmpp,4]>0
		*!*				nMontoInterno=nMontoInterno+thisform.vTotales[mmpp,2]*Round(thisform.vTotales[mmpp,5]*thisform.vTotales[mmpp,3]/100,thisform.DecimalesPrecio)
		*!*			Else
		*!*				nMontoInterno=nMontoInterno+thisform.vTotales[mmpp,2]*Round(thisform.vTotales[mmpp,4]*thisform.vTotales[mmpp,3]/100,thisform.DecimalesPrecio)
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*		endif	
		*!*	EndFor
		*!*	nBoniEquivalente=thisform.PorcBoni1 + thisform.PorcBoni2 - thisform.PorcBoni1 * thisform.PorcBoni2 /100
		*!*	nMontoInterno= nMontoInterno - nMontoInterno * nBoniEquivalente/100
		
		*!*	return Round(nMontoInterno,2)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calculariva
		Local i,nElementoEncontrado,mmpp,lLiqIva,nBonificacionEquivalente,nCantidad,nImporte
		** Alonso
		** GUSTAVO, TASAS DE IVA copiado desde el de tg_compventas
		
		nBonificacionEquivalente  = thisform.PorcBoni1+thisform.PorcBoni2-thisform.PorcBoni1*thisform.PorcBoni2/100
		
		lLiqIva= thisform.ovnt_Docu.Leer("Liq_Iva") and !thisform.oIvas.Leer("Exento")
		
		Dimension thisform.vIvas[1,4]
		
		thisform.vIvas[1,1]=""
		mmpp=1
		
		For i=1 to alen(thisform.vTotales,1)
		
			If 	alltrim(thisform.vTotales[i,10])<>""
				nElementoEncontrado=ascan(thisform.vIvas,thisform.vTotales[i,10])
				If nElementoEncontrado<>0
					nElementoEncontrado=ASUBSCRIPT(thisform.vIvas, nElementoEncontrado, 1)
				Endif	
				nCantidad=1
				if thisform.vTotales[i,2]<>0
					nCantidad=thisform.vTotales[i,2]
				Endif
		
				If nElementoEncontrado=0  && agrego un nuevo elemento en el vector
			
					If mmpp<>1
						Dimension thisform.vIvas[mmpp,4]
					Endif	
					thisform.vIvas[mmpp,1]=thisform.vTotales[i,10]   && Id alicuota de iva
					thisform.vIvas[mmpp,2]=thisform.vTotales[i,4]*nCantidad   && Base imponible sacarle la bonificacion una vez agrupados
					thisform.vIvas[mmpp,3]=thisform.vTotales[i,9]    && Porcentaje de iva
						
					mmpp=mmpp+1
				Else
					thisform.vIvas[nElementoEncontrado,2]=thisform.vIvas[nElementoEncontrado,2]+(thisform.vTotales[i,4]*nCantidad)    && Base imponible sacarle la bonificacion una vez agrupados
				Endif	
			Endif	
		EndFor
		
		if !empty(thisform.vIvas)
			For mmpp=1 to alen(thisform.vIVas,1)
				thisform.vIvas[mmpp,2]=thisform.vIvas[mmpp,2]-thisform.vIvas[mmpp,2]*nBonificacionEquivalente/100
				If lLiqIva
					thisform.vIvas[mmpp,4]=Round(thisform.vIvas[mmpp,2]*thisform.vIvas[mmpp,3]/100,2)   && Importe de Iva
				Else
					thisform.vIvas[mmpp,4]=0
				Endif	
			EndFor
		endif
		
		
		
		
		*!*	If thisform.Estado = TG_ALTACOMPROBANTE
		*!*		lIvaDiscriminado   = thisform.oIvas.Leer("Discriminado")
		*!*		lTipoIvaLiqInt     = thisform.oIvas.Leer("Liq_Int")
		*!*		lComprobanteLiqInt = thisform.ovnt_Docu.Leer("Liq_Int")
		*!*		
		*!*		** ALONSO, TASAS DE IVA, SE AGREGA EL TEMA DE LA CATEGORIA DE IVA EXENTO
		*!*		lLiqIva            = thisform.ovnt_Docu.Leer("Liq_Iva") and !thisform.oIvas.Leer("Exento")
		*!*		************************************************************************
		*!*		
		*!*	Else
		*!*		lIvaDiscriminado   = thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("IvaDiscriminado")
		*!*		lTipoIvaLiqInt     = (thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Imp_Int")<>0)
		*!*		lComprobanteLiqInt = (thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Imp_Int")<>0)
		*!*		
		*!*		lLiqIva            = thisform.oVnt_cabecera.Leer("Liq_Iva") 
		
		*!*	Endif
		
		
		*!*	if lIvaDiscriminado
		*!*		nRetorna = thisform.NetoBonificado
		*!*	else
		
		*!*		nRetorna = thisform.NetoBonificado	
		*!*		if lComprobanteLiqInt and lTipoIvaLiqInt
		*!*			nRetorna = nRetorna - thisform.MontoInternos
		*!*		Endif
		*!*		if lLiqIva
		*!*		     
		*!*		    ** Alonso Error 
		*!*			nRetorna = nRetorna/(1+(nPorcIva1)/100)	
		*!*		Endif	
		**endif
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularmontoiva
		Local nRetorna,lIvaDiscriminado,lComprobanteLiqInt,lTipoIvaLiqInt,lLiqIva,nPorcIva1,nPorcIva2,i
		
		** GUSTAVO, TASAS DE IVA copiado desde el de tg_compventas
		nRetorna = 0
		
		if !empty(thisform.vIvas)
			For i=1 to alen(thisform.vIvas,1)
			    nRetorna=nRetorna+thisform.vIvas [i,4]
			Endfor
		endif
		
		*=fMensAceptar ("Monto Iva= " + str(nRetorna,10,2))
		Return Round(nRetorna,2)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularneto
		local mmpp,nTotal
		
		
		** GUSTAVO codigo chequeado para tasas de iva checkeado
		
		nTotal=0
		
		for mmpp=1 to thisform.Renglones
			if thisform.vTotales[mmpp,2]<>0
				nTotal=nTotal+Round(thisform.vTotales[mmpp,1]*thisform.vTotales[mmpp,2],2)
			else
				nTotal=nTotal+Round(thisform.vTotales[mmpp,1],2)
			endif
		EndFor
		
		
		thisform.NetoBase = Round(nTotal,2)
		
		
		*!*	local mmpp,nTotal
		*!*	nTotal=0
		
		*!*	for mmpp=1 to thisform.Renglones
		*!*		if thisform.vTotales[mmpp,2]<>0
		*!*			nTotal=nTotal+Round(thisform.vTotales[mmpp,1]*thisform.vTotales[mmpp,2],2)
		*!*		else
		*!*			nTotal=nTotal+Round(thisform.vTotales[mmpp,1],2)
		*!*		endif
		*!*	EndFor
		
		
		*!*	thisform.NetoBase = Round(nTotal,2)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularnetoagravar
		Local nRetorna,lIvaDiscriminado,lComprobanteLiqInt,lTipoIvaLiqInt,lLiqIva,nPorcIva1,nPorcIva2,i
		&&GUSTAVO copiado tal cual tasas de iva CHEQUEADO
		nRetorna = 0
		
		if !empty(thisform.vIvas)
			For i=1 to alen(thisform.vIvas,1)
			   	nRetorna=nRetorna+thisform.vIvas [i,2]
			Endfor
		endif
		
		return Round(nRetorna,2)
		
		
		*!*	Local nRetorna,lIvaDiscriminado,lComprobanteLiqInt,lTipoIvaLiqInt,lLiqIva,nPorcIva1,nPorcIva2
		
		
		*!*	lIvaDiscriminado   = thisform.oIvas.Leer("Discriminado")
		*!*	lTipoIvaLiqInt     = thisform.oIvas.Leer("Liq_Int")
		*!*	lComprobanteLiqInt = thisform.ovnt_Docu.Leer("Liq_Int")
		*!*	lLiqIva            = thisform.ovnt_Docu.Leer("Liq_Iva") 
		*!*	nPorcIva1          = thisform.Porc_Iva1 &&thisform.oIvas.Leer("Porc1")
		*!*	nPorcIva2          = thisform.Porc_Iva2 &&thisform.oIvas.Leer("Porc2")
		
		
		*!*	if lIvaDiscriminado
		*!*		nRetorna = thisform.NetoBonificado
		*!*	else
		*!*		nRetorna = thisform.NetoBonificado	
		*!*		if lComprobanteLiqInt and lTipoIvaLiqInt
		*!*			nRetorna = nRetorna - thisform.MontoInternos
		*!*		Endif
		*!*		if lLiqIva
		*!*			nRetorna = nRetorna/(1+(nPorcIva1)/100)	
		*!*		Endif	
		*!*	endif
		
		*!*	return Round(nRetorna,2)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularprecioaimprimir
		lParameters nPrecio,nPorcImpuestoInterno,nCosto, cId_Articulo, nPorcIvaConsulta
		&& GUSTAVO copie metodo de tasas de ivA CHECKEADO
		
		** ALONSO, TASA DE IVA, NUEVO PARAMETRO "cId_Articulo", para sacar el IVA respectivo.
		** ALONSO, TASA DE IVA, NUEVO PARAMETRO "nPorcIvaConsulta", en caso de ser una consulta tomo este porcentaje.
		
		Local nPrecioSinImpuestos,nPrecioAImprimir,nPorcIvaAux,nPorcIntAux
		Local lListaIvaIncluido,lListaIntIncluido,lIvaDiscriminado,nPorcIvaIncluido,lLiqIva
		Local lTipoIvaLiqInt,lComprobanteLiqInt,nPorcIva1, vAuxiliar
		local nPorcIvaArticulo
		
		* ALONSO TASAS DE IVA, NUEVO  nPorcIvaArticulo, me indica el Porcentaje de Iva del Artículo, en caso
		* de ser un ALTA DE COMPROBANTE, lo traigo del maestro de Articulos, y si es una consulta de comprobantes
		* lo leo de Vnt_Detalle. ********************************************************************************
		nPorcIvaArticulo = thisform.oCstVentas.CalcularTasaIvaArticulo(cId_Articulo)
		**********************************************************************************************************
		
		Dimension vAuxiliar[1]
			
		nPorcIvaAux=0
		nPorcIntAux=0
		** El objetivo de este metodo es dado un precio calcular el valor a imprimir
		** De acuerdo a la moneda del precio, moneda de impresion, si el iva y los internos
		** estan discriminados o no y si el comprobante liquida iva y/o internos o no
		** El precio que nos llega como parametro es el precio con las caracteristicas
		** de la lista de precios usada (moneda,iva incluido, internos incluidos)
		
		**thisform.ovnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.Comprobante,.f.,"clave")
		thisform.oIvas.Buscar(thisform.id_iva,.f.,"Clave")
		= aCopy (thisform.vCotizaciones, vAuxiliar)
		
		**Remeado por Gustavo, ya que no se hace el setup de oPrecioVisualizacion y esta cuenta da mal
		**nPrecioAImprimir = Round(thisform.oPrecioVisualizacion.Convertir(nPrecio,Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("id_monedaImpresion"),, thisform.Fecha, @vAuxiliar),thisform.DecimalesPrecio)
		
		nPrecioAImprimir = Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.Convertir(nPrecio,thisform.oVnt_Docu.leer("Id_MonedaVisualizacion"),0,thisform.oVnt_Docu.leer("Id_MonedaImpresion"),0,thisform.Fecha, @vAuxiliar),thisform.DecimalesPrecio)
		
		
		lListaIvaIncluido=thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Iva_Incluido")
		lListaIntIncluido=thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Int_Incluido")
		lIvaDiscriminado=thisform.oIvas.Leer("Discriminado")
			
		nPorcIvaIncluido = nPorcIvaArticulo
		
			** ALONSO, TASAS DE IVA, SE AGREGA LO DE EXENTO PARA DEFINIR SI EL COMPROBANTE LIQUIDA IVA O NO.
		lLiqIva=thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Liq_Iva") and !thisform.oIvas.leer("exento")
			***********************************************************************************************.
			
		lTipoIvaLiqInt=thisform.oIvas.Leer("Liq_Int")
		lComprobanteLiqInt=thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Liq_Int")
			
		
		do case 
			case lListaIvaIncluido.and.lListaIntIncluido
				if lIvaDiscriminado && si descrimina debo sacar los impuestos ya sea que el comprobante liquide iva e internos o no.
				 	If thisform.oParametros.Leer("imp_int_costo") and nPrecioAImprimir>0
						nPrecioAImprimir=(nPrecioAImprimir-(nPorcImpuestoInterno*nCosto/100))/(1+(nPorcIvaIncluido)/100)
				 	Else
						nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioAImprimir/(1+(nPorcImpuestoInterno+nPorcIvaIncluido)/100)
					Endif	
				Else
				 	If thisform.oParametros.Leer("imp_int_costo") and nPrecioAImprimir>0
						nPrecioSinImpuestos=(nPrecioAImprimir-(nPorcImpuestoInterno*nCosto/100))/(1+(nPorcIvaIncluido)/100)
				 	Else
						nPrecioSinImpuestos=nPrecioAImprimir/(1+(nPorcImpuestoInterno+nPorcIvaIncluido)/100)
					Endif	
				
					If !lLiqIva .or. !lComprobanteLiqInt or !lTipoIvaLiqInt				
						IF lComprobanteLiqInt and lTipoIvaLiqInt
							nPorcIntAux=nPorcImpuestoInterno
						Endif
						IF lLiqIva
							** ALONSO, TASAS DE IVA, SE QUITA nPorcIva1 y se deja nPorcIvaIncluido **
						 	nPorcIvaAux=nPorcIvaIncluido
						 	*************************************************************************
						Endif 	
					 	If thisform.oParametros.Leer("imp_int_costo") and nPrecioSinImpuestos>0
							nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioSinImpuestos+nPorcIntAux*nCosto/100+nPorcIvaAux*nPrecioSinImpuestos/100
					 	Else
							nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioSinImpuestos*(1+(nPorcIvaAux+nPorcIntAux)/100)				
						Endif	
					Endif
				endif
				
			case lListaIvaIncluido.and.!lListaIntIncluido
				if lIvaDiscriminado .or. !lLiqIva
					nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioAImprimir/(1+nPorcIvaIncluido/100)
				else	
					nPrecioSinImpuestos=nPrecioAImprimir/(1+nPorcIvaIncluido/100)
				 	If thisform.oParametros.Leer("imp_int_costo") and nPrecioSinImpuestos>0			
						nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioSinImpuestos+nPrecioSinImpuestos*nPorcIvaIncluido/100+nCosto*nPorcImpuestoInterno/100
				 	Else
						nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioSinImpuestos*(1+(nPorcImpuestoInterno+nPorcIvaIncluido)/100)
					Endif	
				endif
		
			case !lListaIvaIncluido.and.lListaIntIncluido
				if lIvaDiscriminado .or. !lComprobanteLiqInt or !lTipoIvaLiqInt
				 	If thisform.oParametros.Leer("imp_int_costo") and nPrecioAImprimir>0					
						nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioAImprimir-nCosto*nPorcImpuestoInterno/100
				 	Else
						nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioAImprimir/(1+nPorcImpuestoInterno/100)
					Endif	
				else	
				 	If thisform.oParametros.Leer("imp_int_costo")	and nPrecioAImprimir>0						
						nPrecioSinImpuestos=nPrecioAImprimir-nCosto*nPorcImpuestoInterno/100
		
						** ALONSO, TASAS DE IVA, SE REMEA ESTA LINEA, NO SE TRABAJA CON nPORCIVA1, SINO CON nPorcIvaIncluido
						*nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioSinImpuestos+nPrecioSinImpuestos*nPorcIva1/100+nCosto*nPorcImpuestoInterno/100
						nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioSinImpuestos+nPrecioSinImpuestos*nPorcIvaIncluido/100+nCosto*nPorcImpuestoInterno/100
						***************************************************************************************************
						
				 	Else
						nPrecioSinImpuestos=nPrecioAImprimir/(1+nPorcImpuestoInterno/100)
		
						** ALONSO, TASAS DE IVA, SE REMEA ESTA LINEA, NO SE TRABAJA CON nPORCIVA1, SINO CON nPorcIvaIncluido
						*nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioSinImpuestos*(1+(nPorcImpuestoInterno+nPorcIva1)/100)
						nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioSinImpuestos*(1+(nPorcImpuestoInterno+nPorcIvaIncluido)/100)
						****************************************************************************************************
					Endif	
				endif
				
			case !lListaIvaIncluido.and.!lListaIntIncluido
				if !lIvaDiscriminado
					IF lComprobanteLiqInt and lTipoIvaLiqInt
						nPorcIntAux=nPorcImpuestoInterno
					Endif
					IF lLiqIva
						** ALONSO, TASAS DE IVA, SE QUITA nPorcIva1 y se deja nPorcIvaIncluido **
					 	nPorcIvaAux=nPorcIvaIncluido
					 	*************************************************************************
					Endif
				 	If thisform.oParametros.Leer("imp_int_costo")	and nPrecioAImprimir>0						
						nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioAImprimir+nPrecioAImprimir*nPorcIvaAux/100+nCosto*nPorcIntAux/100
				 	Else
						nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioAImprimir*(1+(nPorcIvaAux+nPorcIntAux)/100)
					Endif	
				endif
				
		endCase
		
		
		return Round(nPrecioAImprimir,thisform.DecimalesPrecio)
		
		*!*	lParameters nPrecio,nPorcImpuestoInterno,nCosto
		*!*	Local nPrecioSinImpuestos,nPrecioAImprimir,nPorcIvaAux,nPorcIntAux
		*!*	Local lListaIvaIncluido,lListaIntIncluido,lIvaDiscriminado,nPorcIvaIncluido,lLiqIva
		*!*	Local lTipoIvaLiqInt,lComprobanteLiqInt,nPorcIva1, vAuxiliar
		*!*	Dimension vAuxiliar[1]
		*!*		
		*!*	nPorcIvaAux=0
		*!*	nPorcIntAux=0
		*!*	** El objetivo de este metodo es dado un precio calcular el valor a imprimir
		*!*	** De acuerdo a la moneda del precio, moneda de impresion, si el iva y los internos
		*!*	** estan discriminados o no y si el comprobante liquida iva y/o internos o no
		*!*	** El precio que nos llega como parametro es el precio con las caracteristicas
		*!*	** de la lista de precios usada (moneda,iva incluido, internos incluidos)
		
		*!*	thisform.oIvas.Buscar(thisform.id_iva,.f.,"Clave")
		
		
		*!*	** Edgardo
		
		*!*	= aCopy (thisform.vCotizaciones, vAuxiliar)
		*!*	*nPrecioAImprimir = Round(thisform.oPrecioVisualizacion.Convertir(nPrecio,Thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("id_monedaImpresion"),, thisform.Fecha, @vAuxiliar),thisform.DecimalesPrecio)
		*!*	nPrecioAImprimir = Round(thisform.oConvMonUniversal.Convertir(nPrecio,thisform.oVnt_Docu.leer("Id_MonedaVisualizacion"),0,thisform.oVnt_Docu.leer("Id_MonedaImpresion"),0,thisform.Fecha, @vAuxiliar),thisform.DecimalesPrecio)

		*!*	lListaIvaIncluido=thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Iva_Incluido")
		*!*	lListaIntIncluido=thisform.oListaPrecios.Leer("Int_Incluido")
		*!*	lIvaDiscriminado=thisform.oIvas.Leer("Discriminado")

		*!*		nPorcIvaIncluido=thisform.Porc_Iva1
		*!*	Else
		*!*		nPorcIvaIncluido=thisform.oParametros.Leer("Tasa_Iva_Listas") && Mod iva
		*!*	Endif
		*!*	*Martin	
		*!*	lLiqIva=thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Liq_Iva")
		*!*	lTipoIvaLiqInt=thisform.oIvas.Leer("Liq_Int")
		*!*	lComprobanteLiqInt=thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Liq_Int")
		*!*	nPorcIva1=thisform.Porc_Iva1 &&thisform.oIvas.Leer("Porc1")
		
		*!*	do case 
		
		
		*!*		case lListaIvaIncluido.and.lListaIntIncluido
		*!*			if lIvaDiscriminado && si descrimina debo sacar los impuestos ya sea que el comprobante liquide iva e internos o no.
		*!*			 	If thisform.oParametros.Leer("imp_int_costo") and nPrecioAImprimir>0
		*!*					nPrecioAImprimir=(nPrecioAImprimir-(nPorcImpuestoInterno*nCosto/100))/(1+(nPorcIvaIncluido)/100)
		*!*			 	Else
		*!*					nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioAImprimir/(1+(nPorcImpuestoInterno+nPorcIvaIncluido)/100)
		*!*				Endif	
		*!*			Else
		*!*			 	If thisform.oParametros.Leer("imp_int_costo") and nPrecioAImprimir>0
		*!*					nPrecioSinImpuestos=(nPrecioAImprimir-(nPorcImpuestoInterno*nCosto/100))/(1+(nPorcIvaIncluido)/100)
		*!*			 	Else
		*!*					nPrecioSinImpuestos=nPrecioAImprimir/(1+(nPorcImpuestoInterno+nPorcIvaIncluido)/100)
		*!*				Endif

		*!*					Endif

		*!*					Endif

		*!*						nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioSinImpuestos+nPorcIntAux*nCosto/100+nPorcIvaAux*nPrecioSinImpuestos/100
		*!*				 	Else
		*!*						nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioSinImpuestos*(1+(nPorcIvaAux+nPorcIntAux)/100)				
		*!*					Endif	
		*!*				Endif
		*!*			endif

		*!*				nPrecioAImprimir=nPrecioAImprimir/(1+nPorcIvaIncluido/100)
