	PROCEDURE grabarasignaciones
		Local cClave, vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		* recorro la tabla de la grilla y busco en la real para saber si se modifico algo y recalcular
		* en el formulario principal
		
		thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.IrPrimero()
		
		do while !thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.EsEof()
		   cClave = thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+;
		            thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Id_Sistema")+;    
		            thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Id_Comproba")+;
		            str(thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("nro_referencia"),10)+; 
		            thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Renglon")
		            
		   if thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Buscar(cClave,.f.,"Clave")
		      if thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Leer("CantFija") <> thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("CantFija") ;
		         or thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Leer("fijado") <> thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("fijado")
		         
		         =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CantFija"           , thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("CantFija"))
		         =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CantFijaAnt"        , thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("CantFija"))
		         =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Fijado"             , thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Fijado"))
		         =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "modificado"         , .t.)        		        		
		         thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .f., .t.)
		      endif
		   endif
		   
		   thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.IrSiguiente() 
		
		enddo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lparameters cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_comproba,nNro_referencia,dFecha,nTotaldeuda,nPendiente,cId_cliente,cNombrecliente,dVencimiento,cNombrePrioridad,oTablaPiqueo,cid_deposito
		local vGrabacion,cNombrecomprobante,cMascaraDatos,cNombreDeposito
		
		dodefault()
		
		Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		** Gustavo
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblPiqueoauxiliar","tg_tabla","aux_Pendientespiqueo","clave")
		thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.SetearProp ("BOT")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblDepositos","tg_tabla","Depositos","clave")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_docuPiqueo","tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu","clave")
		thisform.oTblVnt_docuPiqueo.Buscar(cId_comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		cNombrecomprobante = thisform.oTblVnt_docuPiqueo.Leer("nombre")
		
		** Gustavo
		If  thisform.oTblVnt_docuPiqueo.Leer("enteros_cantidad")<>0
			cMascaraDatos = replicate("9",thisform.oTblVnt_docuPiqueo.Leer("enteros_cantidad"))+"."+replicate("9",thisform.oTblVnt_docuPiqueo.Leer("decimales_cantidad"))
		Else
			cMascaraDatos = replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("enteros_cantidad"))+"."+replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("decimales_cantidad"))
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oTablaPiqueo = oTablaPiqueo
		
		
		
		thisform.oTblDepositos.Buscar(cId_deposito)
		cNombreDeposito=thisform.oTblDepositos.Leer("Nombre")
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_label1.caption = thisform.tg_label1.caption + "    " + cNombrecomprobante
		thisform.tg_label2.caption = thisform.tg_label2.caption + "    " + str(nNro_referencia,10)
		thisform.tg_label3.caption = thisform.tg_label3.caption + "    " + DTOC(dFecha)
		thisform.tg_label4.caption = thisform.tg_label4.caption + "    " + DTOC(dVencimiento)
		thisform.tg_label5.caption = thisform.tg_label5.caption + "    " + cNombrecliente
		thisform.tg_label6.caption = thisform.tg_label6.caption + "    " + str(ntotaldeuda,12,2)
		thisform.tg_label7.caption = thisform.tg_label7.caption + "    " + str(nPendiente,12,2)
		thisform.tg_label8.caption = thisform.tg_label8.caption + "    " + cNombrePrioridad
		thisform.tg_label9.caption = thisform.tg_label9.caption + "    " + cNombreDeposito
		
		
		
		thisform.oTablaPiqueo.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Buscar(cId_sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_comproba+Str(nNro_referencia,10)+SPACE(8),.t.,"Clave")
		
		   do while !thisform.oTablaPiqueo.EsEof() and Thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Leer("Id_Sucursal") = cId_Sucursal ;
		                                           and Thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Leer("Id_Sistema") = cId_Sistema ;
		                                           and Thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Leer("Id_Comproba") = cId_Comproba ;
		                                           and Thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Leer("nro_referencia") = nNro_referencia
		                                           
		      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Sucursal"        , cId_Sucursal )
		      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Sistema"         , cId_Sistema )
		      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Comproba"        , cId_Comproba )
		      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nro_Referencia"     , nNro_Referencia )
		      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo"        , thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
		      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Detalle"            , thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Leer("Detalle"))      
		      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cant_original"      , thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Leer("Cant_original"))      
		      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cantidad"           , thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Leer("Cantidad"))
		      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CantFija"           , thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Leer("CantFija"))
		      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Fijado"             , thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Leer("Fijado"))
		      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Stock"              , thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Leer("Stock"))
		      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Renglon"            , thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Leer("Renglon"))
		      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CantFijaAnt"        , thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Leer("CantFijaAnt"))
		      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "StockRemanente"     , thisform.oTablaPiqueo.Leer("StockRemanente"))
		                  		        		
		      thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabacion, .t.)
		                                           
		      thisform.oTablaPiqueo.IrSiguiente()                                     
		   enddo
		                                               
		
		
		thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.IrPrimero()
		
		*thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.ReadOnly= .f.
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		*thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarDetallepiqueo.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.text1.inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.text1.inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.text1.inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.text1.inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.text1.inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.enabled = .f.
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".Id_articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".Detalle"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".Cant_Original"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".Cantidad"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".Cantfija"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".fijado"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".Stock"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".StockRemanente"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarasignacionarticulo
		
		
		Thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmComPiqueoArticulo","Tg_ComPiqueoComprobantearticulo",;
			                          thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Id_articulo"),;
			                          thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Detalle"),;	                          
			                          Thisform.oTablaPiqueo,thisform.oTblDepositos.Leer("Id_Deposito"))				
		
		thisform.oFrmComPiqueoArticulo.Show()
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdAsignaTodo.Click
		Local vGrabacion(1,2)
		
		thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.IrPrimero
		Do While !thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.EsEof()
		
			=FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CantFija"           , Min(thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Cantidad"),thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Stock")))
			=FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CantFijaAnt"        , Min(thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Cantidad"),thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Stock")))
			thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .f., .t.)
			
			
			
			thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.IrSiguiente
		enddo
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdDesasignaTodo.Click
		Local vGrabacion(1,2)
		
		thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.IrPrimero
		Do While !thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.EsEof()
		
			=FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CantFija"           , 0)
			=FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CantFijaAnt"        , 0)
			thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .f., .t.)
			
			
			
			thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.IrSiguiente
		enddo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdFijaTodo.Click
		Local vGrabacion(1,2)
		
		thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.IrPrimero
		Do While !thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.EsEof()
		
			=FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Fijado"           , .t.)
			thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .f., .t.)
			
			
			
			thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.IrSiguiente
		enddo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdLiberaTodo.Click
		Local vGrabacion(1,2)
		
		thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.IrPrimero
		Do While !thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.EsEof()
		
			=FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Fijado"           , .f.)
			thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .f., .t.)
			
			
			
			thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.IrSiguiente
		enddo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar1.Click
		Local nReg,lValida
		nReg=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Recno()
		
		
		
		lValida=.t.
		thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.IrPrimero
		Do While !thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.EsEof() and lValida
			If 	thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("CantFija")>thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Cantidad") or thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("CantFija")>thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Stock")
			     lValida=.f.
			     =fMensAceptar("La cantidad indicada en el articulo "+alltrim(thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Id_Articulo"))+" excede el stock o la cantidad pendiente del renglon")
			Endif
			thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.IrSiguiente
		enddo	
		
		
		If lValida
			thisform.Grabarasignaciones
			thisform.Release
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar2.Click
		
		thisform.Release
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column5.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.mostrarasignacionarticulo
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column5.Text1.Valid
		
		if thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.text1.value <= thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Cantidad") and thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.text1.value <= thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Stock")
		   if thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.text1.value <> thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("CantFijaAnt")
		      thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.tg_CheckBox1.value = .t.
		   *else   
		   *   thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.tg_CheckBox1.value = .f.
		   endif   
		   return (.t.)
		else
		   return (.f.)
		endif      
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column9.Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local oPanelControlArticulo
		
		
		
		Thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmPanelControlArticulo","tg_paneldecontrolarticulos",thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
		thisform.oFrmPanelControlArticulo.WindowType=1	                          
		
		thisform.oFrmPanelControlArticulo.Show()
		
		thisform.oFrmPanelControlArticulo=" "
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE grabarasignaciones
		Local cClave, vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		* recorro la tabla de la grilla y busco en la real para saber si se modifico algo y recalcular
		* en el formulario principal
		
		thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.IrPrimero()
		
		do while !thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.EsEof()
		   cClave = thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+;
		            thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Id_Sistema")+;    
		            thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Id_Comproba")+;
		            str(thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("nro_referencia"),10)+; 
		            thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Renglon")
		            
		   if thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Buscar(cClave,.f.,"Clave")
		      if thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("CantFija") <> thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("CantFija") ;
		         or thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("fijado") <> thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("fijado")
		         
		         =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CantFija"           , thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("CantFija"))
		         =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CantFijaAnt"        , thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("CantFija"))
		         =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Fijado"             , thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Fijado"))
		         =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "modificado"         , .t.)        		        		
		         thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .f., .t.)
		      endif
		   endif
		   
		   thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.IrSiguiente() 
		
		enddo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lparameters cId_Articulo,cDetalle,oTablaPiqueoArticulo,cId_Deposito
		local vGrabacion,cNombrecomprobante,cMascaraDatos
		
		dodefault()
		
		Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		** Gustavo
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblPiqueoauxiliar","tg_tabla","aux_Pendientespiqueo","ID_ARTICUL")
		thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.SetearProp ("BOT")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_docuPiqueo","tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu","clave")
		
		*cMascaraDatos = replicate("9",thisform.oTblVnt_docuPiqueo.Leer("enteros_cantidad"))+"."+replicate("9",thisform.oTblVnt_docuPiqueo.Leer("decimales_cantidad"))
		
		thisform.tg_label1.caption = thisform.tg_label1.caption + "  (" + alltrim(cId_Articulo) + ")  "+ cDetalle
		
		thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo = oTablaPiqueoArticulo
		
		thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.fijartag("ID_ARTICUL")
		
		thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Buscar(cId_Articulo + space(10),.T.,"ID_ARTICUL")
		
		Thisform.oTblVnt_docuPiqueo.Buscar(thisform.oTablaPiqueoarticulo.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
		** Gustavo
		If  thisform.oTblVnt_docuPiqueo.Leer("enteros_cantidad")<>0
			cMascaraDatos = replicate("9",thisform.oTblVnt_docuPiqueo.Leer("enteros_cantidad"))+"."+replicate("9",thisform.oTblVnt_docuPiqueo.Leer("decimales_cantidad"))
		Else
			cMascaraDatos = replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("enteros_cantidad"))+"."+replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("decimales_cantidad"))
		Endif	
		
		   do while !thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.EsEof() and Thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("Id_Articulo") = cId_Articulo
		   
		      If Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("piqueapordeposito") and cId_Deposito=thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("Id_DepositoPiqueo")  or !Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("piqueapordeposito")
		                                           
			      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Sucursal"        , thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("Id_Sucursal"))
			      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Sistema"         , thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("Id_Sistema"))
			      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Comproba"        , thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("Id_Comproba"))
			      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nro_Referencia"     , thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("Nro_Referencia"))
			      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Numero"             , thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("Numero"))
			      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Articulo"        , thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
			      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Detalle"            , thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("Detalle"))      
			      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cant_original"      , thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("Cant_original"))      
			      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Cantidad"           , thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("Cantidad"))
			      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CantFija"           , thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("CantFija"))
			      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Fijado"             , thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("Fijado"))
			      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Stock"              , thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("Stock"))
			      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Renglon"            , thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("Renglon"))
			      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "CantFijaAnt"        , thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("CantFijaAnt"))
			      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Cliente"         , thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("Id_Cliente"))
			      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Nombre"             , thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("Nombre"))
			      =FGrabar(@vGrabacion, "NumPrioridad"       , thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.Leer("NumPrioridad"))
			                       		        		
			      thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.AgregaryModificar(@vGrabacion, .t.)
		      Endif                                     
		      thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.IrSiguiente()                                     
		   enddo
		
		thisform.oTablaPiqueoArticulo.fijartag("Clave")
		                                               
		thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.IrPrimero()
		
		*thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.ReadOnly= .f.
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		*thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComADescargarDetallepiqueo.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.text1.inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.text1.inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.text1.inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.text1.inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.enabled = .f.
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.enabled = .f.
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".Id_Sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".Cant_original"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".Cantidad"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".Cantfija"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".fijado"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".Stock"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".nro_referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".numero"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".Id_Cliente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Alias+".Nombre"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar1.Click
		thisform.Grabarasignaciones
		thisform.Release
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column5.Text1.Valid
		
		if thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.text1.value <= thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Cantidad") and thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.text1.value <= thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("Stock")
		   if thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.text1.value <> thisform.oTblPiqueoauxiliar.Leer("CantFijaAnt")
		      thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.tg_CheckBox1.value = .t.
		   *else   
		   *   thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.tg_CheckBox1.value = .f.
		   endif   
		   return (.t.)
		else
		   return (.f.)
		endif      
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE ejecutar
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Refrescar(ThisForm.Tg_proyectos1.Value,ThisForm.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value)
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		Local cCond1
		
		DoDefault()
		
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblProyectos","Tg_Tabla","Proyectos","clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewAnalisisProyecto","Tg_ViewAnalisisProyecto")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblAfectProyectos","Tg_Tabla","AfectProyectos","Columna")
		
		
		For mmpp=4 to thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount
		
			cCond1  = "iif(Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Leer('Cant" +Alltrim(Str(mmpp-4))  + "') < 0,rgb(255,0,0),rgb(0,0,0))"
			thisform.Tg_grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicForeColor= cCond1
				
		EndFor
		
		Thisform.PonerTitulos()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarafectacion
		LParameters cId_Proyecto,cId_ConcProy,nImporte,nColumna
		
		
		If nImporte <> 0
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsulta")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsulta","tg_ConsMovimientosProyectos",cId_Proyecto,cId_ConcProy,nImporte,nColumna,.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsulta.EjecutarConsulta(cId_Proyecto,cId_ConcProy,nImporte,nColumna)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsulta.Show()	
			
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ponerproyecto
		lParameters cId_Proyecto
		
		If Thisform.oTblProyectos.Buscar(cId_Proyecto,.f.,"Clave")
			ThisForm.oLblNombreProyecto.Caption=Thisform.oTblProyectos.Leer("Nombre")
			ThisForm.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value=Thisform.oTblProyectos.Leer("Id_Moneda")
			ThisForm.oTbxFecha_Ini.Value=Thisform.oTblProyectos.Leer("Fecha_Ini")
			ThisForm.oTbxFecha_Est.Value=Thisform.oTblProyectos.Leer("Fecha_Est")
			ThisForm.oTbxFecha_Fin.Value=Thisform.oTblProyectos.Leer("Fecha_Fin")
			Thisform.Ejecutar()
		else
			ThisForm.oLblNombreProyecto.Caption=""
			ThisForm.oTbxFecha_Ini.Value=Ctod(Space(8))
			ThisForm.oTbxFecha_Est.Value=Ctod(Space(8))
			ThisForm.oTbxFecha_Fin.Value=Ctod(Space(8))
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=.f.
			If !Empty(cId_proyecto)
				=fMensAceptar("Proyecto inexistente!")	
			Endif	
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		Endif
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ponertitulos
		Local cColumna
		
		Thisform.oTblAfectProyectos.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not Thisform.oTblAfectProyectos.EsEof()
			cColumna ="ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column" + AllTrim(Str(Thisform.oTblAfectProyectos.Leer("Columna") +4 )) + ".Header1.Caption='"+ Alltrim(Thisform.oTblAfectProyectos.Leer("Nombre")) + "'"
			
			&cColumna
			Thisform.oTblAfectProyectos.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		Thisform.oTblAfectProyectos.IrPrimero()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Thisform.LockScreen=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".NomConcepto"
		If ThisForm.OpcionVista.Value=1
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.Header1.Caption="Cant. Pres."
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".CantPresu"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.Header1.Caption="Cant. Real"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".CantReal"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Cant0"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Cant1"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Cant2"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Cant3"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Cant4"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Cant5"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Cant6"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Cant7"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column12.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Cant8"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column13.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Cant9"
		Else
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.Header1.Caption="Imp. Pres."
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".ImpPresu"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.Header1.Caption="Imp. Real"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".ImpReal"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Imp0"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Imp1"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Imp2"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Imp3"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Imp4"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Imp5"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Imp6"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Imp7"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column12.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Imp8"
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column13.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.Alias + ".Imp9"
		Endif	
		
		Thisform.oViewAnalisisProyecto.IrPrimero()
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh()
		Thisform.LockScreen=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutar.Click
		thisform.Ejecutar
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE OpcionVista.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.LockScreen=.t.
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		Thisform.LockScreen=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantes","Tg_ViewComprobantes")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu","tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oVnt_Cabecera","tg_tabla","Vnt_Cabecera","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oCamiones","tg_tabla","Camiones","Clave")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oDetalle","tg_tabla","Detalle","Id_Articul")
		thisform.oDetalle.setearProp("BOT")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		*!*	ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.DesHabilitar()
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbCamiones1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbCamiones1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde     = Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta     = Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		
		thisform.OldId_moneda      = thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal    = thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Camion      = thisform.Tg_CmbCamiones1.Value
		
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion = thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		*thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal,cId_vendedor,lAnulado, cId_EstadoComproba, vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		Thisform.oDetalle.Revertir()
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal=""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		Endif
		
		cId_Vendedor=""
		cId_EstadoComproba = ""
		lAnulado=.f.
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",cId_Sucursal,cId_vendedor,;
											 ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,;
											 ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),lAnulado,;
											 ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),;
											 ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,;
											 .f.,cId_EstadoComproba)
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		do While !thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
		   cClave = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema")+thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba")+Str(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)
		   Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(cClave,.f.,"Clave")
		   if thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Camion")=Thisform.Tg_CmbCamiones1.Value or Thisform.Tg_CmbCamiones1.Value="TD"
		  	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_articulo"   ,Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Externo"))
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Detalle"       ,thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nombre"))
		       =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Vencimiento"   ,thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha"))	
		  	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total"         ,Thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Total"))
		       Thisform.oDetalle.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		   endif   
		   thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
											 
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oDetalle.Alias
		
		Thisform.oDetalle.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oDetalle.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oDetalle.Alias+".Vencimiento"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oDetalle.Alias+".Detalle"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oDetalle.Alias+".Id_articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oDetalle.Alias+".Total"
		
		
		*!*	thisform.oCmdDetalle.Enabled=!thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsTablaVacia()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oDetalle.Sumar("Total",".t."),2)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		this.Enabled=.f.
		thisform.tg_CommandButton1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		Dimension this.vTitulos [1,2]
		
		Thisform.oCamiones.Buscar(Thisform.Tg_CmbCamiones1.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		
		this.vTitulos[1,1] = "Camion "
		this.vTitulos[1,2] = Thisform.Tg_CmbCamiones1.Value+"  "+iif(Thisform.Tg_CmbCamiones1.Value="TD","Todos",Thisform.oCamiones.Leer("Nombre")) 
		
		DoDefault()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcamiones1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Sucursal
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Camion=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbsucursales1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Sucursal
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Thisform.oDetalle.Borrar()
		Thisform.oDetalle.IrPrimero()
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_articulo"   ,space(15))
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Detalle"       ,space(50))
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Vencimiento"   ,ctod("  /  /  "))	
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Total"         ,0)
		Thisform.oDetalle.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		Thisform.tg_grid1.setfocus()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton3.Click
		Thisform.oDetalle.IrPrimero()
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
				ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Init
		dodefault(".t.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE generooc
		Local vGrabacion, vAuxiliar,nTotal
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		Dimension vAuxiliar[1]
		local cid_articulo
		************* ordenar por articulos *********************
		************ Diego
		thisform.odetalle.IrPrimero
		Do While Not thisform.odetalle.EsEof()
		 thisform.odetalle.Borrar
		 thisform.odetalle.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		 
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
		   If thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("imprime")
		   
		  	   thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema")+thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("id_comproba")+str(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("nro_referencia"),10))
		    	Do while !thisform.oVnt_Detalle.EsEof().and.Thisform.oVnt_detalle.EsClaveIgual()
		    	   cid_articulo = thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("id_articulo")
		    	   if !thisform.odetalle.Localizar("id_articulo='"+cid_Articulo+"'")
			    	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_articulo"			,thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("id_articulo"))
			    	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"precio"			,thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("preciovisu"))
			    	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"cantidad"			,   thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("cantidad"))
			    	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"precioneto"		,  round(thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("preciovisu") * thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("cantidad")* thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("porc_iva") / 100,2) )
			    	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"preciolista"			,  thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("cantidad") *  thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("imp_impint_uni"))
			    	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"detalle"			,   thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("detalle"))
		
			           thisform.odetalle.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
			       else
			             =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"preciolista"			,  ( thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("imp_impint_uni") * thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("cantidad") )  + thisform.odetalle.Leer("preciolista"))
			             =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"precioneto"			,  ( round(thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("preciovisu") * thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("cantidad")* thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("porc_iva") / 100,2) + thisform.odetalle.Leer("precioneto")) )
				         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"cantidad"			,thisform.odetalle.Leer("cantidad")+thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Leer("cantidad"))    
		 		     	thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			       endif    
		           thisform.oVnt_Detalle.IrSiguiente()
		        enddo   
		          
		     
		   Endif
		 	thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EnDDo
		
		thisform.odetalle.seleccionar()
		
		thisform.odetalle.IrPrimero
		Do While Not thisform.odetalle.EsEof()
		   	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"totalimpresion"	,   (thisform.oDetalle.Leer("precioneto") + thisform.oDetalle.Leer("preciolista") +  (thisform.oDetalle.Leer("precio")* thisform.oDetalle.Leer("cantidad")) )  )
		   	   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"costo"	,    thisform.oDetalle.Leer("precio")* thisform.oDetalle.Leer("cantidad"))
		    	thisform.oDetalle.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		
			 thisform.odetalle.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
		
		thisform.odetalle.IrPrimero
		thisform.tg_grid2.visible = .t.
		thisform.tg_grid2.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid2.RecordSource=thisform.odetalle.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid2.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.odetalle.Alias+".Id_articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid2.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.odetalle.Alias+".detalle"
		thisform.tg_grid2.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.odetalle.Alias+".Cantidad"
		thisform.tg_grid2.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.odetalle.Alias+".Precio"
		thisform.tg_grid2.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.odetalle.Alias+".Precioneto"
		thisform.tg_grid2.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.odetalle.Alias+".preciolista"
		thisform.tg_grid2.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.odetalle.Alias+".totalimpresion"
		thisform.tg_grid2.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.odetalle.Alias+".costo"
		***thisform.tg_grid2.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.odetalle.Alias+".internos" + thisform.odetalle.Alias+".precioneto" + thisform.odetalle.Alias+".precio"
		thisform.tg_grid2.Refresh
		
		
		*** thisform.oVnt_Detalle.Buscar(thisform.Id_Sucursal+thisform.Id_Sistema+thisform.Comprobante.Value+str(thisform.Referencia.Value,10))
		*********************************************************
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimir
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias
		
		Local lSoloPendientesRomaneo, nOpcionImpresion, nCantCopiasRomaneo
		
		if type ("thisform.oImpresionRomaneo") = T_OBJECT
			lSoloPendientesRomaneo 	= thisform.oImpresionRomaneo.oChkPendRomaneo.Value
			nOpcionImpresion 		= thisform.oImpresionRomaneo.oOpgOpcion.Value
			nCantCopiasRomaneo 		= thisform.oImpresionRomaneo.Tg_Spinner1.Value
		endif
		
		If nCopias>0 
			thisform.ImprimirComprobante(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias,,lSoloPendientesRomaneo, nOpcionImpresion, nCantCopiasRomaneo)
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimirlotes
		Local vDatos[1,2],nCopias
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			If  thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Imprime")
				
				Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
				
				if !thisform.oChkAsignaCopias.Value
					nCopias = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Copias")
				else
					nCopias = Thisform.Tg_Spinner1.Value
				endif
				
				If nCopias=0
					nCopias = 1
				Endif
				Thisform.Imprimir(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),nCopias )	
			Endif
				
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
	ENDPROC

		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias

		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		*******************
		thisform.AddObject("oaux_artprove","tg_tabla","aux_artprove")
		thisform.oaux_artprove.SetearProp("BOT")
		thisform.AddObject("odetalle","tg_tabla","detalle")
		thisform.odetalle.SetearProp("BOT")
		
		
		*************
		
		&& agregado Ceramisur Tasas

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Cobranza")
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
		
		Else
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()	
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionar
		Local vDatos[1,2],lImprime
		
		If Alltrim(Upper(ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption))="NINGUNO"
			lImprime = .f.
		Else
			lImprime = .t.
		Endif
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Imprime",lImprime)
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EnDDo
		
		If lImprime 
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Ninguno"
		Else
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Seleccionar todo"
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde=this.Value
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value=this.Value
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxClienteHasta.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
			ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
			ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
				ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
				ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled=.F.
				ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled=.F.
		
			Endif	
		Endif

		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

		ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled=.f.
		
		
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE aplicar_filtro_leyenda
		** SERGIO 11/03/2024 #1734
		Local lFiltrar_Leyenda, cString_Filtro
		
		lFiltrar_Leyenda = Thisform.Tg_chkFiltrar_Leyendas.Value
		cString_Filtro = UPPER(Alltrim(Thisform.oTbxFiltro_Leyenda.Value))
		
		If !lFiltrar_Leyenda
			Thisform.oViewComprobantes.Desfiltrar()
		Else
			cSentencia = ''
			Thisform.oTblFiltrar_Leyendas.Seleccionar
			Thisform.oTblFiltrar_Leyendas.IrPrimero
			cSentencia = Iif( Thisform.oTblFiltrar_Leyendas.Leer("Leyenda1"), "LIKE('*" + cString_Filtro + "*',UPPER(leyenda1))", "" )
		
			cSentencia = cSentencia + Iif( Thisform.oTblFiltrar_Leyendas.Leer("Leyenda2"), ;
				IIF( Empty(cSentencia),"", " or ") + "LIKE('*" + cString_Filtro + "*',UPPER(leyenda2))", "")
		
			cSentencia = cSentencia + Iif( Thisform.oTblFiltrar_Leyendas.Leer("Leyenda3"), ;
				IIF( Empty(cSentencia),"", " or ") + "LIKE('*" + cString_Filtro + "*',UPPER(leyenda3))", "")
		
			cSentencia = cSentencia + Iif( Thisform.oTblFiltrar_Leyendas.Leer("Leyenda4"), ;
				IIF( Empty(cSentencia),"", " or ") + "LIKE('*" + cString_Filtro + "*',UPPER(leyenda4))", "")
		
			cSentencia = cSentencia + Iif( Thisform.oTblFiltrar_Leyendas.Leer("Leyenda5"), ;
				IIF( Empty(cSentencia),"", " or ") + "LIKE('*" + cString_Filtro + "*',UPPER(leyenda5))", "")
		
			cSentencia = cSentencia + Iif( Thisform.oTblFiltrar_Leyendas.Leer("Leyenda6"), ;
				IIF( Empty(cSentencia),"", " or ") + "LIKE('*" + cString_Filtro + "*',UPPER(leyenda6))", "")
		
			cSentencia = cSentencia + Iif( Thisform.oTblFiltrar_Leyendas.Leer("Leyenda7"), ;
				IIF( Empty(cSentencia),"", " or ") + "LIKE('*" + cString_Filtro + "*',UPPER(leyenda7))", "")
		
			cSentencia = cSentencia + Iif( Thisform.oTblFiltrar_Leyendas.Leer("Leyenda8"), ;
				IIF( Empty(cSentencia),"", " or ") + "LIKE('*" + cString_Filtro + "*',UPPER(leyenda8))", "")
		
			Thisform.oViewComprobantes.Filtrar( cSentencia )
			Thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero
		Endif
		
		Thisform.Tg_grid1.Refresh
		** SERGIO 11/03/2024 #1734
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargocomboimpresoraetiquetas
		&& LUCAS S 14/06/2014 - TOYODAIH
		local nContador,nTotalImpresoras, lDefaultYaExiste
		
		nContador=0
		nTotalImpresoras=aprinters(vImpresoras)
		
		lDefaultYaExsite=.f.
		
		for mmpp=1 to nTotalImpresoras
			cNomImpresora=vImpresoras[mmpp,1]
			nPosicion=at("/SES",alltrim(upper(vImpresoras[mmpp,1])))
			
			* para windows 2003 server
			
			if nPosicion=0
			   nPosicion=at("EN LA SES",alltrim(upper(vImpresoras[mmpp,1])))
			endif
			
				
			if nPosicion=0
			   nPosicion=at("IN SES",alltrim(upper(vImpresoras[mmpp,1])))
			endif
			
			* para windows 2008 server
			if nPosicion=0 and at("REDIRECCIONADO",alltrim(upper(vImpresoras[mmpp,1])))<>0
			   nPosicion=at("(",alltrim(upper(vImpresoras[mmpp,1])))
			endif  	
			
			if nPosicion=0 and at("REDIRECTED",alltrim(upper(vImpresoras[mmpp,1])))<>0
			   nPosicion=at("(",alltrim(upper(vImpresoras[mmpp,1])))
			endif  
				
			If nPosicion>0
				 cNomImpresora=substr(alltrim(vImpresoras[mmpp,1]),1,nPosicion-1)
			Endif	 
			
			&& LUCAS IMPRESION PEDF 08/2024
			cImpresora="Nombre="+"'"+cNomImpresora+"'"+" and "+"Maquina="+"'"+alltrim(oApp.Maquina)+"'"+" and "+"Id_Impresora<>"+"'"+""+"'"
			&&cImpresora="Nombre="+"'"+cNomImpresora+"'"+" and "+"Maquina="+"'"+alltrim(oApp.Maquina)+"'"+" and "+"Id_Impresora<>"+"'"+""+"'"+" and etiquetas=.T."
			&& LUCAS IMPRESION PEDF 08/2024
		
			 
			If thisform.oTblImpresoras.Localizar(cImpresora)
				lDefaultYaExsite=.t.
				nContador=nContador+1
				dimension thisform.vImpresoras[nContador]
				thisform.vImpresoras[nContador]=space(1)+alltrim(vimpresoras[mmpp,1])
			Endif	
		endfor
		
		
		
		thisform.ExistenImpresoras=.t.
		
		IF TYPE("thisform.vImpresoras") = "L" 
			thisform.ExistenImpresoras=.T.
		ELSE 
			thisform.tg_combobox4.rowsource="thisform.vImpresoras"
			 
			If lDefaultYaExsite
				thisform.tg_combobox4.DisplayValue=space(1)+thisform.vImpresoras[nContador]
			Endif
		ENDIF 
		&& LUCAS S 14/06/2024 - TOYODAIH
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE darcolorrenglon
		LPARAMETERS cId_Comproba, cTipoColor
		LOCAL nBackColor
		
		DO CASE 
			CASE cTipoColor = "BACK"
				oApp.DarParametroGeneral('BACKCOLOR_CMP','X',@nBackColor,'V',cId_Comproba)
			CASE cTipoColor = "FORE"
				oApp.DarParametroGeneral('FORECOLOR_CMP','X',@nBackColor,'V',cId_Comproba)
		ENDCASE
		
		IF nBackColor = 0
			DO CASE 
				CASE cTipoColor = "BACK"
					nBackColor = 16777215
				CASE cTipoColor = "FORE"
					nBackColor = 0
			ENDCASE			
		ENDIF 
		
		RETURN nBackColor
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE enviarmail
		Local cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_comproba,nNro_referencia,cMail,cId_cliente,mmpp,cantPdfs,lHayAdjuntos, cBCC 
		Local cmail, cmailcliente, vPdfs[1], cId_clienteBusqueda
				
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		thisform.LockScreen = .t.
		
		If Type("oEmailItem")<>"O"
			oEmailItem = CreateObject("Tg_Mail")
		Endif
		
		If Type("thisform.oCstImprimecomprobantes")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.AddObject("oCstImprimecomprobantes","Tg_ImprimeComprobantes")
		Endif
		
		mmpp = 0
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		Do While !thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			cId_sucursal 	= ThisForm.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
			cId_sistema 	= ThisForm.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema")
			cId_comproba 	= ThisForm.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba")
			nNro_referencia = ThisForm.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
			
			If thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Imprime")
			
				mmpp = mmpp + 1
			
				* Le paso copias 0 para que no imprima normalmente
				thisform.oCstImprimecomprobantes.ImprimirComprobante(cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_comproba,nNro_referencia,0,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,.null.,.t.,.t.,(mmpp=1),1)
				
			Endif
				
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		if oApp.oTblTerminal.Buscar(oApp.Maquina,.f.,"Clave")
		
			cPath_pdf = allt(oApp.oTblTerminal.Leer("Path_pdf"))
			CantPdfs = ADIR(vPdfs, cPath_pdf + "*.pdf") && Recupero todos los archivos pdf generados
			asor(vPdfs,1) && Lo ordeno por Id_cliente
			
			mmpp = 1
				
			do while mmpp<=CantPdfs
			
				cId_cliente = substr(vPdfs[mmpp,1],1,5)
				cId_clienteBusqueda = strtran(cId_cliente, "#", " ")
				
				cmail = ""
				cmailcliente = ""
				lHayAdjuntos=.f.
				
				Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Buscar(cId_clienteBusqueda+"V", .F., "CLAVECLI")
				Do while !thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.EsEof().and.Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.EsClaveIgual()
					If Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Leer("FE") And 	Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema") = "V"
						cmailcliente = alltrim(Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Leer("Email")) + "; "
						cmail = cmail + cmailcliente
					Endif
				
					Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.IrSiguiente()
				Enddo
				
				If ThisForm.oTblClientes.Buscar(cId_clienteBusqueda,.f.,"Clave") 
					cmail = cmail + alltrim(thisform.oTblClientes.leer("internet"))
						
					if !empty(cMail)
			
						cBCC = ""
						If Thisform.oTblUsuarios.Buscar(oApp.Usuario)
							cBCC = Thisform.oTblUsuarios.Leer("CCO")
						Endif
						
						oEmailItem.Generar(cMail," ",cBCC,"Se adjunta el comprobante correspondiente. ",Alltrim(Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Asunto_Mail")))
						
						do while mmpp<=CantPdfs and substr(vPdfs[mmpp,1],1,5)=cId_cliente
									
							if oEmailItem.Adjuntar(cPath_pdf + vPdfs[mmpp,1])
								lHayAdjuntos=.t.
							endif
					
							mmpp = mmpp + 1
						ENDDO
					ELSE
						=fMensAceptar("El cliente: " + cId_clienteBusqueda + ", no posee cuenta de mail para enviar el mismo!")
					endif
				endif
			
				if lHayAdjuntos
					oEmailItem.Enviar()
				endif
			enddo
		endif
		
		=fMensAceptar("La generación de comprobantes ha finalizado.")
		
		thisform.LockScreen = .f.
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE filtrargrilla
		&& LUCAS 31/05/2024 - TOYODAIH
		LOCAL cFiltro

		ENDIF	
			
		THISFORM.tg_grid1.Refresh
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimir
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias
		
		Local lSoloPendientesRomaneo, nOpcionImpresion, nCantCopiasRomaneo
		
		if type ("thisform.oImpresionRomaneo") = T_OBJECT
			lSoloPendientesRomaneo 	= thisform.oImpresionRomaneo.oChkPendRomaneo.Value
			nOpcionImpresion 		= thisform.oImpresionRomaneo.oOpgOpcion.Value
			nCantCopiasRomaneo 		= thisform.oImpresionRomaneo.Tg_Spinner1.Value
		endif
		
		If nCopias>0 
			thisform.ImprimirComprobante(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias,,lSoloPendientesRomaneo, nOpcionImpresion, nCantCopiasRomaneo, , .T.)
		Endif
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimiretiquetas
		
		&& LUCAS S 14/06/2024 - TOYODAIH - && LUCAS IMPRESION PEDF 08/2024
		LOCAL nFacturados, cDescargaArchivo, nOcurrencia, cText, cTextoAImprimir, nPos, nCantCaracteres
		LOCAL vGrabacion, lImprimi, lTipoImpresionPDF, cImpresora
		LOCAL oShell as Object
		DIMENSION vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		IF oApp.ML_EnviadorCmpxMail
			
			thisForm.cNombreImpresora = Alltrim(thisForm.prepararimpresoraEtiquetas())
					
			IF !EMPTY(thisForm.cNombreImpresora) 
		
				nContador = 0
				nEtiquetas = 1
				cDescargaArchivo = ""
				lImprimi = .F.
				
		
				cImpresora="Nombre="+"'"+thisForm.cNombreImpresora+"'"+" and "+"Maquina="+"'"+alltrim(oApp.Maquina)+"'"+" and "+"Id_Impresora<>"+"'"+""+"'"
			 
			 	lTipoImpresionPDF= .T.
				If thisform.oTblImpresoras.Localizar(cImpresora)
					lTipoImpresionPDF = !thisform.oTblImpresoras.Leer("Etiquetas")
				Endif	
		
				thisform.oViewComprobantes.irPrimero()
				DO WHILE !thisform.oViewComprobantes.esEof()
					IF thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Imprime") 
					
						IF ThisForm.oTblVnt_DocuBis.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("id_comproba"), .F., "CLAVE") AND ThisForm.oTblVnt_DocuBis.Leer("ID_PLATAFORMA")<>"ML"
							
							fMensAceptar("El comprobante: " + thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Id_Comproba") + ", con Nro de Referencia: " + STR(thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Nro_Referencia"),10) + " , no se encuentra configurado para imprimir etiquetas.")
					
						ELSE 
							lImprimi = .T.
							WAIT WIND  "Procesando etiquetas, Comprobante: " + thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("id_comproba") + " Nro. Referencia: " + ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("nro_referencia"))) NOWAIT
		
							
							*** 08-08-2024
							cDescargaArchivo = Thisform.oCstMercadoLibre.DescargarEtiqueta(thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Id_Sucursal"), thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Id_Sistema"),;
									 														thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Nro_Referencia"), lTipoImpresionPDF)
							&& Mariano #1928 21/04/2025 - Se saca la impresión de la etiqueta de la consulta y se la lleva a la clase custom de MercadoLibre, para que se utilice desde todas las consolas desde el mismo lugar y evitar duplicar todo el código. 				
							IF !EMPTY(cDescargaArchivo)
								thisForm.oCstMercadoLibre.ImprimirEtiqueta(cDescargaArchivo, thisForm.cNombreImpresora, thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Id_Sucursal"), ;
										 Thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Id_Sistema"), thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Id_Comproba"), ;
										 thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Nro_Referencia")) 
							
							Endif			
							&& Mariano #1928 21/04/2025 - Se saca la impresión de la etiqueta de la consulta y se la lleva a la clase custom de MercadoLibre, para que se utilice desde todas las consolas desde el mismo lugar y evitar duplicar todo el código. 				
								
					
																		 
							nEtiquetas = nEtiquetas + 1
						endif					
						
					ENDIF
							 
					thisform.oViewComprobantes.irSiguiente()
				enddo
		
			
				IF lImprimi
					=fMensAceptar("Se imprimieron las etiquetas para los pedidos seleccionados.")
				ENDIF
			ELSE
				=fmensAceptar("No tiene seleccionada la impresora de etiquetas!!") 
			ENDIF
		ELSE
			=fmensAceptar("No tiene el componente de descarga de etiquetas instalado!!") 
		ENDIF
		&& LUCAS S 14/06/2014 - TOYODAIH
		
		**** Lucas 08_2024
		
		*!*	&& LUCAS S 14/06/2014 - TOYODAIH
		*!*	LOCAL nFacturados, cDescargaArchivo, nOcurrencia, cText, cTextoAImprimir, nPos, nCantCaracteres
		*!*	LOCAL vGrabacion, lImprimi
		*!*	DIMENSION vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		*!*	IF oApp.ML_EnviadorCmpxMail
		*!*		
		*!*		thisForm.cNombreImpresora = Alltrim(thisForm.prepararimpresoraEtiquetas())
		*!*				
		*!*		IF !EMPTY(thisForm.cNombreImpresora) 
		
		*!*			nContador = 0
		*!*			nEtiquetas = 1
		*!*			cDescargaArchivo = ""
		*!*			lImprimi = .F.
		*!*		
		*!*			thisform.oViewComprobantes.irPrimero()
		*!*			DO WHILE !thisform.oViewComprobantes.esEof()
		*!*				IF thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Imprime") 
		*!*				
		*!*					IF ThisForm.oTblVnt_DocuBis.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("id_comproba"), .F., "CLAVE") AND ThisForm.oTblVnt_DocuBis.Leer("ID_PLATAFORMA")<>"ML"
		*!*						
		*!*						fMensAceptar("El comprobante: " + thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Id_Comproba") + ", con Nro de Referencia: " + STR(thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Nro_Referencia"),10) + " , no se encuentra configurado para imprimir etiquetas.")
		*!*				
		*!*					ELSE 
		*!*						lImprimi = .T.
		*!*						WAIT WIND  "Procesando etiquetas, Comprobante: " + thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("id_comproba") + " Nro. Referencia: " + ALLTRIM(STR(thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("nro_referencia"))) NOWAIT
		
		*!*						
		*!*						cDescargaArchivo = Thisform.oCstMercadoLibre.DescargarEtiqueta(thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Id_Sucursal"), thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Id_Sistema"),;
		*!*								 														thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Nro_Referencia"))
		*!*								
		*!*						WAIT WINDOW cDescargaArchivo  NOWAIT
		*!*								
		*!*						IF !EMPTY(cDescargaArchivo)
		*!*						
		*!*							set printer to name alltrim(thisForm.cNombreImpresora)
		*!*							
		*!*							nOcurrencia = 1
		*!*							cText = FILETOSTR(cDescargaArchivo)
		*!*							cText = STRTRAN(cText, "{", "{{}")
		*!*							DO while(AT('^',cText, nOcurrencia) > 0)
		*!*									nOcurrencia = nOcurrencia + 1
		*!*							endDo
		
		*!*							nCantCaracteres = 1
		*!*							nPos = 1
		*!*							FOR nCaracter = 1 TO nOcurrencia-1
		*!*								IF nCaracter = nOcurrencia-1
		*!*									cTextoAImprimir = SUBSTR(cText, nPos)
		*!*								ELSE
		*!*									nCantCaracteres = AT('^', cText, nCaracter + 1) - nPos
		*!*									cTextoAImprimir = SUBSTR(cText, nPos, nCantCaracteres)
		*!*									nPos = AT('^', cText, nCaracter + 1)
		*!*								endif
		*!*								
		*!*								???cTextoAImprimir
		*!*							ENDFOR
		*!*				
		*!*				
		*!*							thisForm.mandoAImprimir()
		*!*							
		*!*							Thisform.oTblGTV_Ventas.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Id_Sucursal") + thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Id_Sistema") + thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Id_Comproba") + STR(thisform.oViewComprobantes.leer("Nro_Referencia"),10), .F., "CLAVE")
		*!*				 			DO While !Thisform.oTblGTV_Ventas.EsEof() AND Thisform.oTblGTV_Ventas.EsClaveIgual()
		*!*								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"fecha_impetiqueta"		, DATE())
		*!*								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"hora_impetiqueta" 		, TIME())
		*!*								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"maquina_impetiqueta"  	, oApp.Maquina))
		*!*								=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Usuario_ImpEtiqueta"   , oApp.Usuario))
		*!*								Thisform.oTblGTV_Ventas.Modificar(@vGrabacion, .f., .t.)
		*!*								
		*!*								Thisform.oTblGTV_Ventas.IrSiguiente()
		*!*							EndDo	
		*!*						Endif			
		*!*																	 
		*!*						nEtiquetas = nEtiquetas + 1
		*!*					endif					
		*!*					
		*!*				ENDIF
		*!*						 
		*!*				thisform.oViewComprobantes.irSiguiente()
		*!*			enddo
		
		*!*		
		*!*			IF lImprimi
		*!*				=fMensAceptar("Se imprimieron las etiquetas para los pedidos seleccionados.")
		*!*			ENDIF
		*!*		ELSE
		*!*			=fmensAceptar("No tiene seleccionada la impresora de etiquetas!!") 
		*!*		ENDIF
		*!*	ELSE
		*!*		=fmensAceptar("No tiene el componente de descarga de etiquetas instalado!!") 
		*!*	ENDIF
		*!*	&& LUCAS S 14/06/2014 - TOYODAIH
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimirlotes
		Local vDatos[1,2],nCopias
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			If  thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Imprime")
				
				Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
				
				if !thisform.oChkAsignaCopias.Value
					nCopias = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Copias")
				else
					nCopias = Thisform.Tg_Spinner1.Value
				endif
				
				If nCopias=0
					nCopias = 1
				ENDIF
		
				Thisform.Imprimir(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),nCopias )	
			Endif
				
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimirvectorcomprobantes
		** Mariano 07/09/2018 ** 
		Local vComprobantes[1,6], vComprobantesImprimir[1,6], nCopias, nContador, lIngrese, i
		
		nContador = 1
		lIngrese = .F.
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		Do While !thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			if thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Imprime")
		
				if thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
					DIMENSION vComprobantes[nContador, 6]
					vComprobantes[nContador, 1] = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
					vComprobantes[nContador, 2] = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema")
					vComprobantes[nContador, 3] = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_comproba")
					vComprobantes[nContador, 4] = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("nro_referencia")
					if !thisform.oChkAsignaCopias.Value
						vComprobantes[nContador, 5] = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Copias")
					else
						vComprobantes[nContador, 5] = Thisform.Tg_Spinner1.Value
					endIf
					vComprobantes[nContador, 6] = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("interlineadogrilla")	
					nContador = nContador + 1 
					lIngrese = .T.
				endIf	
			Endif		
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo	
		
		If lIngrese
			
			nRestoPosicion = 0
			For i = 1 To Alen(vComprobantes,1)
		
				DIMENSION vComprobantesImprimir[i, 6]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 1] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 1]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 2] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 2]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 3] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 3]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 4] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 4]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 5] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 5]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 6] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 6]
				nRestoPosicion = nRestoPosicion + 1
			EndFor	
		
			thisForm.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
			thisForm.imprimircomprobantesagrupados("", "", "", 0, 0, .F., .F., 0, 0,, .F., @vComprobantesImprimir)
		Endif
		** Mariano 07/09/2018 ** 
	ENDPROC

		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=ThisForm.BotonEjecutarSiempreHabilitado 
		&& LUCAS 07/2024 - TOYODAIH
		
		
		Thisform.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.T.
		Thisform.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled=.T.
		Thisform.oCmdImprimir.Enabled=.T.
		Thisform.oCmdMail.Enabled=.T.
		Thisform.oCmdImprimirSoloDocumento.Enabled=.T.
		Thisform.oCmdAvanzado.Enabled=.T.
		Thisform.oCmdMail.Enabled = .T.
		
		
		Thisform.LockScreen=.F.
		
		&& LUCAS S 14/06/2014 - TOYODAIH
		LOCAL i, cComprobantes, cFiltro
		cComprobantes   = ""
		
		IF ThisForm.HabilitarImpresionEtiquetas
			FOR i = 1 TO ALEN(vComprobantes,1)
				IF vComprobantes[i,2]
					IF Thisform.oTblVnt_DocuBis.Buscar(vComprobantes[i,1], .F., "CLAVE") 
						IF Thisform.oTblVnt_DocuBis.Leer("mercadolibre") AND Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(vComprobantes[i,1], .F., "CLAVE")
							cComprobantes = cComprobantes + ",'" + vComprobantes[i,1] + "'" 
						ENDIF
					ENDIF
				ENDIF
			ENDFOR 
		
			thisform.Tg_cmbvnt_docu1.BoundColumn=2
			thisform.Tg_cmbvnt_docu1.RowSourceType=6
			thisform.Tg_cmbvnt_docu1.RowSource=alltrim(thisform.oTblVnt_DocuEtiquetas.Alias)+".Nombre,id_comproba"
			thisform.Tg_cmbvnt_docu1.Style=2
			thisform.Tg_cmbvnt_docu1.ColumnWidths="170,0"
			cFiltro = "inlist(id_comproba,'TD'" + cComprobantes  + ")" 
			thisform.oTblVnt_DocuEtiquetas.Filtrar(cFiltro)
			thisform.Tg_cmbvnt_docu1.Requery
			thisform.Tg_cmbvnt_docu1.ListIndex=1
			ThisForm.Tg_cmbvnt_docu1.SetearTodos()
			ThisForm.Tg_cmbvnt_docu1.Value ="TD"
		
			Thisform.oChkTodosCmpEtiquetas.Value= .t.
			Thisform.Tg_cmbvnt_docu1.Enabled 	= .f.
		Endif
		&& LUCAS S 14/06/2014 - TOYODAIH
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionar
		Local vDatos[1,2],lImprime
		
		If Alltrim(Upper(ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption))="NINGUNO"
			lImprime = .f.
		Else
			lImprime = .t.
		Endif
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Imprime",lImprime)
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EnDDo
		
		If lImprime 
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Ninguno"
		Else
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Seleccionar todo"
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE enviarmail
		Local cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_comproba,nNro_referencia,cMail,cId_cliente,mmpp,cantPdfs,lHayAdjuntos, cBCC 
		Local cmail, cmailcliente, vPdfs[1], cId_clienteBusqueda
				
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		thisform.LockScreen = .t.
		
		If Type("oEmailItem")<>"O"
			oEmailItem = CreateObject("Tg_Mail")
		Endif
		
		If Type("thisform.oCstImprimecomprobantes")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.AddObject("oCstImprimecomprobantes","Tg_ImprimeComprobantes")
		Endif
		
		mmpp = 0
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		Do While !thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			cId_sucursal 	= ThisForm.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
			cId_sistema 	= ThisForm.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema")
			cId_comproba 	= ThisForm.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba")
			nNro_referencia = ThisForm.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
			
			If thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Imprime")
			
				mmpp = mmpp + 1
			
				* Le paso copias 0 para que no imprima normalmente
				thisform.oCstImprimecomprobantes.ImprimirComprobante(cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_comproba,nNro_referencia,0,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,.null.,.t.,.t.,(mmpp=1),1)
				
			Endif
				
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		if oApp.oTblTerminal.Buscar(oApp.Maquina,.f.,"Clave")
		
			cPath_pdf = allt(oApp.oTblTerminal.Leer("Path_pdf"))
			CantPdfs = ADIR(vPdfs, cPath_pdf + "*.pdf") && Recupero todos los archivos pdf generados
			asor(vPdfs,1) && Lo ordeno por Id_cliente
			
			mmpp = 1
				
			do while mmpp<=CantPdfs
			
				cId_cliente = substr(vPdfs[mmpp,1],1,5)
				cId_clienteBusqueda = strtran(cId_cliente, "#", " ")
				
				cmail = ""
				cmailcliente = ""
				lHayAdjuntos=.f.
				
				Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Buscar(cId_clienteBusqueda+"V", .F., "CLAVECLI")
				Do while !thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.EsEof().and.Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.EsClaveIgual()
					If Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Leer("FE") And 	Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema") = "V"
						cmailcliente = alltrim(Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Leer("Email")) + "; "
						cmail = cmail + cmailcliente
					Endif
				
					Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.IrSiguiente()
				Enddo
				
				If ThisForm.oTblClientes.Buscar(cId_clienteBusqueda,.f.,"Clave") 
					cmail = cmail + alltrim(thisform.oTblClientes.leer("internet"))
						
					if !empty(cMail)
			
						cBCC = ""
						If Thisform.oTblUsuarios.Buscar(oApp.Usuario)
							cBCC = Thisform.oTblUsuarios.Leer("CCO")
						Endif
						
						oEmailItem.Generar(cMail," ",cBCC,"Se adjunta el comprobante correspondiente. ",Alltrim(Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Asunto_Mail")))
						
						do while mmpp<=CantPdfs and substr(vPdfs[mmpp,1],1,5)=cId_cliente
									
							if oEmailItem.Adjuntar(cPath_pdf + vPdfs[mmpp,1])
								lHayAdjuntos=.t.
							endif
					
							mmpp = mmpp + 1
						ENDDO
					ELSE
						=fMensAceptar("El cliente: " + cId_clienteBusqueda + ", no posee cuenta de mail para enviar el mismo!")
					endif
				endif
			
				if lHayAdjuntos
					oEmailItem.Enviar()
				endif
			enddo
		endif
		
		=fMensAceptar("La generación de comprobantes ha finalizado.")
		
		thisform.LockScreen = .f.
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimir
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias
		
		Local lSoloPendientesRomaneo, nOpcionImpresion, nCantCopiasRomaneo
		
		if type ("thisform.oImpresionRomaneo") = T_OBJECT
			lSoloPendientesRomaneo 	= thisform.oImpresionRomaneo.oChkPendRomaneo.Value
			nOpcionImpresion 		= thisform.oImpresionRomaneo.oOpgOpcion.Value
			nCantCopiasRomaneo 		= thisform.oImpresionRomaneo.Tg_Spinner1.Value
		endif
		
		If nCopias>0 
			thisform.ImprimirComprobante(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias,,lSoloPendientesRomaneo, nOpcionImpresion, nCantCopiasRomaneo, , .T.)
		Endif
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimirlotes
		Local vDatos[1,2],nCopias
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			If  thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Imprime")
				
				Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
				
				if !thisform.oChkAsignaCopias.Value
					nCopias = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Copias")
				else
					nCopias = Thisform.Tg_Spinner1.Value
				endif
				
				If nCopias=0
					nCopias = 1
				ENDIF
		
				Thisform.Imprimir(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),nCopias )	
			Endif
				
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimirvectorcomprobantes
		** Mariano 07/09/2018 ** 
		Local vComprobantes[1,6], vComprobantesImprimir[1,6], nCopias, nContador, lIngrese, i
		
		nContador = 1
		lIngrese = .F.
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		Do While !thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			if thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Imprime")
		
				if thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
					DIMENSION vComprobantes[nContador, 6]
					vComprobantes[nContador, 1] = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
					vComprobantes[nContador, 2] = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema")
					vComprobantes[nContador, 3] = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_comproba")
					vComprobantes[nContador, 4] = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("nro_referencia")
					if !thisform.oChkAsignaCopias.Value
						vComprobantes[nContador, 5] = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Copias")
					else
						vComprobantes[nContador, 5] = Thisform.Tg_Spinner1.Value
					endIf
					vComprobantes[nContador, 6] = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("interlineadogrilla")	
					nContador = nContador + 1 
					lIngrese = .T.
				endIf	
			Endif		
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo	
		
		If lIngrese
			
			nRestoPosicion = 0
			For i = 1 To Alen(vComprobantes,1)
		
				DIMENSION vComprobantesImprimir[i, 6]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 1] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 1]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 2] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 2]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 3] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 3]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 4] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 4]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 5] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 5]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 6] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 6]
				nRestoPosicion = nRestoPosicion + 1
			EndFor	
		
			thisForm.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
			thisForm.imprimircomprobantesagrupados("", "", "", 0, 0, .F., .F., 0, 0,, .F., @vComprobantesImprimir)
		Endif
		** Mariano 07/09/2018 ** 
	ENDPROC

		Local cTexto,oLst

			Endif

		Else
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)

			Endif

		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionar
		Local vDatos[1,2],lImprime
		
		If Alltrim(Upper(ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption))="NINGUNO"
			lImprime = .f.
		Else
			lImprime = .t.
		Endif
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Imprime",lImprime)
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EnDDo
		
		If lImprime 
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Ninguno"
		Else
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Seleccionar todo"
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC
