	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_Cliente
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantes","Tg_ViewComprobantes")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_Cabecera","tg_tabla","Vnt_Cabecera","clave")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.DesHabilitar()
		
		thisform.oTbxReferencia.Value=0
		thisform.oTbxNumero.Value=Space(14)
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		
		thisform.OldReferencia=0
		thisform.OldNumero=Space(14)
		
		
		thisform.tg_clientes1.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDAEXISTENCIA 
		
		
		If Type("cId_cliente")<>T_LOGICAL
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Value=cId_cliente
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Valid
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Enabled=.f.
		Endif
		
		thisform.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Cobranza")
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
		
		Else
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()	
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local lAnulado
		
		Local cClave
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,thisform.tg_clientes1.Value,"","",ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,"",lAnulado,,,,,,,,ThisForm.oTbxReferencia.value,ThisForm.oTbxNumero.Value)
		
		if alltrim(Thisform.Tg_CmbSuc_Clientes1.Value)<>"TD"
		   thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		   Do while !thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
		      cClave = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema")+thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba")+Str(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10)
		      thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(cClave,.f.,"Clave")
		      if thisform.oVnt_Cabecera.Leer("CodSucursal")<>Thisform.Tg_CmbSuc_Clientes1.Value
		         thisform.oViewComprobantes.Borrar()
		      endif
		      thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		   enddo
		endif
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".TotalDeuda"
		
		
		
		&& Tasas Aca
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_Operacion"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".NumeroOperacion"
		&& Tasas Hasta Aca
		
		
		*!*	thisform.oCmdDetalle.Enabled=!thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsTablaVacia()
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Sumar("iif(Suma,1,-1)*TotalDeuda",".t."),2)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdDatosCliente.Click
		Local oAbmGen
		
		*oAbmGen=CreateObject("tg_FormConsulta","Clientes",.f.,thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Cliente"))
		If !thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			oAbmGen=CreateObject("tg_FormConsulta","Clientes",.f.,Thisform.Tg_Clientes1.Value)
			oAbmGen.Show()
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oOpgAnulado.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxNumero.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldNumero
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldNumero=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxReferencia.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldReferencia
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldReferencia=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.LostFocus
		Thisform.Tg_Cmbsuc_Clientes1.Filtrar("Id_Cliente='"+this.Value+"'")
		
		thisform.tg_CmbSuc_Clientes1.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.tg_CmbSuc_Clientes1.Value="TD   "
		
		thisform.OldSucCliente = thisform.tg_CmbSuc_Clientes1.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.Valid
		local lValida
		lValida=tg_textclave::valid()
		thisform.CLienteValidado=.f.
		if lValida.and.!this.FormDesactivado && .and. !thisform.ClienteValidado
				
				thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(this.Value)
				ThisForm.RazonSocial.Value=thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social")
				
				thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
				thisform.oTbxMoneda.Value=thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Nombre")
				thisform.ClienteValidado=.t.
		endif
		*!*	If !this.FormDesactivado
		*!*		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		*!*	Endif	
		
		If (thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida).and.!this.FormDesactivado
			*!*thisform.RefrescarConsulta
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Habilitar()
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.t.
		Else
			ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.DesHabilitar()
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.f.
		Endif	
		
		Return thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.When
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldSucCliente
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif
		thisform.OldSucCliente=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbsuc_clientes1.seteartodos
		Local vGrabacion [1,2]
		
		this.oArchivo.SetearProp("BOT")
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,this.CampoValue,"TD")	
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,this.CampoColumna,"Todas")	
		=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Cliente",Thisform.Tg_Clientes1.Value)	
			
		this.oArchivo.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		this.Requery	
		
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimir
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias
		
		Local lSoloPendientesRomaneo, nOpcionImpresion, nCantCopiasRomaneo
		
		if type ("thisform.oImpresionRomaneo") = T_OBJECT
			lSoloPendientesRomaneo 	= thisform.oImpresionRomaneo.oChkPendRomaneo.Value
			nOpcionImpresion 		= thisform.oImpresionRomaneo.oOpgOpcion.Value
			nCantCopiasRomaneo 		= thisform.oImpresionRomaneo.Tg_Spinner1.Value
		endif
		
		If nCopias>0 
			thisform.ImprimirComprobante(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias,,lSoloPendientesRomaneo, nOpcionImpresion, nCantCopiasRomaneo, , .T.)
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimirlotes
		Local vDatos[1,2],nCopias
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.EsEof()
			
			If  thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Imprime")
				
				Thisform.oTblcmp_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
				
				if !thisform.oChkAsignaCopias.Value
					nCopias = Thisform.oTblcmp_Docu.Leer("Copias")
				else
					nCopias = Thisform.Tg_Spinner1.Value
				endif
				
				If nCopias=0
					nCopias = 1
				Endif
				Thisform.Imprimir(thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),nCopias )	
			Endif
				
			thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.IrPrimero()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaCompras")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantesCompras","Tg_ViewComprobantesCompras")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblProveedores","tg_tabla","Proveedores","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		****** MATIAS L. 23/11/2016
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblcmp_docu","tg_tabla","cmp_docu","clave")
		
		*************
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Alias
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		
		***Lucas
		thisform.tg_cmbEstadoscomproba1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbEstadoscomproba1.Value = "TD"
		thisform.OldId_EstadoComproba =     thisform.tg_cmbEstadoscomproba1.Value
		
		ThisForm.oChkSoloPendDesc.Value=.f.
		thisform.OldSoloPendDesc   = ThisForm.oChkSoloPendDesc.Value
		***
		*** Diego 12-06-2008
		thisform.OldId_ProveedorDesde=space(5)
		*** Diego 12-06-2008
		thisform.oTbxReferencia.Value=0
		thisform.OldNumero = ""
		thisform.otbxNumero.Value = SPACE(14)
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaContableDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaContableHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.oTbxProveedorDesde.valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxProveedorHasta.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxProveedorDesde.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		thisform.oTbxProveedorHasta.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		
		thisform.OldReferencia=0
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		
		Thisform.OldFechaContableDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaContableDesde.Value
		Thisform.OldFechaContableHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaContableHasta.Value
		
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Pago")
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago","TG_ConsultaPago",thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.ConsultarPago(thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.Show()
		
		Else
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()	
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal,lAnulado,cId_EstadoComproba
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal=""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		Endif
		
		
		
		
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantesCompras1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,ThisForm.oTbxProveedorDesde.Value,cId_Sucursal,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),lAnulado,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),ThisForm.oTbxProveedorHasta.Value,thisform.Tg_cmbestadoscomproba1.Value,ThisForm.oTbxReferencia.value,ThisForm.oChkSoloPendDesc.Value,.f.,.f.,Thisform.oTbxFechaContableDesde.Value,Thisform.oTbxFechaContableHasta.Value,thisform.otbxNumero.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
		
		******** MATIAS L.23/11/2016
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.oCmdAvanzado.Enabled=.t.
		**************
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionar
		Local vDatos[1,2],lImprime
		
		If Alltrim(Upper(ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption))="NINGUNO"
			lImprime = .f.
		Else
			lImprime = .t.
		Endif
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.EsEof()
			
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Imprime",lImprime)
			thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.IrSiguiente()
		EnDDo
		
		If lImprime 
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Ninguno"
		Else
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Seleccionar todo"
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaContableDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaContableDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

		Endif

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus

	PROCEDURE oTbxNumero.LostFocus

			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldNumero
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldNumero=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxProveedorDesde.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ProveedorDesde
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ProveedorDesde=this.Value
		thisform.oTbxProveedorHasta.Value=this.Value
		thisform.OldId_ProveedorHasta=this.Value
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxProveedorHasta.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ProveedorHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ProveedorHasta=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxReferencia.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldReferencia
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldReferencia=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbestadoscomproba1.InteractiveChange
		*!*	If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		*!*		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled  = this.Value<>thisform.OldEstadoComproba
		*!*		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled = !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		*!*		ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled       = !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		*!*		ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled          = !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		*!*		ThisForm.oCmdAvanzado.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		*!*	Endif	
		*!*	thisform.OldEstadoComproba = this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbsucursales1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Sucursal
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local oAbmGen
		
		If !thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.EsEof()
			oAbmGen=CreateObject("tg_FormConsulta","Proveedores",.f.,thisform.oViewComprobantesCompras.Leer("Id_Proveedor"))
			oAbmGen.Show()
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescompras1.Init
		dodefault(".t.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescompras1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled =this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE grabarfechaentrega
		Local vDatos[1,2]
		
		If ThisForm.oOpgAnulado.Value =1 
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
			Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
				
				If !Empty(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("FecEntrega")) OR .T.  && PROVISORIO HEYDAY, 25/11/2004
					If Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema")+thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba")+Str(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10),.f.,"Clave")
						=fGrabar(@vDatos,"FecEntrega", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("FecEntrega"))
						Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
					Endif	
						
				Endif
		
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Leyenda1", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Leyenda1"))
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Leyenda2", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Leyenda2"))
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Leyenda3", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Leyenda3"))
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Leyenda4", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Leyenda4"))
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Leyenda5", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Leyenda5"))
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Leyenda6", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Leyenda6"))
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Leyenda7", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Leyenda7"))
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Leyenda8", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Leyenda8"))
		
				Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
		
				
				thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
			EndDo
		Else
			=fMensAceptar("No se pueden modificar la fecha de entrega de los comprobantes ya anulados!")
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantes","Tg_ViewComprobantesFechaEntrega")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Cabecera","tg_tabla","Vnt_Cabecera","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		*!*	ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.DesHabilitar()
		
		
		thisform.oTbxReferencia.Value=0
		thisform.oTbxNumero.Value=Space(14)
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"

		* Depositos
		ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.Value="TD"
		* Depositos 
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value

		thisform.OldFechaEntregaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaEntregaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaEntregaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaEntregaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_deposito = ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		thisform.OldNumero=Thisform.oTbxNumero.Value
		Thisform.OldReferencia=Thisform.oTbxReferencia.Value
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.CurrentControl="Text1"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.Sparse=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.ReadOnly =.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column10.ReadOnly =.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column11.ReadOnly =.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column12.ReadOnly =.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column13.ReadOnly =.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column14.ReadOnly =.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column15.ReadOnly =.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column16.ReadOnly =.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column17.ReadOnly =.f.
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Cobranza")
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
		
		Else
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ponerfiltro
		If ThisForm.oChkSoloVacias.Value 
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.Filtrar("FecEntregaEnt = Ctod(Space(8))")
		Else
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.DesFiltrar()	
		Endif
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.SetFocus()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal,cId_vendedor,lAnulado,cId_Deposito
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal=""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		Endif
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
			cId_Vendedor=""
		Else
			cId_Vendedor=ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value
		Endif
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		
		* Depósitos
		If ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.Value="TD"
			cId_Deposito=""
		Else
			cId_Deposito=ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.Value
		Endif
		* Depósitos
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",cId_Sucursal,cId_vendedor,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,;
											ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),;
											lAnulado,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),;
											ThisForm.oTbxFechaEntregaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaEntregaHasta.Value,;
											thisform.oTbxReferencia.Value, thisform.oTbxNumero.Value,cId_Deposito)
											
											
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.oCmdGrabarFechaEntrega.Enabled =.t.
		
		Thisform.PonerFiltro()
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Total"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_cliente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nombre"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".FecEntrega"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Leyenda1"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Leyenda2"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column12.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Leyenda3"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column13.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Leyenda4"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column14.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Leyenda5"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column15.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Leyenda6"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column16.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Leyenda7"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column17.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Leyenda8"
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column18.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".NombreDeposito"
		
		*!*	thisform.oCmdDetalle.Enabled=!thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsTablaVacia()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Sumar("iif(Suma,1,-1)*Total",".t."),2)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkSoloVacias.Click
		Thisform.PonerFiltro()
	ENDPROC

			ThisForm.oCmdGrabarFechaEntrega.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarfechaentrega
		Local vDatos[1,2]
		
		If ThisForm.oOpgAnulado.Value =1 
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
			Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
				
				If !Empty(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("FecEntrega")) OR .T.  && PROVISORIO HEYDAY, 25/11/2004
					If Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema")+thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba")+Str(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10),.f.,"Clave")
						=fGrabar(@vDatos,"FecEntrega", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("FecEntrega"))
						Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
					Endif	
						
				Endif
		
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Leyenda1", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Leyenda1"))
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Leyenda2", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Leyenda2"))
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Leyenda3", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Leyenda3"))
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Leyenda4", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Leyenda4"))
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Leyenda5", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Leyenda5"))
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Leyenda6", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Leyenda6"))
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Leyenda7", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Leyenda7"))
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Leyenda8", thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Leyenda8"))
		
				Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
		
				
				thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
			EndDo
		Else
			=fMensAceptar("No se pueden modificar la fecha de entrega de los comprobantes ya anulados!")
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantes"		,"Tg_ViewComprobantesFechaEntregasaldos")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes"			,"tg_tabla"		,"Clientes"			,"clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Cabecera"		,"tg_tabla"		,"Vnt_Cabecera"		,"clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas"			,"tg_tabla"		,"Monedas"			,"clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros"			,"tg_tabla"		,"Parametros")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		*!*	ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.DesHabilitar()
		
		
		thisform.oTbxReferencia.Value=0
		thisform.oTbxNumero.Value=Space(14)
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaEntregaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaEntregaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		* Depositos
		ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.Value="TD"
		* Depositos 
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldFechaEntregaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaEntregaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaEntregaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaEntregaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_deposito = ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal=thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor=thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		thisform.OldNumero=Thisform.oTbxNumero.Value
		Thisform.OldReferencia=thisform.oTbxReferencia.Value 
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.CurrentControl="Text1"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.Sparse=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.ReadOnly =.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column10.ReadOnly =.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column11.ReadOnly =.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column12.ReadOnly =.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column13.ReadOnly =.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column14.ReadOnly =.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column15.ReadOnly =.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column16.ReadOnly =.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column17.ReadOnly =.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column19.ReadOnly =.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column20.ReadOnly =.t.
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Cobranza")
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
		
		Else
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ponerfiltro
		If ThisForm.oChkSoloVacias.Value 
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.Filtrar("FecEntregaEnt = Ctod(Space(8))")
		Else
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.DesFiltrar()	
		Endif
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.SetFocus()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal,cId_vendedor,lAnulado,cId_Deposito
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal=""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		Endif
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
			cId_Vendedor=""
		Else
			cId_Vendedor=ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value
		Endif
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		
		* Depósitos
		If ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.Value="TD"
			cId_Deposito=""
		Else
			cId_Deposito=ThisForm.oCmbDepositos.Value
		Endif
		* Depósitos
		
		
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",cId_Sucursal,cId_vendedor,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,;
											ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),;
											lAnulado,thisform.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value,;
											ThisForm.oTbxFechaEntregaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaEntregaHasta.Value,;
											thisform.oTbxReferencia.Value, thisform.oTbxNumero.Value,cId_Deposito)
											
											
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.oCmdGrabarFechaEntrega.Enabled =.t.
		
		Thisform.PonerFiltro()
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla

		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_sucursal"

		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Total"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_cliente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nombre"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".FecEntrega"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Leyenda1"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Leyenda2"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column12.ControlSource = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Leyenda3"

		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Sumar("iif(Suma,1,-1)*Total",".t."),2)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange

			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
				ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
				ThisForm.oCmdGrabarFechaEntrega.Enabled=.f.
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Init
		dodefault(".t.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.oCmdGrabarFechaEntrega.Enabled = .f.
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimir
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias
		
		If nCopias>0 
			thisform.ImprimirComprobante(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias)
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimirlotes
		Local vDatos[1,2],nCopias
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			If  thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Imprime")
				Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
				nCopias     = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Copias")
				If nCopias  = 0
					nCopias = 1
				Endif
				Thisform.Imprimir(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),nCopias )	
			Endif
				
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantes", "Tg_ViewComprobantesEstados")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes"     , "tg_tabla", "Clientes", "clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas"      , "tg_tabla", "Monedas" , "clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros"   , "tg_tabla", "Parametros")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu"     , "tg_tabla", "Vnt_Docu", "Clave")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value = "TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value = "TD"
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbestadoscomproba1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbestadoscomproba1.Value = "TD"
		
		ThisForm.oChkSoloPendDesc.Value = .f.
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value = cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value = cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaEstadoDesde.Value = cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaEstadoHasta.Value = cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		ThisForm.oTbxFec_ModiDesde.Value = Ctod("  /  /  ")
		ThisForm.oTbxFec_ModiHasta.Value = Ctod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde       = Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta       = Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldFechaEstadoDesde = Thisform.oTbxFechaEstadoDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaEstadoHasta = Thisform.oTbxFechaEstadoHasta.Value
		
		thisform.OldId_moneda      = thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Sucursal    = thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor    = thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldSoloPendDesc   = ThisForm.oChkSoloPendDesc.Value
		thisform.OldEstadoComproba = ThisForm.Tg_cmbestadoscomproba1.Value
		
		Thisform.OldFec_ModiDesde  = ThisForm.oTbxFec_ModiDesde.Value
		Thisform.OldFec_ModiHasta  = ThisForm.oTbxFec_ModiHasta.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion = thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.CurrentControl = "TG_CHECKBOX1"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.Sparse         = .f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.ReadOnly       = .f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Cobranza")
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
		
		Else
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()	
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal,cId_vendedor,lAnulado, cId_EstadoComproba
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal = ""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal = ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		Endif
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
			cId_Vendedor = ""
		Else
			cId_Vendedor=ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value
		Endif
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbestadoscomproba1.Value="TD"
			cId_EstadoComproba = ""
		Else
			cId_EstadoComproba = ThisForm.Tg_cmbestadoscomproba1.Value
		Endif
		
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",cId_Sucursal,cId_vendedor,;
											 ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,;
											 ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),lAnulado,;
											 ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),;
											 ThisForm.oTbxFec_ModiDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFec_ModiHasta.Value,;
											 ThisForm.oChkSoloPendDesc.Value,cId_EstadoComproba,,,;
											 ThisForm.oTbxFechaEstadoDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaEstadoHasta.Value)
											 
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled  = .f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled = .t.
		ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled       = .t.
		ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled          = .t.
		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Total"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_cliente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Imprime"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Fec_Modi"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".FechaEstado"
		
		*!*	thisform.oCmdDetalle.Enabled=!thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsTablaVacia()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Sumar("iif(Suma,1,-1)*Total",".t."),2)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionar
		Local vDatos[1,2],lImprime
		
		If Alltrim(Upper(ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption))="NINGUNO"
			lImprime = .f.
		Else
			lImprime = .t.
		Endif
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Imprime",lImprime)
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EnDDo
		
		If lImprime 
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Ninguno"
		Else
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Seleccionar todo"
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkSoloPendDesc.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldSoloPendDesc
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
			ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldSoloPendDesc=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click

		thisform.tg_CommandButton1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdSeleccionar.Click

	ENDPROC

		ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled=.f.
		
		
	ENDPROC

			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled

	ENDPROC

			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled       = !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus

			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta

	ENDPROC

		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
				ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
				ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled=.F.
				ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled=.F.
		
			Endif	
		Endif

		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE enviarmail
		Local cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_comproba,nNro_referencia,cMail,cId_cliente,mmpp,cantPdfs,lHayAdjuntos, cBCC 
		Local cmail, cmailcliente, vPdfs[1], cId_clienteBusqueda
				
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		thisform.LockScreen = .t.
		
		If Type("oEmailItem")<>"O"
			oEmailItem = CreateObject("Tg_Mail")
		Endif
		
		If Type("thisform.oCstImprimecomprobantes")<>T_OBJECT
			thisform.AddObject("oCstImprimecomprobantes","Tg_ImprimeComprobantes")
		Endif
		
		mmpp = 0
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		Do While !thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			cId_sucursal 	= ThisForm.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
			cId_sistema 	= ThisForm.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema")
			cId_comproba 	= ThisForm.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba")
			nNro_referencia = ThisForm.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
			
			If thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Imprime")
			
				mmpp = mmpp + 1
			
				* Le paso copias 0 para que no imprima normalmente
				thisform.oCstImprimecomprobantes.ImprimirComprobante(cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_comproba,nNro_referencia,0,.f.,.f.,.f.,.f.,.null.,.t.,.t.,(mmpp=1),1)
				
			Endif
				
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		if oApp.oTblTerminal.Buscar(oApp.Maquina,.f.,"Clave")
		
			cPath_pdf = allt(oApp.oTblTerminal.Leer("Path_pdf"))
			CantPdfs = ADIR(vPdfs, cPath_pdf + "*.pdf") && Recupero todos los archivos pdf generados
			asor(vPdfs,1) && Lo ordeno por Id_cliente
			
			mmpp = 1
				
			do while mmpp<=CantPdfs
			
				cId_cliente = substr(vPdfs[mmpp,1],1,5)
				cId_clienteBusqueda = strtran(cId_cliente, "#", " ")
				
				cmail = ""
				cmailcliente = ""
				lHayAdjuntos=.f.
				
				Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Buscar(cId_clienteBusqueda+"V", .F., "CLAVECLI")
				Do while !thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.EsEof().and.Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.EsClaveIgual()
					If Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Leer("FE") And 	Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema") = "V"
						cmailcliente = alltrim(Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Leer("Email")) + "; "
						cmail = cmail + cmailcliente
					Endif
				
					Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.IrSiguiente()
				Enddo
				
				If ThisForm.oTblClientes.Buscar(cId_clienteBusqueda,.f.,"Clave") 
					cmail = cmail + alltrim(thisform.oTblClientes.leer("internet"))
						
					if !empty(cMail)
			
						cBCC = ""
						If Thisform.oTblUsuarios.Buscar(oApp.Usuario)
							cBCC = Thisform.oTblUsuarios.Leer("CCO")
						Endif
						
						oEmailItem.Generar(cMail," ",cBCC,"Se adjunta el comprobante correspondiente. ",Alltrim(Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Asunto_Mail")))
						
						do while mmpp<=CantPdfs and substr(vPdfs[mmpp,1],1,5)=cId_cliente
									
							if oEmailItem.Adjuntar(cPath_pdf + vPdfs[mmpp,1])
								lHayAdjuntos=.t.
							endif
					
							mmpp = mmpp + 1
						ENDDO
					ELSE
						=fMensAceptar("El cliente: " + cId_clienteBusqueda + ", no posee cuenta de mail para enviar el mismo!")
					endif
				endif
			
				if lHayAdjuntos
					oEmailItem.Enviar()
				endif
			enddo
		endif
		
		=fMensAceptar("La generación de comprobantes ha finalizado.")
		
		thisform.LockScreen = .f.
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimir
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias
		
		Local lSoloPendientesRomaneo, nOpcionImpresion, nCantCopiasRomaneo
		
		if type ("thisform.oImpresionRomaneo") = T_OBJECT
			lSoloPendientesRomaneo 	= thisform.oImpresionRomaneo.oChkPendRomaneo.Value
			nOpcionImpresion 		= thisform.oImpresionRomaneo.oOpgOpcion.Value
			nCantCopiasRomaneo 		= thisform.oImpresionRomaneo.Tg_Spinner1.Value
		endif
		
		If nCopias>0 
			thisform.ImprimirComprobante(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias,,lSoloPendientesRomaneo, nOpcionImpresion, nCantCopiasRomaneo, , .T.)
		Endif
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimirlotes
		Local vDatos[1,2],nCopias
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			If  thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Imprime")
				
				Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
				
				if !thisform.oChkAsignaCopias.Value
					nCopias = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Copias")
				else
					nCopias = Thisform.Tg_Spinner1.Value
				endif
				
				If nCopias=0
					nCopias = 1
				ENDIF
		
				Thisform.Imprimir(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),nCopias )	
			Endif
				
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimirvectorcomprobantes
		** Mariano 07/09/2018 ** 
		Local vComprobantes[1,6], vComprobantesImprimir[1,6], nCopias, nContador, lIngrese, i
		
		nContador = 1
		lIngrese = .F.
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		Do While !thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			if thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Imprime")
		
				if thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
					DIMENSION vComprobantes[nContador, 6]
					vComprobantes[nContador, 1] = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
					vComprobantes[nContador, 2] = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema")
					vComprobantes[nContador, 3] = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_comproba")
					vComprobantes[nContador, 4] = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("nro_referencia")
					if !thisform.oChkAsignaCopias.Value
						vComprobantes[nContador, 5] = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Copias")
					else
						vComprobantes[nContador, 5] = Thisform.Tg_Spinner1.Value
					endIf
					vComprobantes[nContador, 6] = thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("interlineadogrilla")	
					nContador = nContador + 1 
					lIngrese = .T.
				endIf	
			Endif		
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo	
		
		If lIngrese
			
			nRestoPosicion = 0
			For i = 1 To Alen(vComprobantes,1)
		
				DIMENSION vComprobantesImprimir[i, 6]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 1] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 1]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 2] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 2]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 3] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 3]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 4] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 4]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 5] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 5]
				vComprobantesImprimir[i, 6] = vComprobantes[Alen(vComprobantes,1)-nRestoPosicion, 6]
				nRestoPosicion = nRestoPosicion + 1
			EndFor	
		
			thisForm.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
			thisForm.imprimircomprobantesagrupados("", "", "", 0, 0, .F., .F., 0, 0,, .F., @vComprobantesImprimir)
		Endif
		** Mariano 07/09/2018 ** 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal,cId_vendedor,lAnulado, cId_EstadoComproba
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal=""
		Else
			cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		Endif
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
			cId_Vendedor=""
		Else
			cId_Vendedor=ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value
		Endif
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbestadoscomproba1.Value="TD"
			cId_EstadoComproba = ""
		Else

		Endif

		thisform.oViewComprobantes.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,Thisform.Tg_clientes1.value,cId_Sucursal,cId_vendedor,;
											 ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,;

											 ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),;
											 ThisForm.oTbxFec_ModiDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFec_ModiHasta.Value,;
											 ThisForm.oChkSoloPendDesc.Value,cId_EstadoComproba,,,ThisForm.oTbxReferencia.value,ThisForm.oTbxNumero.Value)
											 
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.oCmdMail.Enabled=.t.
		Thisform.oCmdImprimirSoloDocumento.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.oCmdAvanzado.Enabled=.t.

		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionar
		Local vDatos[1,2],lImprime
		
		If Alltrim(Upper(ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption))="NINGUNO"
			lImprime = .f.
		Else
			lImprime = .t.
		Endif
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Imprime",lImprime)
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EnDDo
		
		If lImprime 
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Ninguno"
		Else
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Seleccionar todo"
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularpendiente
		Local nColumn1,nColumn2,nColumn3
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		Thisform.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While !Thisform.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.EsEof()
		
			nColumn1 =	ThisForm.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.Leer("Column1")
			nColumn2 =	ThisForm.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.Leer("Column2")
			nColumn3 = 	ThisForm.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.Leer("Column3")
		
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Column4"	, nColumn1 - nColumn2 - nColumn3)
			ThisForm.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		
			ThisForm.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE cargararticulos
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		ThisForm.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.Revertir() && Borro todos los registros
		
		ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While !ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.EsEof()
		
				If Thisform.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.Buscar(ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("Id_Articulo"),.f.,"Clave")
		
					Do Case
						Case ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("ConsultaConsignacion") = 1
							=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Column1"					,ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("Cantidad"))
		
						Case ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("ConsultaConsignacion") = 2			
							=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Column2"					,ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("Cantidad"))
							
						Case ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("ConsultaConsignacion") = 3
							=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Column3"					,ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("Cantidad"))
					Endcase
		
					ThisForm.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
				
				Else
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo"				,ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Detalle"		  			,ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("Nombre"))
					
					** LUCHO M. 14/12/10
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio"		  			,ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("Precio"))
					** LUCHO M. 14/12/10
					
					Do Case
						Case ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("ConsultaConsignacion") = 1
							=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Column1"					,ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("Cantidad"))
		
						Case ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("ConsultaConsignacion") = 2			
							=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Column2"					,ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("Cantidad"))
							
						Case ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("ConsultaConsignacion") = 3
							=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Column3"					,ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("Cantidad"))
					Endcase
				
					ThisForm.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.T.)
				Endif				
		
			ThisForm.oViewConsignacionCliente.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		*****
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_cliente
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewConsignacionCliente","Tg_ViewConsignacionCliente")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes"			 ,"tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oAux_ConsignacionCliente","tg_tabla","Aux_ConsignacionCliente","clave")
		
		
		ThisForm.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.SetearProp("BOT")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.DesHabilitar()
		
		thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=Ctod("  /  /  ")
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=Ctod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		
		thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde   = Space(15)
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta   = Space(15)
		
		ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Habilitar()
		
		thisform.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.CurrentControl="oCmdMovimientos"
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		
		*!*	If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*		thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("Id_Comproba"),oViewConsignacionCliente.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
		*!*		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		*!*	Else
		*!*		Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosClienteDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
		*!*	Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarmovimientos
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaMovimientos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmconsconsignacionmovimientos","tg_consconsignacionmovimientos")				
		Endif
		Thisform.oFrmconsconsignacionmovimientos.MostrarMovimientos(thisform.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.Leer("Id_Articulo"),ThisForm.oTbxClienteDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxClienteHasta.Value,@vComprobantes,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value)			
		
		thisform.oFrmconsconsignacionmovimientos.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.oViewConsignacionCliente.Refrescar(thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value,@vComprobantes,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,thisform.Id_articuloDesde,thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta,thisform.Id_Marca,thisform.Id_Rubro,thisform.ID_Subrubro)
		
		*thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewConsignacionCliente.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
		Thisform.CargarArticulos()
		
		Thisform.CalcularPendiente()
		
		ThisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType	=1
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.Alias+".Detalle"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.Alias+".Column1"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.Alias+".Column2"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.Alias+".Column3"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.Alias+".Column4"
		
		** LUCHO M. 14/12/10
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.Alias+".Precio"
		** LUCHO M. 14/12/10
		
		thisform.oAux_ConsignacionCliente.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Parent.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdFiltroArticulos.Click
		If Type("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos","TG_FrmFiltroArticulos")				
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Show()
		
		IF  thisform.Id_articuloDesde<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde or ;
			thisform.Id_articuloHasta<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;	
			thisform.id_Marca<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca  or;
			thisform.id_rubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro  or;
			thisform.id_Subrubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro  
		
		
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.Id_articuloDesde=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde
		thisform.Id_articuloHasta=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta
		thisform.id_Marca=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca
		thisform.id_rubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro
		thisform.id_Subrubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxClienteDesde.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde=this.Value
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value=this.Value
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxClienteHasta.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column7.oCmdMovimientos.Click
		Thisform.MostrarMovimientos()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.Init
		dodefault("Consultaconsignacion>0")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.oCmdFiltroArticulos.Enabled = this.ExistenMarcados()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("ConsultaStock")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros"	,"Tg_Tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos"	,"Tg_Tabla","Articulos","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMarcas"		,"Tg_Tabla","Marcas","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblRubros"		,"Tg_Tabla","Rubros","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblSubRubros"	,"Tg_Tabla","SubRubros","Clave")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewConsignacionMovimientos"	,"Tg_ViewConsignacionMovimientos")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet","Tg_ViewConsignacionMovimientosDet")
		
		thisform.oTblParametros.IrPrimero()
		if thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("DiasCardex") = 0 or empty(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("DiasCardex"))
			thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		else
			thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=oApp.CargarFechaSistema() - thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("DiasCardex")
		endif	
		
		thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()
		
		thisform.OldFormato=thisform.oOpgOrden.Value
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(7,8,0,0,0)
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		
		If ThisForm.oOpgOrden.Value = 1
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","tg_consultacomprobante",thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientos.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientos.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientos.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientos.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)		
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		Else
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","tg_consultacomprobante",thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)		
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()	
		Endif
		
		
		
		
		
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarmovimientos
		lParameters cId_Articulo,cClienteDesde,cClienteHasta,vComprobantes,fFechaDesde,fFechaHasta
		
		thisform.id_Articulo=cId_Articulo
		
		Thisform.Id_ClienteDesde=cClienteDesde
		Thisform.Id_ClienteHasta=cClienteHasta
		
		thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(thisform.Id_articulo)
		thisform.oTblMarcas.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Marca"))
		thisform.oTblRubros.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Rubro"))
		thisform.oTblSubRubros.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_SubRubro"))
		
		ThisForm.oLblNombreArtículo.Caption=thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre") +"   "+"("+alltrim(thisform.Id_Articulo)+")" 
		ThisForm.oLblNombreMarca.Caption=thisform.oTblMarcas.Leer("Nombre")
		ThisForm.oLblNombreRubro.Caption=thisform.oTblRubros.Leer("Nombre")
		ThisForm.oLblNombreSubRubro.Caption=thisform.oTblSubRubros.Leer("Nombre")
		ThisForm.oLblClienteDesde.Caption=Thisform.Id_ClienteDesde
		ThisForm.oLblClienteHasta.Caption=Thisform.Id_ClienteHasta
		
		
		thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=fFechaDesde
		thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=fFechaHasta
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		If ThisForm.oOpgOrden.Value = 1
		
			thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientos.Refrescar(thisform.Id_Articulo,ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,Thisform.Id_ClienteDesde,Thisform.Id_ClienteHasta,@vComprobantes)

			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.Header1.Caption = "Salida"

			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientos.Alias+".CantidadSalida"

			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientos.Alias+".Id_Cliente"

			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.Header1.Caption = "Cant. Cons\Resv"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.Header1.Caption = "Cant. Devolución"	
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.Header1.Caption = "Cant. Facturada"
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Alias
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.Visible = .t.
		
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Alias+".NombreSistema"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Alias+".Nro_externo"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Alias+".Fecha"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Alias+".CantidadConsignacion"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Alias+".CantidadDevolucion"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Alias+".CantidadFacturada"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Alias+".Id_Cliente"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewConsignacionMovimientosDet.Alias+".Saldo"	
		Endif
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oOpgOrden.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFormato
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFormato=this.Value
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE TG_COMMANDBUTTON1.Click
		thisform.Hide
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC
