	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewPreciosArticulos" ,"Tg_ViewPreciosArticulosClienteMarca")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas"      	   ,"tg_tabla" ,"Monedas"  			,"Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblListaPrecios"	   ,"tg_tabla" ,"ListaPrecios"		,"Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes"	 	   ,"tg_tabla" ,"Clientes"			,"Clave")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisform.oViewPreciosArticulos.Alias
		
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbmarcas1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbrubros1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbsubrubros1.SetearTodos()
		
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbmarcas1.Value    = "TD"
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbrubros1.Value    = "TD"
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbsubrubros1.Value = "TD"
		
		Thisform.Tg_clientes1.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		Thisform.Tg_articulos1.SetearValorInicial(Space(15))
		Thisform.Tg_articulos2.SetearValorInicial(Space(15))
		
		thisform.OldId_Articulo1 = Space(15)
		thisform.OldId_Articulo2 = Space(15)
		Thisform.OldId_cliente1	= Space(5)
		
		Thisform.chkVerSoloDescuentos.Value = .F.
		*thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcuentacorriente
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.oViewPreciosArticulos.Refrescar(ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value,ThisForm.Tg_cmbmarcas1.Value,ThisForm.Tg_cmbrubros1.Value, ThisForm.Tg_cmbsubrubros1.Value,;
												ThisForm.Tg_articulos1.Value, ThisForm.Tg_articulos1.Value,ThisForm.Tg_cmblistaprecios1.Value, ThisForm.chkVerSoloDescuentos.Value)
											 
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisform.oViewPreciosArticulos.Alias
		
		Thisform.oViewPreciosArticulos.IrPrimero
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewPreciosArticulos.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosArticulos.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosArticulos.Alias+".NomArticulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosArticulos.Alias+".NomMarca"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosArticulos.Alias+".PrecioLista"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosArticulos.Alias+".DescArticulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosArticulos.Alias+".DescMarca"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosArticulos.Alias+".PrecioSinIva"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosArticulos.Alias+".PrecioConIva"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewPreciosArticulos.Alias+".PorcIva"
		
		Thisform.Tg_grid1.Columns(4).DynamicBackColor= "rgb(251,252,239)"
		Thisform.Tg_grid1.Columns(5).DynamicBackColor= "rgb(237,245,248)"
		Thisform.Tg_grid1.Columns(6).DynamicBackColor= "rgb(237,245,248)"
		Thisform.Tg_grid1.Columns(7).DynamicBackColor= "rgb(242,249,236)"
		Thisform.Tg_grid1.Columns(8).DynamicBackColor= "rgb(242,249,236)"
		
		
		thisform.oViewPreciosArticulos.IrPrimero
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validarconsulta
		
		If Empty(ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value)
			=fMensAceptar("Debe seleccionar un cliente para continuar!")
			Return(.F.)
		Endif
		
		If Empty(ThisForm.Tg_cmblistaprecios1.Value)
			=fMensAceptar("Debe seleccionar una lista de precios para continuar!")
			Return(.F.)
		Endif 
		
		Return(.T.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		If ThisForm.ValidarConsulta()
			ThisForm.RefrescarConsulta
			Thisform.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled = .T.
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_articulos1.Valid
		LPARAMETERS lanulamensaje
		local lvalido
		
		lvalido = .t.
		
		If  ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .F.
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Articulo1
		Endif	
		
		thisform.OldId_Articulo1 = this.Value
		
		return lvalido
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_articulos2.Valid
		LPARAMETERS lanulamensaje
		local lvalido
		
		lvalido = .t.
		
		If  ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .F.
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Articulo2
		Endif	
		
		thisform.OldId_Articulo2 = this.Value
		
		return lvalido
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.Valid
		LPARAMETERS lanulamensaje
		local lvalido
		
		lvalido = .t.
		
		If  ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .F.
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_cliente1
		Endif	
		
		thisform.OldId_cliente1 = this.Value
		
		If !Empty(this.Value)
			If Thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(this.Value, .f., "Clave")
				Thisform.lblRazon_Social.Caption = Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social")
			Endif
		Endif 
		return lvalido
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmblistaprecios1.InteractiveChange
		If !Empty(This.Value)
			If Thisform.oTblListaPrecios.Buscar(This.Value, .F., "CLAVE")
				If Thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(Thisform.oTblListaPrecios.Leer("Id_Moneda"), .F., "CLAVE")
					Thisform.lblMoneda.Caption = "Moneda de lista: " + Thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Nombre")
				Endif	
			Else
				Thisform.lblMoneda.Caption = "Moneda de lista: "
			Endif
		Else
			Thisform.lblMoneda.Caption = "Moneda de lista: "
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_MonedaPresentacion, lHistorico
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		cId_MonedaPresentacion=""
		If !ThisForm.oChkMonedaCuentaCorriente.Value
			cId_MonedaPresentacion=ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.tg_CmbMonedas1.Value
		Endif	
		
		**TENGO EL VALOR DE LA COTIZACION, SI LA QUIERE A HISTORICA O ACTUAL
		if thisform.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value = 1
			lHistorico = .t.
		else
			lHistorico = .f.
		endif
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		*edgardo pase version tasas ivas, le agrego el parametro oChkSaldosCero
		
		*** Chiara 01/03/21
		*If ThisForm.oChkMonedaCuentaCorriente.Value And Empty(thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.Value) And Empty(thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value) AND EMPTY(thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value) 
		If (ThisForm.oChkMonedaCuentaCorriente.Value AND EMPTY(thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value) AND EMPTY(thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value)) OR (thisForm.validarMonedaCta() AND EMPTY(thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value) AND EMPTY(thisForm.otbxFechaHasta.Value))
		*** Chiara 01/03/21
			thisform.oViewSaldosClientesNuevo.Refrescar(thisform.Tg_CmbProvincias1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbCobradores1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbCategorias1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_MonedaPresentacion,lHistorico,thisform.oChkSaldosCero.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbZonas1.Value)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientesNuevo.Alias
			Thisform.Grilla = .F.
			thisform.RefrescarGrillaIndividual()
		Else
			thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Refrescar(thisform.Tg_CmbProvincias1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbCobradores1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbCategorias1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_MonedaPresentacion,lHistorico,thisform.oChkSaldosCero.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbZonas1.Value)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias
			Thisform.Grilla = .T.
			thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		Endif
		
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias+".Id_Cliente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias+".Razon_Social"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias+".Saldo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias+".NombreMoneda"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias+".NombreCategoria"
		** Matias l. 06/12/2019
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias+".id_vendedor"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias+".NombreVendedor"
		** Matias l. 06/12/2019
		If !ThisForm.oChkMonedaCuentaCorriente.Value
			thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Sumar("Saldo",".t."),2)
		Else
			thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=0		
		Endif

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validarmonedacta
		*** Chiara 01/03/21
		LOCAL cId_Moneda, lContinua
		
		lContinua = .T.
		
		thisForm.oTblClientes.IrPrimero()
		cId_Moneda = thisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta")
		
		IF cId_Moneda = thisForm.tg_presentamoneda1.tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
			DO WHILE !thisForm.oTblClientes.EsEof()
				IF thisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta") <> cId_Moneda
					lContinua = .F.
				ENDIF 
		
				thisForm.oTblClientes.IrSiguiente()
			ENDDO 
		ELSE
			lContinua = .F.
		ENDIF 
		
		RETURN lContinua
		*** Chiara 01/03/21
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewSaldosClientes"		,"Tg_ViewSaldosClientes")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewSaldosClientesNuevo"	,"Tg_ViewSaldosClientesNuevo")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros"				,"Tg_Tabla","Parametros")
		
		*** Chiara 01/03/21
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes"				,"Tg_Tabla","Clientes","Clave")
		*** Chiara 01/03/21
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias
		
		thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		
		
		thisform.tg_cmbProvincias1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbCobradores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbCategorias1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbZonas1.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.tg_cmbProvincias1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbCobradores1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbCategorias1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbZonas1.Value="TD"
		
		*thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.tg_cmbMonedas1.IrPrimero
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion    = thisform.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
		
		thisform.OldId_Provincia      = thisform.Tg_CmbProvincias1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Cobrador       = thisform.Tg_CmbCobradores1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Categoria      = thisform.Tg_CmbCategorias1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor       = thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Zona			  = thisform.Tg_CmbZonas1.Value
		thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde   = Space(15)
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta   = Space(15)
		thisform.OldId_Moneda         = Space(3)
		thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value = Ctod("  /  /  ")
		thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value = Ctod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaHasta = Ctod("  /  /  ")
		thisform.OldFechaDesde = Ctod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=0		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcuentacorriente
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCuentaCorriente","TG_CtaCorrienteClientes",Iif(Thisform.Grilla,thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Leer("Id_Cliente"),thisform.oViewSaldosClientesNuevo.Leer("Id_Cliente")))				
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaCuentaCorriente.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_MonedaPresentacion, lHistorico
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		cId_MonedaPresentacion=""
		If !ThisForm.oChkMonedaCuentaCorriente.Value
			cId_MonedaPresentacion=ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.tg_CmbMonedas1.Value
		Endif	
		
		**TENGO EL VALOR DE LA COTIZACION, SI LA QUIERE A HISTORICA O ACTUAL
		if thisform.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value = 1
			lHistorico = .t.
		else
			lHistorico = .f.
		endif
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		*edgardo pase version tasas ivas, le agrego el parametro oChkSaldosCero
		
		*** Chiara 01/03/21
		*If ThisForm.oChkMonedaCuentaCorriente.Value And Empty(thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.Value) And Empty(thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value) AND EMPTY(thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value) 
		If (ThisForm.oChkMonedaCuentaCorriente.Value AND EMPTY(thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value) AND EMPTY(thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value)) OR (thisForm.validarMonedaCta() AND EMPTY(thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value) AND EMPTY(thisForm.otbxFechaHasta.Value))
		*** Chiara 01/03/21
			thisform.oViewSaldosClientesNuevo.Refrescar(thisform.Tg_CmbProvincias1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbCobradores1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbCategorias1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_MonedaPresentacion,lHistorico,thisform.oChkSaldosCero.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbZonas1.Value)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientesNuevo.Alias
			Thisform.Grilla = .F.
			thisform.RefrescarGrillaIndividual()
		Else
			thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Refrescar(thisform.Tg_CmbProvincias1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbCobradores1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbCategorias1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_MonedaPresentacion,lHistorico,thisform.oChkSaldosCero.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbZonas1.Value)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias
			Thisform.Grilla = .T.
			thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		Endif
		
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""

	PROCEDURE validarmonedacta
		*** Chiara 01/03/21
		LOCAL cId_Moneda, lContinua
		
		lContinua = .T.
		
		thisForm.oTblClientes.IrPrimero()
		cId_Moneda = thisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta")
		
		IF cId_Moneda = thisForm.tg_presentamoneda1.tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
			DO WHILE !thisForm.oTblClientes.EsEof()
				IF thisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta") <> cId_Moneda
					lContinua = .F.
				ENDIF 
		
				thisForm.oTblClientes.IrSiguiente()
			ENDDO 
		ELSE
			lContinua = .F.
		ENDIF 
		
		RETURN lContinua
		*** Chiara 01/03/21
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewSaldosClientes"		,"Tg_ViewSaldosClientes")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewSaldosClientesNuevo"	,"Tg_ViewSaldosClientesNuevo")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros"				,"Tg_Tabla","Parametros")
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias
		
		thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.SetearValorInicial(Space(5))
		
		
		thisform.tg_cmbProvincias1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbCobradores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbCategorias1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbZonas1.SetearTodos()
		
		thisform.tg_cmbProvincias1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbCobradores1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbCategorias1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		thisform.tg_cmbZonas1.Value="TD"
		
		*thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.tg_cmbMonedas1.IrPrimero
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion    = thisform.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
		
		thisform.OldId_Provincia      = thisform.Tg_CmbProvincias1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Cobrador       = thisform.Tg_CmbCobradores1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Categoria      = thisform.Tg_CmbCategorias1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Vendedor       = thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Zona			  = thisform.Tg_CmbZonas1.Value
		thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde   = Space(15)
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta   = Space(15)
		thisform.OldId_Moneda         = Space(3)
		thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value = Ctod("  /  /  ")
		thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value = Ctod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaHasta = Ctod("  /  /  ")
		thisform.OldFechaDesde = Ctod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=0		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcuentacorriente
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCuentaCorriente","TG_CtaCorrienteClientes",Iif(Thisform.Grilla,thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Leer("Id_Cliente"),thisform.oViewSaldosClientesNuevo.Leer("Id_Cliente")))				
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaCuentaCorriente.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_MonedaPresentacion, lHistorico
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		cId_MonedaPresentacion=""
		If !ThisForm.oChkMonedaCuentaCorriente.Value
			cId_MonedaPresentacion=ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.tg_CmbMonedas1.Value
		Endif	
		
		**TENGO EL VALOR DE LA COTIZACION, SI LA QUIERE A HISTORICA O ACTUAL
		if thisform.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value = 1
			lHistorico = .t.
		else
			lHistorico = .f.
		endif
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		*edgardo pase version tasas ivas, le agrego el parametro oChkSaldosCero
		
		
		If ThisForm.oChkMonedaCuentaCorriente.Value And Empty(thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.Value) And Empty(thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value) AND EMPTY(thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value)
			thisform.oViewSaldosClientesNuevo.Refrescar(thisform.Tg_CmbProvincias1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbCobradores1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbCategorias1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_MonedaPresentacion,lHistorico,thisform.oChkSaldosCero.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbZonas1.Value)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientesNuevo.Alias
			Thisform.Grilla = .F.
			thisform.RefrescarGrillaIndividual()
		Else
			thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Refrescar(thisform.Tg_CmbProvincias1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbCobradores1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbCategorias1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbVendedores1.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,cId_MonedaPresentacion,lHistorico,thisform.oChkSaldosCero.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbZonas1.Value)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias
			Thisform.Grilla = .T.
			thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		Endif
		
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias+".Id_Cliente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias+".Razon_Social"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias+".Saldo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias+".NombreMoneda"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias+".NombreCategoria"
		** Matias l. 06/12/2019
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias+".id_vendedor"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Alias+".NombreVendedor"
		** Matias l. 06/12/2019
		If !ThisForm.oChkMonedaCuentaCorriente.Value
			thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oViewSaldosClientes.Sumar("Saldo",".t."),2)
		Else
			thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=0		
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrillaindividual
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientesNuevo.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientesNuevo.Alias+".Id_Cliente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientesNuevo.Alias+".Razon_Social"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientesNuevo.Alias+".Saldo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientesNuevo.Alias+".NombreMoneda"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientesNuevo.Alias+".NombreCategoria"
		** Matias l. 06/12/2019
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientesNuevo.Alias+".id_vendedor"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewSaldosClientesNuevo.Alias+".NombreVendedor"
		** Matias l. 06/12/2019
		If !ThisForm.oChkMonedaCuentaCorriente.Value
			thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oViewSaldosClientesNuevo.Sumar("Saldo",".t."),2)
		Else
			thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=0		
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkMonedaCuentaCorriente.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldMonedaCuentaCorriente
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldMonedaCuentaCorriente=this.Value
		
		** SE AGREGA LA OPCION DE PODER SACAR EL SALDO A COTIZACION HISTORICA O ACTUAL
		thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.Enabled                    = !this.Value
		ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.Tg_CmbMonedas1.Enabled     = !this.Value
		ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Enabled = !this.Value
		******************************************************************************
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkSaldosCero.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldMostrarSinSaldo
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldMostrarSinSaldo=this.Value
		
		** SE AGREGA LA OPCION DE PODER SACAR EL SALDO A COTIZACION HISTORICA O ACTUAL
		thisform.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.Enabled                    = !this.Value
		ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.Tg_CmbMonedas1.Enabled     = !this.Value
		ThisForm.Tg_PresentaMoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Enabled = !this.Value
		******************************************************************************
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxClienteDesde.LostFocus
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ClienteDesde=this.Value
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value=this.Value
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxClienteHasta.LostFocus

		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_ClienteHasta=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimir
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias
		
		If nCopias>0 
			thisform.ImprimirComprobante(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cComprobante,nReferencia,nCopias)
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE imprimirlotes
		Local vDatos[1,2],nCopias
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			If  thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Imprime")
				Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
				
				if !thisform.oChkAsignaCopias.Value
					nCopias = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Copias")
				else
					nCopias = Thisform.Tg_Spinner1.Value
				endif
				
				If nCopias=0
					nCopias = 1
				Endif
				Thisform.Imprimir(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),nCopias )	
			Endif
				
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantes","Tg_ViewComprobantesSerializacionVentas")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Operaciones","tg_tabla","Vnt_Operaciones","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu","tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("Tg_MenuLib1","tg_MenuLib")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		*!*	ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.DesHabilitar()
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		*thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.SetearTodos()
		*thisform.tg_cmbSucursales1.Value="TD"
		thisform.Tg_cmbestadoscomproba1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.Tg_cmbestadoscomproba1.Value="TD"
		
		ThisForm.oChkSoloPendDesc.Value = .f.
		thisform.oChkTodas.Value = .t.
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		ThisForm.oTbxFec_ModiDesde.Value=Ctod("  /  /  ")
		ThisForm.oTbxFec_ModiHasta.Value=Ctod("  /  /  ")
		
		
		thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDASOLOEXPRESION  
		thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.SetearValorInicial(Space(15))
		thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.SetearValorInicial(Space(15))
		
		
		thisform.OldArticuloDesde=Thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value
		thisform.OldArticuloHasta=Thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value
		
		thisform.OldSerieDesde=Thisform.oTbxSerieDesde.Value
		thisform.OldSerieHasta=Thisform.oTbxSerieHasta.Value
		
		ThisForm.oChkTodas.Value = .f.
		
		ThisForm.oTbxNumeroDesde.Value = 0
		ThisForm.oTbxNumeroHasta.Value = 0
		
		thisform.OldTodas   = ThisForm.oChkTodas.Value
		
		Thisform.OldNumeroDesde  = ThisForm.oTbxNumeroDesde.Value
		Thisform.OldNumeroHasta  = ThisForm.oTbxNumeroHasta.Value
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde     = Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta     = Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		
		thisform.OldId_moneda      = thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		*thisform.OldId_Sucursal    = thisform.Tg_CmbSucursales1.Value
		thisform.OldEstadoComproba  = thisform.Tg_cmbestadoscomproba1.Value
		thisform.OldSoloPendDesc   = ThisForm.oChkSoloPendDesc.Value
		
		Thisform.OldFec_ModiDesde  = ThisForm.oTbxFec_ModiDesde.Value
		Thisform.OldFec_ModiHasta  = ThisForm.oTbxFec_ModiHasta.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion = thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.CurrentControl="TG_CHECKBOX1"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.Sparse=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.ReadOnly=.f.
		
		** AGREGADO PARA LA IMPRESION DE COMPROBANTES CON UN NUMERO DE COPIAS FIJO
		thisform.Tg_Spinner1.Enabled    = .f.
		thisform.Tg_Spinner1.Value      = 1  && 1 copia por defecto
		thisform.oChkAsignaCopias.Value = .f.
		*************************************
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Cobranza")
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
		
		Else
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()	
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarmenu
		*!*	lParameters oLst
		Local vVector[2]
		
		vVector[1]="Consultar Comprobante General..."
		vVector[2]="Consultar Serialización Comprobante...    "
		
		ThisForm.Tg_menulib1.ShowMenu(@vVector)
		
		Do case 
			Case Bar()=1
		*!*			thisform.MostrarComprobante(oLst)
					thisform.MostrarComprobante
			Case Bar()=2
		*!*			thisform.MostrarCambioImporte(oLst)
					thisform.MostrarSerializacionComprobante
		
		EndCase	
		
		Return 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarserializacioncomprobante

		Endif

														oApp.CodSistema("Ventas"),;
														thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),;

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_sucursal,cId_vendedor,lAnulado, cId_EstadoComproba
		*If ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value="TD"
			cId_Sucursal=""
		*Else
		*	cId_Sucursal=ThisForm.Tg_cmbsucursales1.Value
		*Endif
		
		
		If thisform.Tg_cmbestadoscomproba1.Value="TD"
			cId_EstadoComproba=""
		Else
			cId_EstadoComproba=thisform.Tg_cmbestadoscomproba1.Value
		Endif
		
		
		lTodasOperaciones = thisform.ochkTodas.Value
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantes1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",cId_Sucursal,;
											 ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value,;
											 ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),;
											 thisform.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value, thisform.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value,lAnulado,;
											 ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),;
											 ThisForm.oTbxFec_ModiDesde.Value,ThisForm.oTbxFec_ModiHasta.Value,;
											 ThisForm.oChkSoloPendDesc.Value,;
											 lTodasOperaciones, thisform.Tg_Vnt_Operaciones1.Value,;
											 thisform.oTbxNumeroDesde.Value, thisform.oTbxNumeroHasta.Value,;
											 thisform.oTbxSerieDesde.Value, thisform.oTbxSerieHasta.Value, cId_EstadoComproba)
											 
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.oCmdImprimir.Enabled=.t.
		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
	ENDPROC

		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Total"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_cliente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Imprime"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Fec_Modi"

		thisform.tg_grid1.Column14.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".NombreEstado"

		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Sumar("iif(Suma,1,-1)*Total",".t."),2)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE seleccionar
		Local vDatos[1,2],lImprime
		
		If Alltrim(Upper(ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption))="NINGUNO"
			lImprime = .f.
		Else
			lImprime = .t.
		Endif
		
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not thisform.oViewComprobantes.EsEof()
			
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Imprime",lImprime)
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.Modificar(@vDatos,.f.,.t.)
			thisform.oViewComprobantes.IrSiguiente()
		EnDDo
		
		If lImprime 
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Ninguno"
		Else
			ThisForm.oCmdSeleccionar.Caption="Seleccionar todo"
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE consultar
		Local cId_Cliente,dFechaAltaDesde,dFechaAltaHasta,cId_MonedaPresentacion,nTipoCotizacion,nSaldo,vResultado
		
		If Thisform.Validar()
			Thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
			cId_Cliente							= ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value
			dFechaAltaDesde					=	Ctod(" ")
			dFechaAltaHasta					=	oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()
			cId_MonedaPresentacion	=	ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
			nTipoCotizacion					=	ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
			nSaldo 									= 0
			
			Thisform.DesSetearGrilla()
			Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Refrescar(cId_Cliente,dFechaAltaDesde,dFechaAltaHasta,cId_MonedaPresentacion,nTipoCotizacion,@nSaldo,@vResultado,thisform.Id_ValorUnico,Thisform.Id_EstadoUnico)
			Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
			ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.Value=Thisform.DarSaldo()
			***** Martin 
			If ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.Value > 0 
				ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.enabled=.t.
			Else
				ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.enabled=.f.	
			Endif
			****** Martin
			Thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE darsaldo
		Local nSaldo
		
		nSaldo = 0
		
		Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.IrPrimero()
		
		Do While Not Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.EsEof()
			nSaldo= nSaldo + Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Leer("monto")
			Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.IrPrimero()
		
		Return nSaldo
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE desseteargrilla
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
		LParameters cId_Cliente,cId_moneda,nTipoCotizacion,cId_ValorUnico,cId_EstadoUnico,lOcultar
		
		Thisform.DesSetearGrilla()
		Thisform.Ocultar=lOcultar
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value=cId_Cliente
		ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Enabled=.f.
		thisform.Id_ValorUnico	=	cId_ValorUnico
		Thisform.Id_EstadoUnico	=	cId_EstadoUnico
		
		If Thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(cId_Cliente,.f.,"Clave")
			Thisform.Caption="Valores pendientes de " + Alltrim(Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("razon_social"))
		Else
			Thisform.Caption="Valores pendientes"
		Endif	
		
		
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value=cId_moneda
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value=nTipoCotizacion
		ThisForm.oCmdconsultar.Enabled=.f.
		Thisform.Consultar()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE escobranza
		LParameters cId_comproba
		
		Thisform.oTblVnt_docu.Buscar(cId_comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		Return Thisform.oTblVnt_docu.Leer("Cobranza")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE espago
		LParameters cId_comproba
		
		Thisform.oTblCmp_docu.Buscar(cId_comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		Return Thisform.oTblCmp_docu.Leer("Pago")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LParameters cId_Cliente,cId_moneda,nTipoCotizacion,cId_ValorUnico,cId_EstadoUnico,lOcultar
		
		DoDefault()
		
		Thisform.Ocultar=lOcultar
		ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.Value=0
		thisform.Addobject("oViewvaloresentregadosclientes","tg_viewvaloresentregadosclientes")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu","Tg_Tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCmp_docu","Tg_Tabla","Cmp_Docu","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","Tg_Tabla","Clientes","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","Tg_Tabla","Parametros")
		****** Martin
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCaj_Valores","Tg_Tabla","Caj_Valores","Clave")
		****** Martin
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value=ThisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("mon_def")
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon()
		Thisform.DesSetearGrilla()
		
		If Type("cId_Cliente") <> "L"
			thisForm.EjecutarConsulta(cId_Cliente,cId_moneda,nTipoCotizacion,cId_ValorUnico,cId_EstadoUnico,lOcultar)
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cId_comprobante,nReferencia,cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,lOcultar,cId_sistemaLlamador
		
		cId_comproba    =	ThisForm.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		nNro_Referencia	=	ThisForm.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
		cId_sucursal		=	ThisForm.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
		cId_sistema			=	ThisForm.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Leer("Id_Sistema")
		
		cId_sistemaLlamador=oApp.CodSistema(oApp.NomSistema("V"))
		lOcultar=.T.
		Do Case
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")
			  If ThisForm.EsCobranza(cId_Comproba)
			 		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
				Else	  
			  	If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
				Endif
			Case CId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Compras")
				If ThisForm.EsPago(cId_Comproba)	
					If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago","TG_ConsultaPago",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.ConsultarPago(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.Show()
				Else	
					If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()
				Endif	
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Banco")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos","TG_ConsCompBanco",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.ConsultarCompBanco(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.Show()
				
			Case cId_sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Caja")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja","TG_ConsCompCaja",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.ConsultarCompCaja(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.Show()
		
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Cobradores")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores","TG_ConsCompCobradores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.ConsultarCompCobradores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.Show()
				
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores","TG_ConsCompVendedores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.ConsultarCompVendedores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.Show()
				
		EndCase
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarvalor
		***** Martin
		Local cId_Sucursal,cId_Valor,cTipo,nOrden,cId_Moneda,nMonto,cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia
		
		cId_Sucursal = ThisForm.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
		cId_Valor		 = ThisForm.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Leer("Id_Valor")	
		nOrden			 = ThisForm.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Leer("Orden")
		cId_Moneda   = ThisForm.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Leer("Id_Moneda")
		nMonto			 = ThisForm.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Leer("Monto")
		
		cId_Sucursal = Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
		cId_Sistema = Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Leer("Id_Sistema")
		cId_Comproba = Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		nNro_Referencia = Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
		
		
		Thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Buscar(cId_Valor,.f.,"Clave")
		cTipo = Thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Id_Tipo")
		
		
		Do case
		
			case cTipo="EF"
					If Type("this.oFrmValorEfectivo")<>T_OBJECT
						this.CrearYAsignarObjeto("this.oFrmValorEfectivo","tg_ValorEfectivo")
					Endif				
					this.oFrmValorEfectivo.MostrarConsulta(cId_Valor,cId_Moneda,nMonto)
					
			case cTipo="RT"
					If Type("this.oFrmValorRetencion")<>T_OBJECT
						this.CrearYAsignarObjeto("this.oFrmValorRetencion","tg_ValorRetencion")
					Endif			
					this.oFrmValorRetencion.MostrarConsulta(cId_Valor,cId_Sucursal,nOrden,cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba)
					
			case cTipo="DB"
					If Type("this.oFrmValorDeposito")<>T_OBJECT
						this.CrearYAsignarObjeto("this.oFrmValorDeposito","tg_ValorDeposito")
					Endif
					this.oFrmValorDeposito.MostrarConsulta(cId_Valor,cId_Sucursal,nOrden)
		
			case cTipo="CP"
					If Type("this.oFrmValorChequePropio")<>T_OBJECT
						this.CrearYAsignarObjeto("this.oFrmValorChequePropio","tg_ValorChequePropio")
					Endif
					this.oFrmValorChequePropio.MostrarConsulta(cId_Valor,cId_Sucursal,nOrden,cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba)
					
			case cTipo="CH"
					If Type("this.oFrmValorCheque")<>T_OBJECT
						this.CrearYAsignarObjeto("this.oFrmValorCheque","tg_ValorCheque")
		  		Endif			
					this.oFrmValorCheque.MostrarConsulta(cId_Valor,cId_Sucursal,nOrden,cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba)
					
			case cTipo="PG"
					If Type("this.oFrmValorPagare")<>T_OBJECT
						this.CrearYAsignarObjeto("this.oFrmValorPagare","tg_ValorPagare")				
					Endif
					this.oFrmValorPagare.MostrarConsulta(cId_Valor,cId_Sucursal,nOrden,cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba)
		
			case cTipo="PP"
					If Type("this.oFrmValorPagarePropio")<>T_OBJECT
						this.CrearYAsignarObjeto("this.oFrmValorPagarePropio","tg_ValorPagarePropio")				
					Endif
					this.oFrmValorPagarePropio.MostrarConsulta(cId_Valor,cId_Sucursal,nOrden,cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba)
		
			case cTipo="DS"
					If Type("this.oFrmValorDescuento")<>T_OBJECT
						this.CrearYAsignarObjeto("this.oFrmValorDescuento","tg_ValorDescuento")
					Endif
					this.oFrmValorDescuento.MostrarConsulta(cId_Valor,cId_Sucursal,nOrden)
					
			case cTipo="CU"
					If Type("this.oFrmValorCupon")<>T_OBJECT
						this.CrearYAsignarObjeto("this.oFrmValorCupon","tg_ValorCupon")
					Endif			
					this.oFrmValorCupon.MostrarConsulta(cId_Valor,cId_Sucursal,nOrden,cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba)
					
					
		EndCase		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Else
			Thisform.Release	
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Thisform.LockScreen=.t.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Alias
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Alias + ".Id_Sucursal"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Alias + ".NombreSistema"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Alias + ".Id_Comproba"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Alias + ".Nro_Referencia"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Alias + ".Orden"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Alias + ".NombreValor"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Alias + ".NombreMoneda"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Alias + ".Monto"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Alias + ".NombreEstado"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewvaloresentregadosclientes.Alias + ".Fecha_Venc"
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
		Thisform.LockScreen=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validar
		If Empty(ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value)
			=fMensAceptar("Debe indicar el cliente que desea saber el saldo!")
			ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		If Empty(ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value) 
			=fMensAceptar("Debe indicar la moneda de presentacion!")
			ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		
		
		Return .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdconsultar.Click
		Thisform.Consultar
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		****** Martin
		Thisform.MostrarValor()
		****** Martin
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE consultar
		lParameters cId_Cliente,lOcultar
		
		If Type("cId_cliente")<>T_LOGICAL
			Thisform.LockScreen = .t.
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Value=cId_cliente
			thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Valid
			thisform.tg_clientes1.LostFocus
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Enabled=.f.
			
			Thisform.LockScreen = .f.
		Endif
		
		If !lOcultar And Empty(cId_cliente)
			ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.SetFocus()
		Endif
		
		Thisform.Ocultar = lOcultar
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_cliente,lOcultar
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewCtaCorrienteClientes","Tg_ViewCtaCorrienteClientes")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVendedores","tg_tabla","Vendedores","clave")
		
		*** Matias L. 04/01/2022 #1561
		thisform.AddObject("oTblComp_Leyendas","tg_tabla","Comp_Leyendas","clave")
		*** Matias L. 04/01/2022 #1561
		
		*** Martin
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblGruposEmpresarios","Tg_Tabla","GruposEmpresarios","Clave")
		*** Martin
		thisform.Recno=1
		
		For mmpp=2 to thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount
		
			thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).dynamicBackcolor="iif(thisform.recno=Recno(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255))"
			thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).dynamicForecolor="iif(thisform.recno=Recno(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0))"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(mmpp).Text1.BackColor=rgb(0,0,0)
			thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(mmpp).Text1.ForeColor=rgb(255,255,255)
				
		EndFor
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.DynamicForeColor="iif(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer('Debe')=0,iif(thisform.recno=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Recno(),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255)),iif(thisform.recno=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Recno(),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0)))"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.DynamicForeColor="iif(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer('Haber')=0,iif(thisform.recno=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Recno(),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255)),iif(thisform.recno=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Recno(),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0)))"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.DynamicFontBold="iif(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer('Nro_referencia')=0,.t.,.f.)"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.DynamicBackColor="iif("+thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".ImpPendiente<>0,iif(oApp.CargarFechaSistema()>"+thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".Proximo_Vencimiento,Rgb(206,70,111),rgb(0,128,192)),rgb(0,0,0))"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ForeColor=rgb(255,255,255)
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias
		thisform.tg_clientes1.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDAEXISTENCIA 
		
		* edgardo pase version tasas ivas
		* ripples fecha desde hasta cuenta corriente
		*Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value = Ctod("  /  /  ")
		*Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value = Ctod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.Tg_cmbgrupossucur1.visible = .f.
		
		thisform.addObject("oTblParametros","Tg_Tabla","Parametros")
		
		If This.oTblParametros.Leer("SeleccionGrupoSucur")
			Thisform.Tg_cmbgrupossucur1.setearTodos()
		
			Thisform.Tg_cmbgrupossucur1.visible = .t.
			Thisform.Tg_cmbgrupossucur1.Value="TD"		
			Thisform.ComboAgrupamientoHabilitado = .t.
		Else
			Thisform.ComboAgrupamientoHabilitado = .f.
		Endif
		
		thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value = Ctod("  /  /  ")
		thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value = Ctod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		
		thisform.lPrimeraVez=.t.
		
		Thisform.consultar(cId_Cliente,lOcultar)
		
		
		*** No podemos usar resaltar renglon ya que seteo otros dynamikcolor que no tienen
		*** que ver con el resaltado sino mas bien con el estado del comprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If alltrim(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"))<>""
			If thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Cobranza")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)
				Else
					thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
			Else	
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			Endif	
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarleyendas
		IF thisform.oTblComp_Leyendas.Buscar(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.leer("Id_Comproba")+oApp.CodSistema("VENTAS"),.f.,"clave")
			if type("thisform.oDatosLeyenda")<>"O" OR ISNULL(thisform.oDatosLeyenda)
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oDatosLeyenda","TG_DatosLeyendas",oApp.CodSistema("VENTAS"))
			ENDIF
		
			thisform.oDatosLeyenda.Setup(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.tg_clientes1.value,thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.leer("nro_referencia"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.leer("id_sucursal"),oApp.CodSistema("VENTAS"))
			thisform.oDatosLeyenda.SetearEdicion()
			thisform.oDAtosLeyenda.Show()
			thisform.oDAtosLeyenda.release
		ELSE
			=fMensAceptar("El comprobante no posee leyendas.")
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta(.F.)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters lMoverFocus
		
		
		
		IF Thisform.lPrimeraVez
		     
			Thisform.nAnchoColumna8=ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.Width
			Thisform.nAnchocolumna10=ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column10.Width
		
		Endif
		
		Thisform.lPrimeraVez=.f.
		
		** LUCAS 27/07/2011
		Thisform.VisualizarConsulta = .T.
		
		If thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("RelacionUsuarioVendedor")
			If thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value, .T., "CLAVE")
				IF Thisform.oTblVendedores.Buscar(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Vendedor"), .T., "CLAVE")
					If !oApp.PedirPermiso("PRO","CONFECCIONARFACCOB",.f.,.f.,oApp.CodUsuario())
						If Thisform.oTblVendedores.Leer("Id_Usuario") <> oApp.Usuario
							Thisform.VisualizarConsulta = .F.
							=fmensAceptar("El cliente no pertence al usuario, no se visualizará la cta. cte.")
						Endif				
					Endif
				Endif
			Endif
		Endif
		** LUCAS 27/07/2011	
		
		
		
		
		** 03-08 19-10-2011	
			  If thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value, .T., "CLAVE")
			    if Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("filtro_vendedorusuario")	
				    IF !oApp.PedirPermiso("PRO","SALTEAFILTRO",.f.,.f.,oApp.CodUsuario())

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.Valid
		local lValida
		lValida=tg_textclave::valid()
		
		if lValida.and.!this.FormDesactivado.and.!thisform.ClienteValidado
				
				thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(this.Value)
				ThisForm.RazonSocial.Value=thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social")
				
		
				*** Martin
				If Thisform.oTblGruposEmpresarios.Buscar(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_GrupoEmpresario"),.f.,"Clave")
					Thisform.Id_GrupoEmpresario = thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_GrupoEmpresario")
					ThisForm.oCmdGrupoEmpresario.Enabled = !Thisform.oTblGruposEmpresarios.Leer("Defecto")
				Else
					Thisform.Id_GrupoEmpresario = Space(3)
					ThisForm.oCmdGrupoEmpresario.Enabled = .f.
				Endif	
				*** Martin
				
				ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
				
				thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
				thisform.SignoMonedaCtaCorriente=thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Signo")
		*!*			thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Refrescar(this.Value,ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value)
				thisform.ClienteValidado=.t.
		endif
		
		
		
		If (thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida).and.!this.FormDesactivado
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.t.
		Else
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.f.
		Endif	
		
		
		
		Return thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE consultar
		lParameters cId_Cliente,lOcultar
		
		If Type("cId_cliente")<>T_LOGICAL
			Thisform.LockScreen = .t.
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Value=cId_cliente
			thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Valid
			thisform.tg_clientes1.LostFocus
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Enabled=.f.
			Thisform.LockScreen = .f.
		Endif
		
		If !lOcultar And Empty(cId_cliente)
			ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.SetFocus()
		Endif
		
		Thisform.Ocultar = lOcultar
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_cliente,lOcultar
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewCtaCorrienteClientes","Tg_ViewCtaCorrienteClientes")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")

		*** Martin
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblGruposEmpresarios","Tg_Tabla","GruposEmpresarios","Clave")
		*** Martin
		thisform.Recno=1
		
		For mmpp=2 to thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount
		
			thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).dynamicBackcolor="iif(thisform.recno=Recno(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255))"
			thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).dynamicForecolor="iif(thisform.recno=Recno(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0))"

			thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(mmpp).Text1.ForeColor=rgb(255,255,255)
				
		EndFor
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.DynamicForeColor="iif(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer('Debe')=0,iif(thisform.recno=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Recno(),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255)),iif(thisform.recno=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Recno(),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0)))"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.DynamicForeColor="iif(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer('Haber')=0,iif(thisform.recno=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Recno(),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255)),iif(thisform.recno=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Recno(),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0)))"

		* edgardo pase version tasas ivas

		*Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value = Ctod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.Tg_cmbgrupossucur1.visible = .f.

			Thisform.Tg_cmbgrupossucur1.setearTodos()

		Endif

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If alltrim(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"))<>""
			If thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Cobranza")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)
				Else
					thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
			Else	
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			Endif	
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta(.F.)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		lParameters lLlevaFocoAGrilla
		
		
		
		** Parametro intocable porque a veces no puedo hacer el setfocus cuando se hace
		** un refrescarAplicacion desde otro objeto, este no puede tomar el foco sino
		** se lo debe dejar al otro objeto sin quitarselo
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".Debe"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".Haber"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".Saldo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".ImpPendiente"
		
		* ripples 1
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".SaldoPendiente"
		***
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".NombreCmp"
		
		thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda())
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_label4.Caption=Str(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Sumar("ImpPendiente","Proximo_Vencimiento>=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()"),10,2)+"   "+thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Signo")
		thisform.tg_label5.Caption=str(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Sumar("ImpPendiente","Proximo_Vencimiento<oApp.CargarFechaSistema()"),10,2)+"   "+thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Signo")
		thisform.tg_label6.Caption=Str(Val(thisform.tg_label4.Caption)+Val(thisform.tg_label5.Caption),13,2)+"   "+thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Signo")
		
		
		*!*	thisform.oCmdDetalle.Enabled=!thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.EsTablaVacia()
		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		If lLlevaFocoAGrilla
			thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
			thisform.ClienteValidado=.f.  && Este setfocus produce otro valid del cliente
		Endif							  && Pongo este flag para que no cargue la vista de nuevo
		
		
		thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.IrUltimo
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.Valid
		local lValida
		lValida=tg_textclave::valid()
		if lValida.and.!this.FormDesactivado.and.!thisform.ClienteValidado
				
				thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(this.Value)
				ThisForm.RazonSocial.Value=thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social")
				
		
				*** Martin
				If Thisform.oTblGruposEmpresarios.Buscar(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_GrupoEmpresario"),.f.,"Clave")
					Thisform.Id_GrupoEmpresario = thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_GrupoEmpresario")
					ThisForm.oCmdGrupoEmpresario.Enabled = !Thisform.oTblGruposEmpresarios.Leer("Defecto")
				Else
					Thisform.Id_GrupoEmpresario = Space(3)
					ThisForm.oCmdGrupoEmpresario.Enabled = .f.
				Endif	
				*** Martin
				
				ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
				
				thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
				thisform.SignoMonedaCtaCorriente=thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Signo")
		*!*			thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Refrescar(this.Value,ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value)
				thisform.ClienteValidado=.t.
		endif
		
		If (thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida).and.!this.FormDesactivado
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.t.
		Else
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.f.
		Endif	
		
		Return thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE consultar
		lParameters cId_Cliente,lOcultar
		
		If Type("cId_cliente")<>T_LOGICAL
			Thisform.LockScreen = .t.
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Value=cId_cliente
			thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Valid
			thisform.tg_clientes1.LostFocus
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Enabled=.f.
			
			Thisform.LockScreen = .f.
		Endif
		
		If !lOcultar And Empty(cId_cliente)
			ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.SetFocus()
		Endif
		
		Thisform.Ocultar = lOcultar
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_cliente,lOcultar
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewCtaCorrienteClientes","Tg_ViewCtaCorrienteClientes")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVendedores","tg_tabla","Vendedores","clave")
		*** Martin
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblGruposEmpresarios","Tg_Tabla","GruposEmpresarios","Clave")

		Local cTexto,oLst

			Else	
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.Valid
		local lValida
		lValida=tg_textclave::valid()
		if lValida.and.!this.FormDesactivado.and.!thisform.ClienteValidado
				
				thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(this.Value)
				ThisForm.RazonSocial.Value=thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social")
				
		
				*** Martin
				If Thisform.oTblGruposEmpresarios.Buscar(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_GrupoEmpresario"),.f.,"Clave")
					Thisform.Id_GrupoEmpresario = thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_GrupoEmpresario")
					ThisForm.oCmdGrupoEmpresario.Enabled = !Thisform.oTblGruposEmpresarios.Leer("Defecto")
				Else
					Thisform.Id_GrupoEmpresario = Space(3)
					ThisForm.oCmdGrupoEmpresario.Enabled = .f.
				Endif	
				*** Martin
				
				ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
				
				thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
				thisform.SignoMonedaCtaCorriente=thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Signo")
		*!*			thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Refrescar(this.Value,ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value)
				thisform.ClienteValidado=.t.
		endif
		
		If (thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida).and.!this.FormDesactivado
