	PROCEDURE enviarmail
		lParameters cId_Cliente, cEstado, cRazon_Social
		Local cArchivoExcel, cmailcliente, cmail
		
		ThisForm.oEmailItem = CreateObject("Tg_Mail")
				
		cmail = ""
		cmailcliente = ""
		
		If !Empty(Thisform.ArchivoExcel)		
			Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Buscar(cId_Cliente+"V", .F., "CLAVECLI")
			Do while !thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.EsEof().and.Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.EsClaveIgual()
		
				If Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Leer("ADM") And 	Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema") = "V"
					cmailcliente = alltrim(Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.Leer("Email")) + "; "
					cmail = cmail + cmailcliente
				Endif
		
				Thisform.oTblEmailsClientes.IrSiguiente
			Enddo
		
		 
			If Empty(cmail)
				cEstado = "SIN MAIL ASIGNADO"		 			
			Else
				ThisForm.oEmailItem.Generar(cmail,;
											" ",;
											" ",;
											"Se adjunta la cuenta corriente en un archivo excel.",;
											Alltrim(cRazon_Social) + " - Resumen de Cuenta Corriente")
											
				ThisForm.oEmailItem.Adjuntar(Thisform.ArchivoExcel)
				Thisform.oEMailItem.Enviar(.F.)
			Endif
		Endif			
							
		Thisform.oEmailItem = .f.
				
		Return cEstado
			
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE generararchivoexcel
		lParameters cId_Cliente, cEstado
		
		Thisform.ArchivoExcel = ""
		
		Thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Seleccionar
		Thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.IrPrimero
		
		If Thisform.oTblTerminal.Buscar(oApp.Maquina, .F., "Clave")
			
			If Thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(cId_Cliente, .F., "Clave")
				Thisform.ArchivoExcel = Alltrim(Thisform.oTblTerminal.Leer("Path_Pdf")) + Alltrim(cId_Cliente) + ".xls"
		
				If FILE(Thisform.ArchivoExcel + ".xls")
					DELETE FILE Thisform.ArchivoExcel + ".xls"
				Endif
		
		
					If !Empty(Thisform.ArchivoExcel)
		
					Thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"), .F., "Clave")
		
					pmSheetName = "Hoja1" 
					Copy to (Thisform.ArchivoExcel) Type Fox2x
				
					lboExcel = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
					lboExcel.Visible = .F.
					lboExcel.Workbooks.Open(Thisform.ArchivoExcel)
		
					IF EMPTY(pmSheetName)
						pmSheetName="Hoja1"
					ENDIF
		
					lboExcel.ActiveSheet.Name = PmSheetName
		
					lboExcel.Range("A1:Q1500").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.Cut
		
					lboExcel.Range("A14").Select
					lboExcel.ActiveSheet.Paste
		
					lboExcel.Rows("14:14").Select
					lboExcel.Range("B14").Activate
					lboExcel.Selection.Delete(1)
					lboExcel.Cells.Select
		
					lboExcel.Columns("A:C").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.Delete(1)
					lboExcel.Columns("M:N").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.Delete(1)
					lboExcel.Columns("B:B").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.Delete(1)
					lboExcel.Columns("D:E").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.Delete(1)
		
					lboExcel.Range("A13").Select
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = "Nombre de Comprobante"
					lboExcel.Range("B13").Select
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = "Nro Externo"
					lboExcel.Range("C13").Select
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = "Fecha"
					lboExcel.Range("D13").Select
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = "Imp. Cmp"
					lboExcel.Range("E13").Select
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = "Debe"	
					lboExcel.Range("F13").Select
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = "Haber"	
					lboExcel.Range("G13").Select
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = "Saldo"	
					lboExcel.Range("H13").Select
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = "Imp. Pendiente"
					lboExcel.Range("I13").Select
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = "Saldo Pendiente"	
		
		
					lboExcel.Range("A13:I13").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 1
					lboExcel.Selection.Font.Bold = .T.
					lboExcel.Selection.Font.Name = "Arial"
					lboExcel.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		
					lboExcel.Cells.Select
					lboExcel.Range("A1").Activate
					lboExcel.Cells.EntireColumn.AutoFit
					lboExcel.Range("B14").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.Font.Bold = .T.
		
					lboExcel.Range("A13:I13").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.Borders(1).LineStyle = 1
					lboExcel.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 1
					lboExcel.Selection.Borders(1).ColorIndex = 1
					lboExcel.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 3
					lboExcel.Selection.Borders(3).Weight = 3
					lboExcel.Selection.Borders(3).ColorIndex = 1
					lboExcel.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 3
					lboExcel.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 4
					lboExcel.Selection.Borders(4).ColorIndex = 1
		
					lboExcel.Range("A14:I14").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 3
					lboExcel.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 2
					lboExcel.Selection.Borders(4).ColorIndex = 1
					lboExcel.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 35
					lboExcel.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
		 
					lboExcel.Range("A7").Select
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = "Cód. Cliente:"
					lboExcel.Range("A8").Select
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = "Razón Social:"
					lboExcel.Range("A9").Select
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = "Dirección:"
					lboExcel.Range("A10").Select
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = "Teléfono:"
					lboExcel.Range("A11").Select
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = "Moneda Cta. Cte:"
		
					lboExcel.Range("B7:I7").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.Merge
					lboExcel.Range("B7").Select 
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = Alltrim(Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Cliente"))		
					lboExcel.Range("B8:I8").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.Merge
					lboExcel.Range("B8").Select 
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = Alltrim(Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social"))
					lboExcel.Range("B9:I9").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.Merge
					lboExcel.Range("B9").Select 
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = Alltrim(Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Direccion"))
					lboExcel.Range("B10:I10").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.Merge
					lboExcel.Range("B10").Select 
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = Alltrim(Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Telefono1"))
					lboExcel.Range("B11:I11").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.Merge
					lboExcel.Range("B11").Select 
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = Alltrim(Thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Nombre"))
		
					lboExcel.Range("A7:A11").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.Font.Bold = .T.
		
					lboExcel.Range("B7:I11").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 2
		
					lboExcel.Range("H1:I1").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.Merge
					lboExcel.Range("H1").Select 
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = "ESTADO DE CUENTA CORRIENTE"
					lboExcel.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 4
					lboExcel.Selection.Font.Bold = .T.
		
					lboExcel.Range("B2").Select 
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = Alltrim(Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Nombre"))
					lboExcel.Selection.Font.Name = "Arial"
					lboExcel.Selection.Font.Size = 36
		
					lboExcel.Rows("3:5").Select
					lboExcel.Selection.Delete
					   
					lboExcel.Range("A1").Select    
					lboExcel.ActiveCell.FormulaR1C1 = "FECHA: " + DTOC(DATE())
					lboExcel.Selection.Font.Bold = .T.
		
					lboExcel.Range("A1").Select
					IF EMPTY(pmSheetName)
					 pmSheetName="Hoja1"
					ENDIF
					
					lboExcel.Range("A1").Select
		
					lboExcel.ActiveSheet.Name = PmSheetName
					lboExcel.Application.Displayalerts = .F.
					lboExcel.ActiveWorkbook.SaveAs(Thisform.ArchivoExcel, -4143,"","",.f.,.f.)
					lboExcel.Application.Displayalerts = .T.
		
					lboExcel.ActiveWorkbook.Close()
					lboExcel.Quit()
					lboExcel = Null
				Else
					cEstado = "NO SE GENERO EL EXCEL."
				Endif		
			Endif			
		Endif
		
		Return cEstado
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE getcolorestado
		lparameter cEstado
		
		nColor = 0
		
		Do Case 
			Case cEstado = "ENVIADO" 		 		
				nColor = rgb(209,231,215)	&& VERDE
		
			Case cEstado = "SIN MAIL ASIGNADO"	
				nColor = rgb(242,247,187)	&& AMARILLO
						
			Case cEstado = "NO SE GENERO EL EXCEL."	
				nColor = rgb(230,200,191)	&& ROJO
			
			Case Empty(cEstado)
				nColor = rgb(238,238,238)	&& GRIS 
		EndCase
		
		Return nColor 
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarconfiguracion
		Local vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		Thisform.oViewClientes.IrPrimero()
		Do While !Thisform.oViewClientes.EsEof() 
		
			If Thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(Thisform.oViewClientes.Leer("Id_Cliente"), .F., "CLAVE")
		
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "EnviarCtaCteMail", Thisform.oViewClientes.Leer("EnviarCtaCteMail"))
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "TipoCtaCte"		, Thisform.oViewClientes.Leer("TipoCtaCte"))
				Thisform.oTblClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			Endif
			
			Thisform.oViewClientes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarproceso
		lParameters cId_Cliente, cEstado
		Local vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		If Thisform.oTblCtaCteClientes.Buscar(cId_Cliente, .F., "CLAVE")
		
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Fecha"		, Date())
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Hora"		, Time())
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Usuario"	, oApp.Usuario)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Maquina"		, oApp.Maquina)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Estado"		, cEstado)		
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Error"		, Iif(cEstado="ENVIADO", .F., .T.))			
			Thisform.oTblCtaCteClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		
		Else
		
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Cliente"	, cId_Cliente)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Fecha"		, Date())
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Hora"		, Time())
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Id_Usuario"	, oApp.Usuario)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Maquina"		, oApp.Maquina)
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Estado"		, cEstado)					
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "Error"		, Iif(cEstado="ENVIADO", .F., .T.))		
			Thisform.oTblCtaCteClientes.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE iniciarcomponentes
		Local loApp
		
		If Thisform.Validar()
			Thisform.oTbxMesesCtaCte.Enabled = .F.
			ThisForm.oTbxClienteDesde.Enabled = .F.
			ThisForm.oTbxClienteHasta.Enabled = .F.
			Thisform.oGridClientes.Enabled = .F.
			ThisForm.oCmdEnviarMails.Enabled = .F.
			ThisForm.oCmdGrabarConfiguracion.Enabled = .F.
			ThisForm.oCmdRefrescarGrilla.Enabled = .F.
			ThisForm.oChkError.Enabled = .F.
			Thisform.oCmdConfigComprobantes.Enabled = .F.
			thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Enabled = .F.
			ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategorias1.Enabled = .F.
		Else
			Thisform.oTbxMesesCtaCte.Value = oApp.CargarFechaSistema() -  90
		
			ThisForm.oTbxClienteDesde.Valida=""
			ThisForm.oTbxClienteHasta.Valida=""
		
			thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
			thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
			
			thisform.tg_cmbcategorias1.SetearTodos()
			thisform.tg_cmbcategorias1.Value="TD"	
		
			For mmpp=1 to thisform.oGridClientes.ColumnCount
				Thisform.oGridClientes.Columns(mmpp).DynamicBackColor = "thisform.GetColorEstado(thisform.oViewClientes.Leer('Estado'))"
			Endfor
		Endif
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		Dodefault()
		
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewCtaCorrienteClientes","Tg_ViewCtaCorrienteClientesEmail")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewClientes"			  ,"Tg_ViewClientesCtaCte")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes"			,"tg_tabla","Clientes"		,"Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblEmailsClientes"		,"tg_tabla","EmailsClientes","ClaveCli")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas"			,"tg_tabla","Monedas"		,"Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblTerminal"			,"Tg_tabla","Terminal"		,"Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblUsuarios"			,"Tg_tabla","Usuarios"		,"Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCtaCteClientes"		,"Tg_tabla","CtaCteClientes","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu"			,"tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu"		,"Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_DocuBis"		,"tg_tabla","Vnt_DocuBis"	,"Clave")
		thisform.addObject("oTblParametros"			,"Tg_Tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.oGridClientes.RecordSource=thisform.oViewClientes.Alias
		thisform.oGridClientes.ResaltarRenglon(,,,,,.t.)
		
		Thisform.IniciarComponentes()
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarconfiguracioncomprobantes
		if !isnull(thisform.oFrmconfcompctacte)
			If Type("thisform.oFrmconfcompctacte")<>"O"		 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmconfcompctacte","tg_formconfcompctacte", "V")		
			Else
				thisform.oFrmconfcompctacte.IniciarComponentes()		
			EndIf
		else
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmconfcompctacte","tg_formconfcompctacte", "V")					
		endif
		
						
		thisform.oFrmconfcompctacte.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarconfiguracionmail
		if !isnull(thisform.ofrmconfigcuentamail)
			If Type("thisform.ofrmconfigcuentamail")<>"O"		 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.ofrmconfigcuentamail","tg_formconfigcuentamail")		
			Else
				thisform.ofrmconfigcuentamail.IniciarComponentes()		
			EndIf
		else
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.ofrmconfigcuentamail","tg_formconfigcuentamail")					
		endif
		
						
		thisform.ofrmconfigcuentamail.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarmails
		if !isnull(thisform.oFrmMailsClientes)
			If Type("thisform.oFrmMailsClientes")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmMailsClientes","tg_frmemailsclientes", thisform.oViewClientes.Leer("Id_Cliente"), .F.)		
			Else
				thisform.oFrmMailsClientes.Consultar(thisform.oViewClientes.Leer("Id_Cliente"), .F.)		
			EndIf
		else
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmMailsClientes","tg_frmemailsclientes", thisform.oViewClientes.Leer("Id_Cliente"), .F.)					
		endif
		
						
		thisform.oFrmMailsClientes.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE procesar
		Local nTipoCotizacion, cId_Cliente, cEstado, vComprobantesTodos[1,2], vComprobantesBlanco[1,2], vComprobantesZ[1,2], i, j, k
		
		
		thisform.FechaDesde = Thisform.oTbxMesesCtaCte.Value
		thisform.FechaHasta = oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()
		
		nTipoCotizacion = 1 	&& COTIZACION HISTORICA
		i = 1
		j = 1
		k = 1
		
		Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.IrPrimero()
		Do While !Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.EsEof()
		
			If Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Remunerativo")
		
				Dimension vComprobantesTodos[i,2]
				vComprobantesTodos[i,1] = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Comproba")
				vComprobantesTodos[i,2] = .T.
			
				i = i + 1
			Endif
		
			Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		
		Thisform.oTblVnt_DocuBis.IrPrimero()
		Do While !Thisform.oTblVnt_DocuBis.EsEof()
		
			Do Case
				Case Thisform.oTblVnt_DocuBis.Leer("tipoctacte") = 1
					Dimension vComprobantesBlanco[j,2]
					vComprobantesBlanco[j,1] = Thisform.oTblVnt_DocuBis.Leer("Id_Comproba")
					vComprobantesBlanco[j,2] = .T.
				
					j = j + 1
		
				Case Thisform.oTblVnt_DocuBis.Leer("tipoctacte") = 2
					Dimension vComprobantesZ[k,2]
					vComprobantesZ[k,1] = Thisform.oTblVnt_DocuBis.Leer("Id_Comproba")
					vComprobantesZ[k,2] = .T.
				
					k = k + 1		
			EndCase
			
			Thisform.oTblVnt_DocuBis.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		
		
		Thisform.oTblClientes.Filtrar("EnviarCtaCteMail")
		Thisform.oTblClientes.IrPrimero()
		Do While !Thisform.oTblClientes.EsEof()
		
			cId_Cliente = Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Cliente")
		      cEstado    = "ENVIADO" 
		
			If !Empty(cId_Cliente) And Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("EnviarCtaCteMail")
				
				Do Case 
					Case Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("TipoCtaCte") = 0				&& SI TIPO CUENTA CORRIENTE ES 0 SE ENVIA TODA LA CUENTA CORRIENTE
						Thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Refrescar(cId_Cliente,;
																	 ThisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"),;
																	 nTipoCotizacion,;
																	 Thisform.FechaDesde,;
																	 Thisform.FechaHasta, @vComprobantesTodos)
		
		
					Case Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("TipoCtaCte") = 1				&& SI TIPO CUENTA CORRIENTE ES 1 SE ENVIA SOLO LA PARTE BLANCA
						Thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Refrescar(cId_Cliente,;
																	 ThisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"),;
																	 nTipoCotizacion,;
																	 Thisform.FechaDesde,;
																	 Thisform.FechaHasta, @vComprobantesBlanco)
		
		
					Case Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("TipoCtaCte") = 2				&& SI TIPO CUENTA CORRIENTE ES 2 SE ENVIA SOLO LA PARTE Z
						Thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Refrescar(cId_Cliente,;
																	 ThisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"),;
																	 nTipoCotizacion,;
																	 Thisform.FechaDesde,;
																	 Thisform.FechaHasta, @vComprobantesZ)
		
		
					Case Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("TipoCtaCte") = 3				&& SI TIPO CUENTA CORRIENTE ES 3 SE ENVIA CADA UNA DE LAS PARTES (BLANCA Y Z) POR SEPARADO
				
						Thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Refrescar(cId_Cliente,;
																	 ThisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"),;
																	 nTipoCotizacion,;
																	 Thisform.FechaDesde,;
																	 Thisform.FechaHasta, @vComprobantesBlanco)
		
						cEstado = Thisform.GenerarArchivoExcel(cId_Cliente, cEstado)
						cEstado = Thisform.EnviarMail(cId_Cliente,cEstado,ThisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social"))		
						Thisform.GrabarProceso(cId_Cliente, cEstado)
					      cEstado    = "ENVIADO" 
				
						Thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Refrescar(cId_Cliente,;
																	 ThisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"),;
																	 nTipoCotizacion,;
																	 Thisform.FechaDesde,;
																	 Thisform.FechaHasta, @vComprobantesZ)		
		
				EnDCase
		
				cEstado = Thisform.GenerarArchivoExcel(cId_Cliente, cEstado)
				cEstado = Thisform.EnviarMail(cId_Cliente,cEstado,ThisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social"))		
				Thisform.GrabarProceso(cId_Cliente, cEstado)
		
		
		
			Endif
		
			Thisform.oTblClientes.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		Thisform.oTblClientes.DesFiltrar()
		Thisform.oTblClientes.IrPrimero()
		
		=fMensAceptar("El Proceso fue finalizado.")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local cId_Vendedor, cId_Categoria
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
			cId_Vendedor=""
		Else
			cId_Vendedor=ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value
		Endif
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategorias1.Value="TD"
			cId_Categoria=""
		Else
			cId_Categoria=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategorias1.Value
		Endif
		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.
		ThisForm.SetearCursorEspera()
		
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewClientes.Refrescar(Thisform.oChkError.Value, ThisForm.oTbxClienteDesde.Value, ThisForm.oTbxClienteHasta.Value, cId_Vendedor, cId_Categoria, Thisform.ochkSeleccionar.Value, Thisform.ochkDeseleccionar.Value)
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.RecordSource=thisform.oViewClientes.Alias
		
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewClientes.Alias+".Id_Cliente"
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewClientes.Alias+".Razon_Social"
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewClientes.Alias+".EnviarCtaCteMail"
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewClientes.Alias+".TipoCtaCte"
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewClientes.Alias+".Fecha"
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewClientes.Alias+".Estado"
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewClientes.Alias+".Error"
		
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column3.Sparse=.f.
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column3.ReadOnly=.f.
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column3.CurrentControl="oChkEnviarMail"
		
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column4.Sparse=.f.
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column4.ReadOnly=.f.
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column4.CurrentControl="oChkEnviarMail"
		
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column7.Sparse=.F.
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column7.ReadOnly=.F.
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column7.CurrentControl="oCmdCtasMails"
		
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column8.Sparse=.f.
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column8.ReadOnly=.T.
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column8.CurrentControl="oChkError"
		
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column1.ReadOnly=.T.
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column2.ReadOnly=.T.
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column5.ReadOnly=.T.
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column6.ReadOnly=.T.
		
		thisform.oGridClientes.Refresh()
		
		ThisForm.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.
		
		
					
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validar
		Local lError
		
		lError = .F.
		
		If Thisform.oTblTerminal.Buscar(oApp.Maquina, .F., "CLAVE")
			If This.oTblTerminal.Leer("configmail") = 0
				=fMensAceptar("Debe configurar el tipo de cuenta.")
				lError = .T.	
			Endif
		Endif
		
		If Thisform.oTblUsuarios.Buscar(oApp.Usuario, .F., "CLAVE") And !lError 
			If Empty(This.oTblUsuarios.Leer("smtp"))
				lError = .T.
			Endif
		
			If Empty(This.oTblUsuarios.Leer("mail"))
				lError = .T.
			Endif
		
			If Empty(This.oTblUsuarios.Leer("clavemail"))
				lError = .T.
			Endif
			
			If lError 
				=fMensAceptar("Debe configurar la cuenta de mail.")
			Endif
		Endif
		
		
		loApp = CREATEOBJECT("Excel.Application")
		If VarType(loApp) <> "O" And !lError 
			=fMensAceptar("Debe instalar el excel para poder utilizar el aplicativo.")
			lError = .T.
		Endif
		
		
		Return lError 
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE consultar
		lParameters cId_Cliente,lOcultar
		
		If Type("cId_cliente")<>T_LOGICAL
			Thisform.LockScreen = .t.
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Value=cId_cliente
			thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Valid
			thisform.tg_clientes1.LostFocus
			thisform.tg_clientes1.Enabled=.f.
			Thisform.LockScreen = .f.
		Endif
		
		If !lOcultar And Empty(cId_cliente)
			ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.SetFocus()
		Endif
		
		Thisform.Ocultar = lOcultar
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_cliente,lOcultar
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewCtaCorrienteClientes","Tg_ViewCtaCorrienteClientes")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes","tg_tabla","Clientes","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVendedores","tg_tabla","Vendedores","clave")
		*** Martin
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblGruposEmpresarios","Tg_Tabla","GruposEmpresarios","Clave")
		*** Martin
		thisform.Recno=1
		
		For mmpp=2 to thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount
		
			thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).dynamicBackcolor="iif(thisform.recno=Recno(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255))"
			thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).dynamicForecolor="iif(thisform.recno=Recno(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0))"
			thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(mmpp).Text1.BackColor=rgb(0,0,0)
			thisform.tg_grid1.Columns(mmpp).Text1.ForeColor=rgb(255,255,255)
				
		EndFor
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.DynamicForeColor="iif(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer('Debe')=0,iif(thisform.recno=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Recno(),rgb(0,0,0),rgb(255,255,255)),iif(thisform.recno=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Recno(),rgb(255,255,255),rgb(0,0,0)))"

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If alltrim(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"))<>""
			If thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Cobranza")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)
				Else
					thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
			Else	
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			Endif	
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

		lParameters lMoverFocus

		Thisform.VisualizarConsulta = .T.

						Endif

				Endif
			Endif
		Endif

			  If thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value, .T., "CLAVE")

							  endif	
						  endif

			   	   endif

		If Thisform.VisualizarConsulta

			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias
			
			thisform.RefrescarGrilla(lMoverFocus)		
		
			* ripples 1
			******* Martin
			*!*	If ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=1
			*!*		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.Visible=.t.
			*!*		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.Width=69
			*!*	Else

			*!*		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.Width=0
			*!*	Endif

				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.Width=69
				ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column10.Visible=.f.

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		lParameters lLlevaFocoAGrilla
		
		
		
		** Parametro intocable porque a veces no puedo hacer el setfocus cuando se hace
		** un refrescarAplicacion desde otro objeto, este no puede tomar el foco sino
		** se lo debe dejar al otro objeto sin quitarselo
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1

		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".Debe"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".Haber"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".Saldo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".ImpPendiente"
		
		* ripples 1
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".SaldoPendiente"
		***
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Alias+".NombreCmp"
		
		thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda())
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_label4.Caption=Str(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Sumar("ImpPendiente","Proximo_Vencimiento>=oApp.CargarFechaSistema()"),10,2)+"   "+thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Signo")
		thisform.tg_label5.Caption=str(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Sumar("ImpPendiente","Proximo_Vencimiento<oApp.CargarFechaSistema()"),10,2)+"   "+thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Signo")
		thisform.tg_label6.Caption=Str(Val(thisform.tg_label4.Caption)+Val(thisform.tg_label5.Caption),13,2)+"   "+thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Signo")
		
		
		*!*	thisform.oCmdDetalle.Enabled=!thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.EsTablaVacia()
		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		If lLlevaFocoAGrilla
			thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
			thisform.ClienteValidado=.f.  && Este setfocus produce otro valid del cliente
		Endif							  && Pongo este flag para que no cargue la vista de nuevo
		
		
		thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.IrUltimo
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		For mmpp=1 to 11-thisform.FilaGrillaRelativa
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(0)
		EndFor
		
		
		* Gustavo Aca
		
		*!*	thisform.tg_grid1.ActivateCell(thisform.tg_grid1.RelativeRow,8)
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.IrUltimo
		
		thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.LostFocus
		=Tg_TextClave::Valid()
		
		If !this.FormDesactivado
			thisform.RefrescarConsulta(.t.)
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.Valid
		local lValida
		lValida=tg_textclave::valid()
		if lValida.and.!this.FormDesactivado.and.!thisform.ClienteValidado
				
				thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(this.Value)
				ThisForm.RazonSocial.Value=thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Razon_Social")
				
		
				*** Martin
				If Thisform.oTblGruposEmpresarios.Buscar(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_GrupoEmpresario"),.f.,"Clave")
					Thisform.Id_GrupoEmpresario = thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_GrupoEmpresario")
					ThisForm.oCmdGrupoEmpresario.Enabled = !Thisform.oTblGruposEmpresarios.Leer("Defecto")
				Else
					Thisform.Id_GrupoEmpresario = Space(3)
					ThisForm.oCmdGrupoEmpresario.Enabled = .f.
				Endif	
				*** Martin
				
				ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
				
				thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Moneda_Cta"))
				thisform.SignoMonedaCtaCorriente=thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Signo")
		*!*			thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Refrescar(this.Value,ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value)
				thisform.ClienteValidado=.t.
		endif
		
		If (thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida).and.!this.FormDesactivado
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.t.
		Else
			thisform.oCmdDatosCliente.Enabled=.f.
		Endif	
		
		Return thisform.ClienteValidado.or.lValida
	ENDPROC

			*this.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Enabled=.f.
		Else
			this.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Enabled=.t.	
		Endif
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta(.t.)
		*!*	thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_clientes1.Value,ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value)

	PROCEDURE confeccionarcomprobante
		LParameters lShow
		
		Local cId_Comproba,lPoderEditar,lHabilitoScrollBars, lOculta_Leyenda, dFechaMax, cId_ComNC, cLetraComprobante, cFiltro, cId_Sucursal, cId_Sistema, cId_Cliente
		Local lDesdeConsolaRMA, mmpp, vDetalle
		Dimension vDetalle[1,6]
		
		cFiltro = "Titulo = .F. And NC = .T."
		
		Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Seleccionar() 
		Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Filtrar(cFiltro)
		Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.IrPrimero()
		
		cId_Sucursal = Thisform.oTblparametros.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
		cId_Sistema  = "V"
		cId_Cmp		 = Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		nReferencia  = Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
		cId_Cliente  = Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Id_Cliente")
		
		mmpp = 1
		Do While !Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.EsEof()
			
			Dimension vDetalle[mmpp,6]	
			
			vDetalle[mmpp,1] = Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
			vDetalle[mmpp,2] = Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Id_Sistema")
			vDetalle[mmpp,3] = Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Id_Comproba")
			vDetalle[mmpp,4] = Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Nro_Referencia")	
			vDetalle[mmpp,5] = Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Id_Articulo")
			vDetalle[mmpp,6] = Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Renglon")
			
			mmpp = mmpp + 1 
						
			Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		lDesdeConsolaRMA = .T.
		
		cId_Comproba = ""
		dFechaMax    = ctod("  /  /    ")
		cLetraComprobante = ""
		
		Thisform.oTblVnt_CabeceraCliente.IrPrimero	
		Thisform.oTblVnt_CabeceraCliente.Buscar(cId_Cliente, .F., "Id_Cliente")	
		Do While !Thisform.oTblVnt_CabeceraCliente.EsEof().and.Thisform.oTblVnt_CabeceraCliente.EsClaveIgual()
			
			If Thisform.oTblVnt_CabeceraCliente.Leer("Remunerativo") And !Thisform.oTblVnt_CabeceraCliente.Leer("Anulado") And Thisform.oTblVnt_CabeceraCliente.Leer("Suma")
				If dFechaMax < Thisform.oTblVnt_CabeceraCliente.Leer("Fecha")
					dFechaMax    	  =  Thisform.oTblVnt_CabeceraCliente.Leer("Fecha")
					cId_Comproba 	  =  Thisform.oTblVnt_CabeceraCliente.Leer("Id_Comproba")
					cLetraComprobante =  Thisform.oTblVnt_CabeceraCliente.Leer("Id_Tipo_Com")
				Endif
			Endif
			
			Thisform.oTblVnt_CabeceraCliente.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		
		If !Empty(cId_Comproba)
		
			IF Thisform.oTblVnt_DocuBis.Buscar(cId_Cmp, .f., "Clave")
				Do Case
					Case cLetraComprobante = "A"
						cId_ComNC = Thisform.oTblVnt_DocuBis.Leer("ID_NC_RMA_A")
					Case cLetraComprobante = "B"
						cId_ComNC = Thisform.oTblVnt_DocuBis.Leer("ID_NC_RMA_B")			
					OtherWise
						cId_ComNC = Thisform.oTblVnt_DocuBis.Leer("ID_NC_RMA_X")				
				EndCase
			Endif	
		
			IF Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Cmp, .f., "Clave")
				cId_Deposito = Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Deposito")
			Endif
				
			If !Empty(cId_ComNC)
			
				IF Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_ComNC, .f., "Clave")
					lPoderEditar		= !(Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("solocmppendientes") Or Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Val_descarga"))
					lHabilitoScrollBars = .T.
				Endif
		
				If !Thisform.oTblparametros.Leer("oculta_Leyenda_descarga_ind")
				   loculta_leyenda = .f.
				Else
				   loculta_leyenda = .t.
				Endif
		
				If Type("Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante") <> "O"	
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante","tg_altacomprobante")
				Endif
		
				Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante.SetearConfIndividualNotaCredito(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Cmp,nReferencia,cId_Cliente,cId_ComNC,cId_Deposito,.t.,.f.,lPoderEditar,loculta_leyenda,lHabilitoScrollBars,lDesdeConsolaRMA,@vDetalle)
		
				If lShow
					Thisform.oFrmConfComprobante.Show()
				Endif	
				
				Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Desfiltrar()
				Thisform.EjecutarConsulta()
				
			Else
			
			 	=fmensAceptar("No se pudo generar la nota de crédito!! (No hay un comprobante asociado)")
		
			Endif
		
		Else
		
		 	=fmensAceptar("No se pudo generar la nota de crédito!! (No se realizaron facturas)")
		
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE consultar
		lParameters vComprobantes,cId_ClienteDesde,cId_ClienteHasta,cId_vendedor,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,lAnulado,nReferencia,cNumero,cId_ArticuloDesde,cId_ArticuloHasta,cId_Deposito,lCancelado
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Alias
		
		Thisform.Id_ClienteDesde = cId_ClienteDesde
		Thisform.Id_ClienteHasta = cId_ClienteHasta
		Thisform.Id_Vendedor	 = cId_vendedor
		Thisform.FechaDesde		 = dFechaDesde
		Thisform.FechaHasta		 = dFechaHasta
		Thisform.Anulado		 = lAnulado
		Thisform.Referencia		 = nReferencia
		Thisform.Numero			 = cNumero
		Thisform.ArticuloDesde   = cId_ArticuloDesde
		Thisform.ArticuloHasta   = cId_ArticuloHasta
		Thisform.Id_Deposito	 = cId_Deposito
		Thisform.Cancelado		 = lCancelado
		=Acopy (vComprobantes, Thisform.vAuxiliar)
		 		
		Thisform.Tg_commandbutton2.Enabled 	= !lCancelado
		Thisform.Tg_grid1.Readonly 			= lCancelado
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE darvector
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
		Local cFiltro, cId_ArticuloDesde, cId_ArticuloHasta
		
		If Type("ThisForm.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value")="L".Or.Empty(ThisForm.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value)
			ThisForm.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value = ""
		endif
			
		cId_ArticuloDesde = ThisForm.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value
		Thisform.ArticuloDesde = ThisForm.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value
		
		If Type("ThisForm.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value")="L".Or.Empty(ThisForm.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value)
			ThisForm.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value = oApp.TomarMaximoString()
		endif
		
		cId_ArticuloHasta = ThisForm.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value
		Thisform.ArticuloHasta = ThisForm.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value
		
		cFiltro = "between(Id_Articulo, '" +cId_ArticuloDesde+ "', '" + cId_ArticuloHasta + "')"
		
		If !Empty(cId_ArticuloDesde) Or !Empty(cId_ArticuloHasta) 
			Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Filtrar(cFiltro)
		Else
			thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.DesFiltrar()
		Endif
		
		Thisform.SumarTotales()
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters vComprobantes,cId_ClienteDesde,cId_ClienteHasta,cId_vendedor,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,lAnulado,nReferencia,cNumero,cId_ArticuloDesde,cId_ArticuloHasta,cId_Deposito,lCancelado
		
		Dimension Thisform.vAuxiliar[1]
		
		DoDefault()
		
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada"	,"tg_viewconsconsolarmadesglosada")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_CabeceraCliente"	,"tg_tabla","Vnt_Cabecera"				,"Id_Cliente")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_DocuBis"			,"tg_tabla","Vnt_DocuBis"				,"Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu"				,"tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu"					,"Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblparametros"				,"tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		ThisForm.oTbxArticuloDesde.Value = SPACE(15)
		ThisForm.oTbxArticuloHasta.Value = SPACE(15)
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Alias
		
		Thisform.Id_ClienteDesde = cId_ClienteDesde
		Thisform.Id_ClienteHasta = cId_ClienteHasta
		Thisform.Id_Vendedor	 = cId_vendedor
		Thisform.FechaDesde		 = dFechaDesde
		Thisform.FechaHasta		 = dFechaHasta
		Thisform.Anulado		 = lAnulado
		Thisform.Referencia		 = nReferencia
		Thisform.Numero			 = cNumero
		Thisform.ArticuloDesde   = cId_ArticuloDesde
		Thisform.ArticuloHasta   = cId_ArticuloHasta
		Thisform.Id_Deposito	 = cId_Deposito
		Thisform.Cancelado		 = lCancelado
		=Acopy(vComprobantes, Thisform.vAuxiliar)
		
		Thisform.oTbxCantDV.Value = 0
		Thisform.oTbxCantNC.Value = 0
		Thisform.oTbxCantPendiente.Value = 0
		Thisform.oTbxCantidad.Value = 0
		
		Thisform.Tg_commandbutton2.Enabled = !lCancelado
		Thisform.Tg_grid1.Readonly = lCancelado
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		If !Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Titulo")
			If !IsNull(thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante)
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>"O"	 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","Tg_ConsConsolaDetalladaRMA",thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Nro_Referencia"), thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("nEstado"))					
				Endif
			Else
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","Tg_ConsConsolaDetalladaRMA",thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Nro_Referencia"), thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("nEstado"))				
			Endif
		
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Nro_Referencia"), thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("nEstado"))				
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla

		Thisform.Tg_Grid1.Columns(6).DynamicFontSize="iif(Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer('Cant_CanceladaNC') > 0,10,9)"	
		
		
		For mmpp=1 to thisform.tg_grid1.ColumnCount

		Endfor

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE sumartotales
		Thisform.oTbxCantDV.Value = ThisForm.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Sumar("Cant_CanceladaDV",".T.")
		Thisform.oTbxCantNC.Value = ThisForm.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Sumar("Cant_CanceladaNC",".T.")
		Thisform.oTbxCantPendiente.Value = ThisForm.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Sumar("Cant_Pendiente",".T.")
		Thisform.oTbxCantidad.Value = ThisForm.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Sumar("Cantidad",".T.")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validar
		Local lValida, cCliente, lPasoPorPrimeraVez
		
		lValida 	= .F.
		cCliente 	= ""
		lPasoPorPrimeraVez = .T.
		
		Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.IrPrimero()
		Do While !Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.EsEof() 
			If !Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Titulo") And Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("NC")
				lValida = .T.
			Endif
			Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		If !lValida
			=fMensAceptar("No hay artículos seleccionados.")
		Endif
		
		Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.IrPrimero()
		Do While !Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.EsEof() And lValida <> .F.
		
			If !Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Titulo") And Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("NC")
		
				If lPasoPorPrimeraVez
					lPasoPorPrimeraVez = .F.
					cCliente = Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Id_Cliente")
				Endif
			
				If Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Cant_Pendiente") = 0
					=fMensAceptar("No se pueden seleccionar artículos con Cant. Pendiente igual a 0.")
					lValida = .F.
				Endif
						
				If lValida  And cCliente <> Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.Leer("Id_Cliente")
					=fMensAceptar("No se puede realizar una nota de crédito a diferentes clientes.")		
					lValida = .F.
				Endif			
				
			Endif
		
			Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.IrSiguiente()
		Enddo
		
		Thisform.oViewConsolaRmaDesglosada.IrPrimero()
		
		Return lValida
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCerrar.Click
		Thisform.hide
		
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

		Local lShow
		
		lShow = .T.
		
		thisform.DescargaAutomatica = .f.
		
		If oApp.PedirPermiso("PRO","NCRMA",.f.,.f.,oApp.CodUsuario())
			If Thisform.Validar()
				Thisform.ConfeccionarComprobante(lShow)
			Endif	
		Else
		 	=fmensAceptar("No posee permiso para generar la Nota de Crédito.")
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarconfiguracion
		Local vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		Thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.IrPrimero()
		Do While !Thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.EsEof() 
		
			If Thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(Thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.Leer("Id_Cliente"), .F., "CLAVE")
		
				=fGrabar(@vGrabacion, "ImputacionAutomatica", Thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.Leer("ImputacionAutomatica"))
				Thisform.oTblClientes.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
			Endif
			
			Thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE iniciarcomponentes
		
		ThisForm.oTbxClienteDesde.Value=""
		ThisForm.oTbxClienteHasta.Value=""
		
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
		
		thisform.tg_cmbcategorias1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbcategorias1.Value="TD"	
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		Dodefault()
		
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewImputacionAutomatica","Tg_ViewImputacionAutomatica")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes"			,"tg_tabla","Clientes"		,"Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu"			,"tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu"		,"Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Imputacion"		,"tg_tabla","Vnt_Imputacion","Cliente")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Cabecera"		,"tg_tabla","Vnt_Cabecera"	,"Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oCstVentas"				,"Tg_SistemaVentas")
		
		thisform.oGridClientes.RecordSource=thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.Alias
		thisform.oGridClientes.ResaltarRenglon(,,,,,.t.)
		
		Thisform.IniciarComponentes()
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE procesar
		Local nTotalImputado
		
		
		Thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.IrPrimero()
		Do While !Thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.EsEof()
			
			If Thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.Leer("ImputacionAutomatica")
			
				If Thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(Thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.Leer("Id_Cliente"), .F., "Clave")
			
					If Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Buscar(Thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.Leer("Id_Cliente") + "S", .F., "Cliente")
						Do While !Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.EsEof() And Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.EsClaveIgual()
							
							If Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Importe") > 0
		
								If Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Comproba"), .f., "Clave")
		
									nTotalImputado    = thisform.oCstVentas.ImputacionAutomatica(Thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.Leer("Id_Cliente"),;
																								 Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Suma"),;		
																								 Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("GrupoImputacion"),;
																								 Thisform.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Cobranza"),;
																								 Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Importe"),;
																								 Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Comproba"),;
																								 Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),;
																								 Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Nro_Externo_Cruce"),;
																								 Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Fecha"),;
																								 .T.)
								
									=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Importe",    Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Importe") - nTotalImputado)
									thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)														 
								
									If Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Buscar(Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Sucursal")+Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Sistema")+Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Comproba")+Str(Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10), .F., "Clave")			
				
										If Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Importe") = 0
											=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cancelado_Cta"		,   .T.)
											=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Cancelado"			,   Thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Leer("Cancelado_Desc") And .T.)
											=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Proximo_Vencimiento"	,	cTod("  /  /  "))
											thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)														 
										Else
											=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Proximo_Vencimiento"	,	thisform.oCstVentas.ConsultarProxVencimiento(Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Sistema"),Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Comproba"),Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Nro_Referencia")))	
											thisform.oTblVnt_Cabecera.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)		
										Endif
										
										thisform.oCstVentas.ActualizarVencimientos(Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Sistema"),Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Id_Comproba"),Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.Leer("Nro_Referencia"))	
									Endif						
					
								Endif
		
							Endif
		
							Thisform.oTblVnt_Imputacion.IrSiguiente()
						EndDo			
					Endif
				
				Endif
			
			Endif
			
			Thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		
		=fMensAceptar("El Proceso fue finalizado.")
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
																				 
		
		
		
		
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla()		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local cId_Vendedor, cId_Categoria
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value="TD"
			cId_Vendedor=""
		Else
			cId_Vendedor=ThisForm.Tg_cmbVendedores1.Value
		Endif
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategorias1.Value="TD"
			cId_Categoria=""
		Else
			cId_Categoria=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategorias1.Value
		Endif
		
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.
		ThisForm.SetearCursorEspera()
		
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.Refrescar(ThisForm.oTbxClienteDesde.Value, ThisForm.oTbxClienteHasta.Value, cId_Vendedor, cId_Categoria, Thisform.ochkSeleccionar.Value, Thisform.ochkDeseleccionar.Value)
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.RecordSource=thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.Alias
		
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.Alias+".Id_Cliente"
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.Alias+".Razon_Social"
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewImputacionAutomatica.Alias+".ImputacionAutomatica"
		
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column3.Sparse=.f.
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column3.ReadOnly=.f.
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column3.CurrentControl="oChkImputar"
		
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column1.ReadOnly=.T.
		ThisForm.oGridClientes.Column2.ReadOnly=.T.
		
		thisform.oGridClientes.Refresh()
		
		ThisForm.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.
		
		
					
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ochkDeseleccionar.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ochkSeleccionar.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdGrabarConfiguracion.Click
		Thisform.GrabarConfiguracion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdImputar.Click
		Thisform.Procesar()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdRefrescarGrilla.Click
		Thisform.RefrescarConsulta()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxClienteDesde.Valid
		LPARAMETERS lanulamensaje
		local lvalido
		
		lvalido = .t.
		
		thisform.oTbxClienteHasta.Value = this.Value
		
		return lvalido
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxClienteHasta.Valid
		LPARAMETERS lanulamensaje
		local lvalido
		
		lvalido = .t.
		
		return lvalido
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE calcularvariacionpromedio
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		
		Dodefault()
		
		Thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oViewDescuentosPorMarca"   ,"Tg_ViewDescuentosPorMarca")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca","tg_tabla","Aux_DescuentosPorMarca")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos"			   ,"tg_tabla","Articulos"			,"clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblMarcas"				   ,"tg_tabla","Marcas"				,"clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblDescuentosPorMarca"	   ,"tg_tabla","DescuentosPorMarca" ,"clave")
		
		
		thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.SetearProp("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Revertir()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource = thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Alias
		
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbmarcas1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategorias1.SetearTodos()
		
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbmarcas1.Value = "TD"
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategorias1.Value = "TD"
		
		thisform.OldId_cliente1	=Space(5)
		thisform.OldId_cliente2 =Space(5)
		
		Thisform.chkVerMarcaDescuento.Value = .F.
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.oViewDescuentosPorMarca.Refrescar(ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value, ThisForm.Tg_clientes2.Value, ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategorias1.Value, ThisForm.Tg_cmbmarcas1.Value, Thisform.chkVerMarcaDescuento.Value)
											 
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewDescuentosPorMarca.Alias
		
		
		Thisform.oViewDescuentosPorMarca.IrPrimero
		
		Do While !Thisform.oViewDescuentosPorMarca.EsEof()
		
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Cliente"		, Thisform.oViewDescuentosPorMarca.Leer("Id_Cliente"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Razon_Social"		, Thisform.oViewDescuentosPorMarca.Leer("Razon_Social"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Marca"			, Thisform.oViewDescuentosPorMarca.Leer("Id_Marca"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre"			, Thisform.oViewDescuentosPorMarca.Leer("Nombre"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"DescuentoActual" 	, Thisform.oViewDescuentosPorMarca.Leer("Descuento"))
			=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"DescuentoNuevo"	, Thisform.oViewDescuentosPorMarca.Leer("Descuento"))
			
			Thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)	
		
			Thisform.oViewDescuentosPorMarca.IrSiguiente
		EndDo
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		
		Thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Alias+".Id_Cliente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Alias+".Razon_Social"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Alias+".DescuentoActual"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Alias+".DescuentoNuevo"
		
		thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.IrPrimero
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Revertir()
		ThisForm.RefrescarConsulta
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes1.Valid
		LPARAMETERS lanulamensaje
		local lvalido
		
		lvalido = .t.
		
		If  ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .F.
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_cliente1
		Endif	
		
		thisform.OldId_cliente1 = this.Value
		
		return lvalido
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_clientes2.Valid
		LPARAMETERS lanulamensaje
		local lvalido
		
		lvalido = .t.
		
		If  ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .F.
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_cliente2
		Endif	
		
		thisform.OldId_cliente2 = this.Value
		
		return lvalido
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.IrPrimero()
		
		Do while !Thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.EsEof()
		
		   If Thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Leer("DescuentoActual") <> Thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Leer("DescuentoNuevo")
		   
		      If Thisform.oTblDescuentosPorMarca.Buscar(Thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Leer("Id_Cliente")+Thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Leer("Id_Marca"),.f.,"Clave")
		        		
		      	 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Descuento"       	,	Thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Leer("DescuentoNuevo"))
		         Thisform.oTblDescuentosPorMarca.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		         
		      Else
		      
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Cliente"        	,	Thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Leer("Id_Cliente"))            
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Marca" 	    	,	Thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Leer("Id_Marca"))         
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Descuento"         	,	Thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Leer("DescuentoNuevo"))         
		         thisform.oTblDescuentosPorMarca.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		      
		      Endif
		      
		   Endif
		
		   Thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.IrSiguiente()
		 
		Enddo
		
		=fMensAceptar("Se grabaron correctamente los datos.")
		
		Thisform.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .t.
		
		thisform.oTblAux_DescuentosPorMarca.Revertir()
		ThisForm.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column6.Text1.Valid
			
		If This.Value > 100
			=fMensAceptar("El descuento no puede ser mayor a 100%. Verifique.")
		   	return(.f.)
		Endif		
				
		return(.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularvariacionpromedio
		Local nTotalPrecioactual, nTotalPrecioNuevo, nVariacionPromedio, nRegistro
		
		nRegistro = Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Recno()
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrPrimero()
		
		nTotalPrecioactual = 0
		nTotalPrecioNuevo = 0
		
		Do while !Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.EsEof()
		
		   nTotalPrecioActual = nTotalPrecioActual + Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioActual")
		   nTotalPrecioNuevo = nTotalPrecioNuevo + Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioNuevo")
		   
		   Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrSiguiente()
		   
		enddo
		
		nVariacionPromedio = Round(((nTotalPrecioNuevo / nTotalPrecioActual) - 1) * 100, 5)
		
		Thisform.Tg_TextBox2.Value = nVariacionPromedio
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrRegistro(nRegistro)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Precios","tg_tabla","Vnt_Precios","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_Precios","tg_tabla","Aux_Precios")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_PrecioHistorico","tg_tabla","Vnt_PrecioHistorico")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos","tg_tabla","Articulos","clave")
		
		** LUCHO M. 17/10/11
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblLog_BorrarPreciosEspeciales"	,"Tg_tabla","Log_BorrarPreciosEspeciales")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblVnt_ArtCli"						,"Tg_tabla","Vnt_ArtCli","Id_Articul")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblClientes"						,"Tg_tabla","Clientes","Clave")
		** LUCHO M. 17/10/11
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Precios.SetearProp ("BOT")
		thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Revertir()
		
		cMascaraDatos = replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("enteros_precio"))+"."+replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("decimales_precio"))
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		*thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=oApp.CargarfechaSistema()
		thisform.Fila = 1
		Thisform.tg_TextBox1.Value = 0
		
		Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.IrPrimero()
		
		*thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_Articulo, cNombre, nPrecio, nRegistro 
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Revertir()
		
		if thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta = space(15)
		   thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta = oApp.TomarMaximoString()
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Id_Marca = "TD"
		   thisform.Id_Marca = SPACE(3)
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Id_Rubro = "TD"
		   thisform.Id_Rubro = SPACE(3)
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Id_SubRubro = "TD"
		   thisform.Id_SubRubro = SPACE(3)
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value=1
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.FijarTag("Clave")
		else
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.FijarTag("Nombre")
		endif
		   
		* barro los articulos y lleno la tabla auxiliar con los que van a lista de precios
		Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrPrimero()
		nRegistro = 1
		do while !Thisform.oTblArticulos.EsEof()
		
		   if Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lista_Precios") and !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo")
		   
		      cId_Articulo = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo")   
		      cNombre = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
		      cId_Marca = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Marca")
		      cId_Rubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Rubro")
		      cId_Subrubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Subrubro")
		      
		      if cId_Articulo >= Thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde and cId_Articulo <= Thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta;
		                                                   and (cId_Marca = Thisform.Id_Marca or Thisform.Id_Marca=space(3));
		                                                   and (cId_Rubro = Thisform.Id_Rubro or Thisform.Id_Rubro=space(3));
		                                                   and (cId_SubRubro = Thisform.Id_Subrubro or Thisform.Id_Subrubro=space(3))
		      nPrecio = 0
		      
		      if Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Buscar(cId_Articulo+Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		         nPrecio = Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")      
		      endif
		      
			  =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo"        	,	cId_Articulo )
			  =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre"			        ,	cNombre ) 
			  =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioActual"        	,	nPrecio )
			  =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Variacion"           	,	0 )
			  =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioNuevo"         	,	nPrecio )	
			  =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Registro"         		,	nRegistro )	
			  
			  
		      thisform.oTblAux_Precios.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		      nRegistro = nRegistro + 1
		      Thisform.RegistroMax = nRegistro 
		      endif
		            
		   endif
		   
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()
		   
		enddo
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		cMascaraDatos = replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("enteros_precio"))+"."+replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("decimales_precio"))
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".Id_Articulo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".PrecioActual"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".Variacion"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Alias+".PrecioNuevo"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.Inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.Inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Parent.RefrescarConsulta
		
		thisform.oTblAux_Precios.irUltimo() 
		thisform.Renglones = Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Recno()
		thisform.oTblAux_Precios.irPrimero() 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmblistaprecios1.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		Local vGrabacion, dFecha, cId_Lista
		Local cDetalle && LUCHO M. 17/10/11
		
		dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		dFecha = thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		cId_Lista = Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.Value
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrPrimero()
		Do while !Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.EsEof()
			
			if Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioActual") <> Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioNuevo")
		
				cDetalle="" && LUCHO M. 17/10/11
				
				* Busco el precio en vnt_precios
				if Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.buscar(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Id_Articulo")+cId_Lista,.f.,"Clave")
		      
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio",Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioNuevo") )
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"fecha_cambio" ,date())
					thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		         
		         	cDetalle="SE MODIFICO EL PRECIO" && LUCHO M. 17/10/11
		         
					*busco en vnt_preciohistorico
					if Thisform.oTblVnt_PrecioHistorico.buscar(Dtos(dFecha - 1)+Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Id_Articulo")+cId_Lista,.f.,"Clave")
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio"			,Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioActual") )
						thisform.oTblVnt_PrecioHistorico.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
					else
			            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha"			,dFecha - 1 )         
			            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Lista"			,cId_Lista )            
			            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo"		,Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Id_Articulo") )         
			            =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio"			,Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioActual") )         
			            thisform.oTblVnt_PrecioHistorico.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
					endif
				else
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Lista"			,cId_Lista )            
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo"		,Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Id_Articulo") )         
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio"			,Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioNuevo") )    
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"fecha_cambio" ,date())     
					thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
					
					cDetalle="SE AGREGO A VNT_PRECIOS. NO EXISTIA EL REGISTRO" && LUCHO M. 17/10/11
				endif
		      
				** LUCHO M. 17/10/11
				If oApp.oTblParametros.Leer("BorraPreciosEspecialesAlActualizarPrecios")
					If ThisForm.oTblVnt_ArtCli.Buscar(ThisForm.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Id_Articulo"),.f.,"Id_Articul")
						Do While !ThisForm.oTblVnt_ArtCli.EsEof() And ThisForm.oTblVnt_ArtCli.EsClaveIgual()
							If ThisForm.oTblClientes.Buscar(ThisForm.oTblVnt_ArtCli.Leer("Id_Cliente"),.f.,"Clave") And (ThisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("Id_Lista")=cId_Lista)
								ThisForm.oTblVnt_ArtCli.Borrar()
							Endif
							ThisForm.oTblVnt_ArtCli.IrSiguiente()
						Enddo
					Endif
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Fecha"			,Date())
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Hora"				,Time())
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Usuario"		,oApp.Usuario)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Maquina"			,oApp.Maquina)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo"		,ThisForm.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Id_Articulo"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Lista"			,cId_Lista)
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio_Old"		,ThisForm.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioActual"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio_New"		,ThisForm.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioNuevo"))
					=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Detalle"			,ThisForm.Caption + " - " + cDetalle)
					ThisForm.oTblLog_BorrarPreciosEspeciales.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
				Endif
				** LUCHO M. 17/10/11
		   endif
		
		   Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
		Thisform.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		If Type("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos","TG_FrmFiltroArticulos")				
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Show()
		
		IF  thisform.Id_articuloDesde<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde or ;
			thisform.Id_articuloHasta<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;	
			thisform.id_Marca<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca  or;
			thisform.id_rubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro  or;
			thisform.id_Subrubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro  
		
		
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.Id_articuloDesde=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde
		thisform.Id_articuloHasta=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta
		thisform.id_Marca=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca
		thisform.id_rubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro
		thisform.id_Subrubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro
		
		
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column4.Text1.GotFocus
		Local nProximaFila, nRegistro
		
		If Thisform.Fila +1 <=thisform.Renglones && MATIAS L. 04/01/2018 IF POR VALIDACION
			If thisform.TerminoRenglon and !thisform.oTblAux_Precios.EsFinal()
				nProximaFila=thisform.Fila + 1
				thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrRegistro(nProximaFila)
				nRegistro=thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Recno() 		
				thisform.tg_grid1.ActivateCell(thisform.Fila+1,1)
				thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrRegistro(nProximaFila) 
				thisform.TerminoRenglon=.f.
			endif
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column4.Text1.Valid
		Local nPrecioNuevo, vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		*if this.value<>0
		
		   nPrecioNuevo = Round(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual")+(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual") * This.Value /100),Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Decimales_Precio"))
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioNuevo"        	,	nPrecioNuevo )
		   thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		
		*endif
		
		Thisform.CalcularVariacionPromedio
		
		return(.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column5.Text1.LostFocus
		if lastKey()=13.or.LastKey()=9
			thisform.TerminoRenglon=.t.
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column5.Text1.Valid
		Local nVariacion, vGrabacion
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		if This.value = 0
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"variacion"        	,	0 )
		   thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   
		   thisform.CalcularVariacionPromedio
		   
		   return(.t.)
		endif
		
		if (this.value / Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual")) - 1 < 10
		   nVariacion = Round(((this.value / Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual")) - 1) * 100, 2)
		   =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Variacion"        	,	nVariacion )
		   thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   
		   thisform.CalcularVariacionPromedio
		
		   return(.t.)
		endif
		
		thisform.CalcularVariacionPromedio
		
		
		return(.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_optiongroup1.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_textbox1.InteractiveChange
		Local nRegistro, nPrecioNuevo
		
		nRegistro = Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.recno()
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrPrimero()
		
		do while !Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.EsEof()
		
		   if Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("PrecioActual") <> 0
		      nPrecioNuevo = Round(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual")+(Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Leer("Precioactual") * Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value /100),Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Decimales_Precio"))
		      =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"PrecioNuevo"        	,	nPrecioNuevo )
		      =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Variacion"           	,	Thisform.Tg_TextBox1.Value )
		      thisform.oTblAux_Precios.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		   endif
		   
		   Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrSiguiente()
		enddo
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_Precios.IrRegistro(nRegistro)
		
		thisform.CalcularVariacionPromedio
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE
