	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Precios","tg_tabla","Vnt_Precios","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas","tg_tabla","Aux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos","tg_tabla","Articulos","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMarcas","tg_tabla","Marcas","nombre")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblRubros","tg_tabla","Rubros","nombre")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblSubrubros","tg_tabla","Subrubros","nombre")
		
		*!*	thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.SetearProp ("BOT")
		*!*	thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Revertir()
		
		cMascaraDatos = replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("enteros_precio"))+"."+replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("decimales_precio"))
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.Inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.Inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.Inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.Inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		
		thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde=Space(15)
		thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta=space(15)
		thisform.Id_Marca=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_Rubro=Space(3)
		thisform.Id_SubRubro=Space(3)
		
		*thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		*Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=oApp.CargarfechaSistema()
		
		Thisform.tg_TextBox1.Value = "Precio"
		Thisform.tg_TextBox2.Value = "Precio Sug"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.Header1.Caption = Thisform.tg_TextBox1.Value
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.Header1.Caption = Thisform.tg_TextBox2.Value
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.Header1.Caption = Thisform.tg_TextBox1.Value
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.Header1.Caption = Thisform.tg_TextBox2.Value
		
		Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.IrPrimero()
		Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.IrPrimero()
		
		*thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtVendidosDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarcomsulta1
		Local cId_Articulo1, cId_Articulo2, cNombre1, cNombre2, nPrecio1, nPrecio2, nPrecio3, nPrecio4, lHayArticulosCorte, cId_Corte
		Local vGrabacion, nCol, vCursor
		
		if Thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.EsTablavacia()
		
		Dimension vCursor[9,4]
		vCursor[1,1]="Id_Articulo1"
		vCursor[1,2]="C"
		vCursor[1,3]=15
		vCursor[1,4]=0
		vCursor[2,1]="Nombre1"
		vCursor[2,2]="C"
		vCursor[2,3]=50
		vCursor[2,4]=0
		vCursor[3,1]="Id_Articulo2"
		vCursor[3,2]="C"
		vCursor[3,3]=15
		vCursor[3,4]=0
		vCursor[4,1]="Nombre2"
		vCursor[4,2]="C"
		vCursor[4,3]=50
		vCursor[4,4]=0
		vCursor[5,1]="Precio1"
		vCursor[5,2]="N"
		vCursor[5,3]=15
		*vCursor[5,4]=4
		vCursor[5,4]=5
		vCursor[6,1]="Precio2"
		vCursor[6,2]="N"
		vCursor[6,3]=15
		*vCursor[6,4]=4
		vCursor[6,4]=5
		vCursor[7,1]="Precio3"
		vCursor[7,2]="N"
		vCursor[7,3]=15
		*vCursor[7,4]=4
		vCursor[7,4]=5
		vCursor[8,1]="Precio4"
		vCursor[8,2]="N"
		vCursor[8,3]=15
		*vCursor[8,4]=4
		vCursor[8,4]=5
		vCursor[9,1]="Color"
		vCursor[9,2]="C"
		vCursor[9,3]=1
		vCursor[9,4]=0
		
		else
		
		Dimension vCursor[9,4]
		vCursor[1,1]="Id_Articulo1"
		vCursor[1,2]="C"
		vCursor[1,3]=Thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Leer("AnchoArticulos")
		vCursor[1,4]=0
		vCursor[2,1]="Nombre1"
		vCursor[2,2]="C"
		vCursor[2,3]=Thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Leer("AnchoDetalle")
		vCursor[2,4]=0
		vCursor[3,1]="Id_Articulo2"
		vCursor[3,2]="C"
		vCursor[3,3]=Thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Leer("AnchoArticulos")
		vCursor[3,4]=0
		vCursor[4,1]="Nombre2"
		vCursor[4,2]="C"
		vCursor[4,3]=Thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Leer("AnchoDetalle")
		vCursor[4,4]=0
		vCursor[5,1]="Precio1"
		vCursor[5,2]="N"
		vCursor[5,3]=Thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Leer("EnterosPrecios")
		vCursor[5,4]=Thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Leer("DecimalesPrecios")
		vCursor[6,1]="Precio2"
		vCursor[6,2]="N"
		vCursor[6,3]=Thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Leer("EnterosPrecios")
		vCursor[6,4]=Thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Leer("DecimalesPrecios")
		vCursor[7,1]="Precio3"
		vCursor[7,2]="N"
		vCursor[7,3]=Thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Leer("EnterosPrecios")
		vCursor[7,4]=Thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Leer("DecimalesPrecios")
		vCursor[8,1]="Precio4"
		vCursor[8,2]="N"
		vCursor[8,3]=Thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Leer("EnterosPrecios")
		vCursor[8,4]=Thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Leer("DecimalesPrecios")
		vCursor[9,1]="Color"
		vCursor[9,2]="C"
		vCursor[9,3]=1
		vCursor[9,4]=0
		
		endif
		
		if !Thisform.cursorcreado
		   create cursor listapreciosdoscolumnas from array vcursor
		endif
		
		delete all in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		
		Thisform.cursorcreado=.t.
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		*thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Revertir()
		
		if thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta = space(15)
		   thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta = oApp.TomarMaximoString()
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Id_Marca = "TD"
		   thisform.Id_Marca = SPACE(3)
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Id_Rubro = "TD"
		   thisform.Id_Rubro = SPACE(3)
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Id_SubRubro = "TD"
		   thisform.Id_SubRubro = SPACE(3)
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value=1
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.FijarTag("Clave")
		endif   
		if thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value=2
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.FijarTag("Nombre")
		endif
		
		nCol=1
		
		if thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value=1 or thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value=2
		* barro los articulos y lleno la tabla auxiliar con los que van a lista de precios
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrPrimero()
		
		   do while !Thisform.oTblArticulos.EsEof()
		   
		      if !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lista_Precios") or Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo")
		         Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()
		         loop
		      endif   
		
		      if Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lista_Precios") and !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo")
		          
		         cId_Articulo1 = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo")   
		         cNombre1 = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
		         
		         cId_Marca = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Marca")
		         cId_Rubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Rubro")
		         cId_Subrubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Subrubro")
		      
		         if cId_Articulo1 >= Thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde and cId_Articulo1 <= Thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta;
		                                                       and (cId_Marca = Thisform.Id_Marca or Thisform.Id_Marca=space(3));
		                                                       and (cId_Rubro = Thisform.Id_Rubro or Thisform.Id_Rubro=space(3));
		                                                       and (cId_SubRubro = Thisform.Id_Subrubro or Thisform.Id_Subrubro=space(3))
		            nPrecio1 = 0
		      
		            if Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Buscar(cId_Articulo1+Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		               nPrecio1 = Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")      
		            endif   
		      
		            nPrecio2 = 0
		
		            if Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Buscar(cId_Articulo1+Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		               nPrecio2 = Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")      
		            endif
		            
		            if nCol = 1
		               append blank in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			           replace Id_Articulo1 with cId_Articulo1 in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			           replace Nombre1 		with cNombre1      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			           replace Precio1      with nPrecio1      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		 	           replace Precio2      with nPrecio2      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		               
		               nCol=2
		            else   
		
			           replace Id_Articulo2 with cId_Articulo1 in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			           replace Nombre2 		with cNombre1      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			           replace Precio3      with nPrecio1      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		 	           replace Precio4      with nPrecio2      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		            
		               nCol=1
		            endif
		              
		         else
		            Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()
		            loop
		         endif
		            
		      endif
		      
		      Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()
		      
		   enddo
		   
		Endif   
		
		* aca proceso si es por marca rubro o subrubro
		
		lHayArticulosCorte = .f.
		
		if thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value=3
		
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.FijarTag("Nombre")
		   
		   Thisform.oTblMarcas.IrPrimero()
		   
		   do while !Thisform.oTblMarcas.EsEof()
		   
		      nCol=1 
		   
		      if Thisform.Id_marca <> space(3)
		         if Thisform.oTblMarcas.Leer("Id_Marca") <> Thisform.Id_Marca
		            Thisform.oTblMarcas.IrSiguiente()
		            loop
		         endif   
		      endif
		   
		      cId_Corte = Thisform.oTblMarcas.Leer("Id_Marca")
		      cFiltro = "Id_marca="+"'"+cId_Corte+"'"
		      Thisform.oTblArticulos.DesFiltrar()
		      Thisform.oTblArticulos.Filtrar(cFiltro)
		         
		      lHayArticulosCorte = .f.   
		         
		      Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrPrimero()
		      do while !Thisform.oTblArticulos.EsEof()
		         if Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lista_Precios") and !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo") 
		            lHayArticulosCorte = .t.
		            exit
		         endif
		         Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()    
		      enddo
		      
		      if lHayArticulosCorte
		      
		         append blank in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         replace id_articulo1 with space(15) in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		
		         append blank in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         replace id_articulo1 with space(15)                           in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         replace nombre1      with Thisform.oTblMarcas.Leer("Nombre")  in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         replace color        with "1"                                 in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         
		         append blank in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         replace id_articulo1 with space(15) in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		     
		         Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrPrimero()
		         
		         do while !Thisform.oTblArticulos.EsEof()
		         
		            if !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lista_Precios") or Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo")
		               Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()
		               loop
		            endif   
		
		            if Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lista_Precios") and !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo")
		   
		               cId_Articulo1 = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo")   
		               cNombre1 = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
		         
		               cId_Marca = cId_Corte
		               cId_Rubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Rubro")
		               cId_Subrubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Subrubro")
		      
		               if cId_Articulo1 >= Thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde and cId_Articulo1 <= Thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta;
		                                                             and (cId_Marca = Thisform.Id_Marca or Thisform.Id_Marca=space(3));
		                                                             and (cId_Rubro = Thisform.Id_Rubro or Thisform.Id_Rubro=space(3));
		                                                             and (cId_SubRubro = Thisform.Id_Subrubro or Thisform.Id_Subrubro=space(3))
		                  nPrecio1 = 0
		      
		                  if Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Buscar(cId_Articulo1+Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		                     nPrecio1 = Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")      
		                  endif   
		      
		                  nPrecio2 = 0
		
		                  if Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Buscar(cId_Articulo1+Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		                     nPrecio2 = Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")      
		                  endif
		            
		                  if nCol = 1
		                     append blank in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			                 replace Id_Articulo1 with cId_Articulo1 in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			                 replace Nombre1 		with cNombre1      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			                 replace Precio1      with nPrecio1      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		 	                 replace Precio2      with nPrecio2      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		               
		                     nCol=2
		                  else   
		
			                 replace Id_Articulo2 with cId_Articulo1 in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			                 replace Nombre2 		with cNombre1      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			                 replace Precio3      with nPrecio1      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		 	                 replace Precio4      with nPrecio2      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		            
		                     nCol=1
		                  endif
		                    
		               else
		               
		                  Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()
		                  loop
		                  
		               endif
		         
		            endif
		         
		            Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()    
		         enddo
		
		      endif
		
		      Thisform.oTblMarcas.IrSiguiente()
		   enddo 
		      
		endif
		
		if thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value=4
		
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.FijarTag("Nombre")
		   
		   Thisform.oTblRubros.IrPrimero()
		   
		   do while !Thisform.oTblRubros.EsEof()
		   
		      nCol=1 
		   
		      if Thisform.Id_Rubro <> space(3)
		         if Thisform.oTblRubros.Leer("Id_Rubro") <> Thisform.Id_Rubro
		            Thisform.oTblRubros.IrSiguiente()
		            loop
		         endif   
		      endif
		   
		      cId_Corte = Thisform.oTblRubros.Leer("Id_Rubro")
		      cFiltro = "Id_Rubro="+"'"+cId_Corte+"'"
		      Thisform.oTblArticulos.DesFiltrar()
		      Thisform.oTblArticulos.Filtrar(cFiltro)
		         
		      lHayArticulosCorte = .f.   
		         
		      Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrPrimero()
		      do while !Thisform.oTblArticulos.EsEof()
		         if Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lista_Precios") and !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo") 
		            lHayArticulosCorte = .t.
		            exit
		         endif
		         Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()    
		      enddo
		      
		      if lHayArticulosCorte
		      
		         append blank in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         replace id_articulo1 with space(15) in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		
		         append blank in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         replace id_articulo1 with space(15)                           in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         replace nombre1      with Thisform.oTblRubros.Leer("Nombre")  in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         replace color        with "1"                                 in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         
		         append blank in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         replace id_articulo1 with space(15) in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		     
		         Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrPrimero()
		         
		         do while !Thisform.oTblArticulos.EsEof()
		         
		            if !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lista_Precios") or Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo")
		               Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()
		               loop
		            endif   
		
		            if Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lista_Precios") and !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo")
		   
		               cId_Articulo1 = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo")   
		               cNombre1 = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
		         
		               cId_Marca = cId_Corte
		               cId_Rubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Rubro")
		               cId_Subrubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Subrubro")
		      
		               if cId_Articulo1 >= Thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde and cId_Articulo1 <= Thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta;
		                                                             and (cId_Marca = Thisform.Id_Marca or Thisform.Id_Marca=space(3));
		                                                             and (cId_Rubro = Thisform.Id_Rubro or Thisform.Id_Rubro=space(3));
		                                                             and (cId_SubRubro = Thisform.Id_Subrubro or Thisform.Id_Subrubro=space(3))
		                  nPrecio1 = 0
		      
		                  if Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Buscar(cId_Articulo1+Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		                     nPrecio1 = Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")      
		                  endif   
		      
		                  nPrecio2 = 0
		
		                  if Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Buscar(cId_Articulo1+Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		                     nPrecio2 = Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")      
		                  endif
		            
		                  if nCol = 1
		                     append blank in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			                 replace Id_Articulo1 with cId_Articulo1 in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			                 replace Nombre1 		with cNombre1      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			                 replace Precio1      with nPrecio1      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		 	                 replace Precio2      with nPrecio2      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		               
		                     nCol=2
		                  else   
		
			                 replace Id_Articulo2 with cId_Articulo1 in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			                 replace Nombre2 		with cNombre1      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			                 replace Precio3      with nPrecio1      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		 	                 replace Precio4      with nPrecio2      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		            
		                     nCol=1
		                  endif
		                    
		               else
		               
		                  Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()
		                  loop
		                  
		               endif
		         
		            endif
		         
		            Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()    
		         enddo
		
		      endif
		
		      Thisform.oTblRubros.IrSiguiente()
		   enddo 
		      
		endif
		         
		if thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value=5
		
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.FijarTag("Nombre")
		   
		   Thisform.oTblSubRubros.IrPrimero()
		   
		   do while !Thisform.oTblSubRubros.EsEof()
		   
		      nCol=1 
		   
		      if Thisform.Id_SubRubro <> space(3)
		         if Thisform.oTblSubRubros.Leer("Id_Rubro") <> Thisform.Id_SubRubro
		            Thisform.oTblSubRubros.IrSiguiente()
		            loop
		         endif   
		      endif
		   
		      cId_Corte = Thisform.oTblSubRubros.Leer("Id_SubRubro")
		      cFiltro = "Id_SubRubro="+"'"+cId_Corte+"'"
		      Thisform.oTblArticulos.DesFiltrar()
		      Thisform.oTblArticulos.Filtrar(cFiltro)
		         
		      lHayArticulosCorte = .f.   
		         
		      Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrPrimero()
		      do while !Thisform.oTblArticulos.EsEof()
		         if Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lista_Precios") and !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo") 
		            lHayArticulosCorte = .t.
		            exit
		         endif
		         Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()    
		      enddo
		      
		      if lHayArticulosCorte
		      
		         append blank in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         replace id_articulo1 with space(15) in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		
		         append blank in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         replace id_articulo1 with space(15)                           in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         replace nombre1      with Thisform.oTblSubRubros.Leer("Nombre")  in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         replace color        with "1"                                 in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         
		         append blank in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		         replace id_articulo1 with space(15) in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		     
		         Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrPrimero()
		         
		         do while !Thisform.oTblArticulos.EsEof()
		         
		            if !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lista_Precios") or Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo")
		               Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()
		               loop
		            endif   
		
		            if Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lista_Precios") and !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo")
		   
		               cId_Articulo1 = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo")   
		               cNombre1 = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
		         
		               cId_Marca = cId_Corte
		               cId_Rubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Rubro")
		               cId_Subrubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Subrubro")
		      
		               if cId_Articulo1 >= Thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde and cId_Articulo1 <= Thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta;
		                                                             and (cId_Marca = Thisform.Id_Marca or Thisform.Id_Marca=space(3));
		                                                             and (cId_Rubro = Thisform.Id_Rubro or Thisform.Id_Rubro=space(3));
		                                                             and (cId_SubRubro = Thisform.Id_Subrubro or Thisform.Id_Subrubro=space(3))
		                  nPrecio1 = 0
		      
		                  if Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Buscar(cId_Articulo1+Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		                     nPrecio1 = Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")      
		                  endif   
		      
		                  nPrecio2 = 0
		
		                  if Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Buscar(cId_Articulo1+Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		                     nPrecio2 = Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")      
		                  endif
		            
		                  if nCol = 1
		                     append blank in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			                 replace Id_Articulo1 with cId_Articulo1 in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			                 replace Nombre1 		with cNombre1      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			                 replace Precio1      with nPrecio1      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		 	                 replace Precio2      with nPrecio2      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		               
		                     nCol=2
		                  else   
		
			                 replace Id_Articulo2 with cId_Articulo1 in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			                 replace Nombre2 		with cNombre1      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
			                 replace Precio3      with nPrecio1      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		 	                 replace Precio4      with nPrecio2      in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		            
		                     nCol=1
		                  endif
		                    
		               else
		               
		                  Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()
		                  loop
		                  
		               endif
		         
		            endif
		         
		            Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()    
		         enddo
		
		      endif
		
		      Thisform.oTblSubRubros.IrSiguiente()
		   enddo 
		      
		endif
		         
		         
		Thisform.oTblArticulos.DesFiltrar()
		         
		go top in listapreciosdoscolumnas
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla1
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_Articulo1, cId_Articulo2, cNombre1, cNombre2, nPrecio1, nPrecio2, nPrecio3, nPrecio4, lHayArticulosCorte, cId_Corte
		Local vGrabacion, nCol
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		Dimension vGrabacion[1,2]
		
		thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Revertir()
		
		if thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta = space(15)
		   thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta = oApp.TomarMaximoString()
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Id_Marca = "TD"
		   thisform.Id_Marca = SPACE(3)
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Id_Rubro = "TD"
		   thisform.Id_Rubro = SPACE(3)
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Id_SubRubro = "TD"
		   thisform.Id_SubRubro = SPACE(3)
		endif   
		
		if thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value=1
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.FijarTag("Clave")
		endif   
		if thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value=2
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.FijarTag("Nombre")
		endif
		
		nCol=1
		
		if thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value=1 or thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value=2
		* barro los articulos y lleno la tabla auxiliar con los que van a lista de precios
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrPrimero()
		
		   do while !Thisform.oTblArticulos.EsEof()
		   
		      if !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lista_Precios") or Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo")
		         Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()
		         loop
		      endif   
		
		      if Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lista_Precios") and !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo")
		          
		         cId_Articulo1 = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo")   
		         cNombre1 = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
		         
		         cId_Marca = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Marca")
		         cId_Rubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Rubro")
		         cId_Subrubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Subrubro")
		      
		         if cId_Articulo1 >= Thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde and cId_Articulo1 <= Thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta;
		                                                       and (cId_Marca = Thisform.Id_Marca or Thisform.Id_Marca=space(3));
		                                                       and (cId_Rubro = Thisform.Id_Rubro or Thisform.Id_Rubro=space(3));
		                                                       and (cId_SubRubro = Thisform.Id_Subrubro or Thisform.Id_Subrubro=space(3))
		            nPrecio1 = 0
		      
		            if Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Buscar(cId_Articulo1+Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		               nPrecio1 = Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")      
		            endif   
		      
		            nPrecio2 = 0
		
		            if Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Buscar(cId_Articulo1+Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		               nPrecio2 = Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")      
		            endif
		            
		            if nCol = 1
			           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo1"   ,	cId_Articulo1 )
			           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre1"		  ,	cNombre1 ) 
			           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio1"        ,	nPrecio1 )
		 	           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio2"        ,	nPrecio2 )
		               thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		               nCol=2
		            else   
			           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo2"   ,	cId_Articulo1 )
			           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre2"		  ,	cNombre1 ) 
			           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio3"        ,	nPrecio1 )
		 	           =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio4"        ,	nPrecio2 )
		               thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		               nCol=1
		            endif
		              
		         else
		            Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()
		            loop
		         endif
		            
		      endif
		      
		      Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()
		      
		   enddo
		   
		Endif   
		
		* aca proceso si es por marca rubro o subrubro
		
		lHayArticulosCorte = .f.
		
		if thisform.Tg_OptionGroup1.Value=3
		
		   Thisform.oTblArticulos.FijarTag("Nombre")
		   
		   Thisform.oTblMarcas.IrPrimero()
		   
		   do while !Thisform.oTblMarcas.EsEof()
		   
		      nCol=1 
		   
		      if Thisform.Id_marca <> space(3)
		         if Thisform.oTblMarcas.Leer("Id_Marca") <> Thisform.Id_Marca
		            Thisform.oTblMarcas.IrSiguiente()
		            loop
		         endif   
		      endif
		   
		      cId_Corte = Thisform.oTblMarcas.Leer("Id_Marca")
		      cFiltro = "Id_marca="+"'"+cId_Corte+"'"
		      Thisform.oTblArticulos.DesFiltrar()
		      Thisform.oTblArticulos.Filtrar(cFiltro)
		         
		      lHayArticulosCorte = .f.   
		         
		      Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrPrimero()
		      do while !Thisform.oTblArticulos.EsEof()
		         if Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lista_Precios") and !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo") 
		            lHayArticulosCorte = .t.
		            exit
		         endif
		         Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()    
		      enddo
		      
		      if lHayArticulosCorte
		      
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo1" , space(15))
		         thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		    
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo1" , space(15))
			     =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre1"		 , Thisform.oTblMarcas.Leer("Nombre")) 
			     =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Color"		 , "1") 
		         thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		         
		         =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo1" , space(15))
		         thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		
		      
		         Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrPrimero()
		         
		         do while !Thisform.oTblArticulos.EsEof()
		         
		            if !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lista_Precios") or Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo")
		               Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()
		               loop
		            endif   
		
		            if Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lista_Precios") and !Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Inactivo")
		   
		               cId_Articulo1 = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Articulo")   
		               cNombre1 = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
		         
		               cId_Marca = cId_Corte
		               cId_Rubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Rubro")
		               cId_Subrubro = Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Subrubro")
		      
		               if cId_Articulo1 >= Thisform.Id_ArticuloDesde and cId_Articulo1 <= Thisform.Id_ArticuloHasta;
		                                                             and (cId_Marca = Thisform.Id_Marca or Thisform.Id_Marca=space(3));
		                                                             and (cId_Rubro = Thisform.Id_Rubro or Thisform.Id_Rubro=space(3));
		                                                             and (cId_SubRubro = Thisform.Id_Subrubro or Thisform.Id_Subrubro=space(3))
		                  nPrecio1 = 0
		      
		                  if Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Buscar(cId_Articulo1+Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios1.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		                     nPrecio1 = Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")      
		                  endif   
		      
		                  nPrecio2 = 0
		
		                  if Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Buscar(cId_Articulo1+Thisform.Tg_CmbListaPrecios2.Value,.f.,"Clave")
		                     nPrecio2 = Thisform.oTblVnt_Precios.Leer("Precio")      
		                  endif
		            
		                  if nCol=1        
			                 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo1"   ,	cId_Articulo1 )
			                 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre1"		   ,	cNombre1 ) 
			                 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio1"        ,	nPrecio1 )
		 	                 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio2"        ,	nPrecio2 )
		                     thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
		                     nCol=2
		                  else
			                 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Articulo2"   ,	cId_Articulo1 )
			                 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre2"		  ,	cNombre1 ) 
			                 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio3"        ,	nPrecio1 )
		 	                 =fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Precio4"        ,	nPrecio2 )
		                     thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Modificar(@vGrabacion,.f.,.t.)
		                     nCol=1
		                  endif
		                    
		               else
		               
		                  Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()
		                  loop
		                  
		               endif
		         
		            endif
		         
		            Thisform.oTblArticulos.IrSiguiente()    
		         enddo
		
		      endif
		
		      Thisform.oTblMarcas.IrSiguiente()
		   enddo 
		      
		endif
		         
		Thisform.oTblArticulos.DesFiltrar()
		         
		thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.IrPrimero()
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Local cMascaraDatos, mmpp
		
		cMascaraDatos = replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("enteros_precio"))+"."+replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("decimales_precio"))
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Alias
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Alias+".Id_Articulo1"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Alias+".nombre1"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Alias+".Precio1"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Alias+".Precio2"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Alias+".Id_Articulo2"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Alias+".nombre2"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Alias+".Precio3"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Alias+".Precio4"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.Inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.Inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.Inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.Inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.Header1.Caption = alltrim(Thisform.tg_TextBox1.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.Header1.Caption = alltrim(Thisform.tg_TextBox2.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.Header1.Caption = alltrim(Thisform.tg_TextBox1.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.Header1.Caption = alltrim(Thisform.tg_TextBox2.Value)
		
		cStringcolor = 'Iif(alltrim(thisForm.oTblAux_ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Leer("Color"))<>" ",rgb(128,255,255),"")'
		
		for mmpp = 1 to thisform.tg_grid1.Columncount
		    thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicBackColor = cStringcolor
		endfor    
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla1
		Local cMascaraDatos, mmpp
		
		cMascaraDatos = replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("enteros_precio"))+"."+replicate("9",thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("decimales_precio"))
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource="ListaPreciosDosColumnas"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource="ListaPreciosDosColumnas.id_Articulo1"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource="ListaPreciosDosColumnas.nombre1"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource="ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Precio1"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource="ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Precio2"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource="ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Id_Articulo2"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource="ListaPreciosDosColumnas.nombre2"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource="ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Precio3"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource="ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Precio4"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.Inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.Inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.Inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.Inputmask = cMascaraDatos
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.Header1.Caption = alltrim(Thisform.tg_TextBox1.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.Header1.Caption = alltrim(Thisform.tg_TextBox2.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.Header1.Caption = alltrim(Thisform.tg_TextBox1.Value)
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.Header1.Caption = alltrim(Thisform.tg_TextBox2.Value)
		
		cStringcolor = 'Iif(alltrim(ListaPreciosDosColumnas.Color)<>" ",rgb(128,255,255),"")'
		
		for mmpp = 1 to thisform.tg_grid1.Columncount
		    thisform.tg_Grid1.Columns(mmpp).DynamicBackColor = cStringcolor
		endfor    
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
	ENDPROC

		*thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		thisform.RefrescarComsulta1
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmblistaprecios2.InteractiveChange
		Thisform.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled = .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton2.Click
		If Type("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos","TG_FrmFiltroArticulos")				
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Show()
		
		IF  thisform.Id_articuloDesde<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde or ;
			thisform.Id_articuloHasta<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta  or;	
			thisform.id_Marca<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca  or;
			thisform.id_rubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro  or;
			thisform.id_Subrubro<>thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro  
		
		
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
			ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		
		
		thisform.Id_articuloDesde=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloDesde
		thisform.Id_articuloHasta=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.Id_articuloHasta
		thisform.id_Marca=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Marca
		thisform.id_rubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_rubro
		thisform.id_Subrubro=thisform.oFrmFiltroArticulos.id_Subrubro
		
		
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_optiongroup1.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularcomprobantespendientes
		LParameters cId_Cliente,cId_Comproba,nTipoCotizacion,cId_Moneda,vCmpPendientes,cId_EstadoAprobado
		Local nSaldo
		nSaldo=0
		
		*@0423/1@*
		Thisform.oCstSistemaVentas.ConsultarComprobantesPendientes(cId_Cliente,cId_Comproba,nTipoCotizacion,cId_Moneda,@nSaldo,@vCmpPendientes,cId_EstadoAprobado,.t.)
		*@0423/1@*
		
		return nSaldo
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularcreditopendiente
		Local nSaldo
		
		nSaldo=ThisForm.oTbxCred_Maximo.Value
		
		nSaldo=nSaldo - ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.Value
		
		nSaldo=nSaldo - ThisForm.oTbxVal_Pendientes.Value
		nSaldo=nSaldo - ThisForm.oTbxComptesPendientes.Value
		
		****** david 28/12 ********
		ThisForm.oTbxCred_Disponible.Value =nSaldo
		
		If nSaldo >= 0
			thisform.oTbxCred_Disponible.disabledBackcolor= RGB(192,192,192) 
		Else
		    thisform.oTbxCred_Disponible.disabledBackcolor= RGB(255,128,128) 	
		Endif	
		
		****** david 28/12 ********
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularsaldocliente
		LParameters cId_cliente,cId_Moneda,dFechaHasta,dFechaDesde
		
		Local nSaldo
		
		nSaldo=Thisform.oCstSistemaVentas.ConsultarSaldo(cId_cliente,cId_Moneda,dFechaHasta,dFechaDesde,,,ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value=1)
		
		ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.Value=nSaldo
		
		if Thisform.oCstSistemaVentas.ClienteMoroso (cId_cliente)
			ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.DisabledBackColor = Rgb(255,0,0)
			ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.DisabledForeColor = Rgb(255,255,255)
		else
			ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.DisabledBackColor = Rgb(192,192,192)
			ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.DisabledForeColor = Rgb(0,0,0)
		endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularvalorespendientes
		lParameters cId_Cliente,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,nCorrimiento
		
		Local nSaldo,vResultado,i,vValores
		
		*@0423/1@
		Dimension Thisform.vValores[1]
		Thisform.vValores[1]=.f.
		
		Thisform.oCstSistemaVentas.ConsultarValoresPendientes(cId_Cliente,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,@nSaldo,@vResultado,@vValores,nCorrimiento)
		*@0423/1@
		ThisForm.oTbxVal_Pendientes.Value=nSaldo
		Thisform.vResultado=.f.
		
		If Type("vResultado") <> "L"
			Dimension Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1) ,5]
			
			For i= 1 to Alen(vResultado,1)
				
				Thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Buscar(vResultado[i,1],.f.,"Clave")
				Thisform.oTblCaj_Estados.Buscar(vResultado[i,2],.f.,"Clave")
			
				Thisform.vResultado[i,1] = vResultado[i,1]
				Thisform.vResultado[i,2] = Thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Nombre")
				Thisform.vResultado[i,3] = vResultado[i,2]
				Thisform.vResultado[i,4] = Left(Thisform.oTblCaj_Estados.Leer("Nombre"),10)
				Thisform.vResultado[i,5] = STR(vResultado[i,3],10,2)
			Next
		    
		    Dimension Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+2 ,5]
		    
		  Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+1,1] = " "
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+1,2] = " "
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+1,3] = " "
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+1,4] = space(10)
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+1,5] = space(10)
		
		  Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+2,1] = "TD"
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+2,2] = "Total" 
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+2,3] = " "
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+2,4] = space(10)
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+2,5] = STR(nSaldo,10,2)
		
			
			*@0423/1@
			If Type(vValores) <> "L"
				Dimension Thisform.vValores[Alen(vValores)]
				For i= 1 to Alen(vValores)
					Thisform.vValores[i] = vValores[i]
				Next
			Else
				Dimension Thisform.vValores[1]
				Thisform.vValores[1]=.f.
			Endif
			*@0423/1@
		Endif
		
		Thisform.RefrescarListaValores()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE controlarcambioscomprobante
		Local cId_Cliente,nTipoCotizacion,cId_Moneda, nImpTotal_Pendiente, nIndice,nImpTotal_PendienteAprobado
		*@0423/1@*
		Local vCmpPendientes
		
		Dimension Thisform.vCmpPendientes[1] 
		Thisform.vCmpPendientes[1] = .f.
		*@0423/1@*
		
		Dimension thisform.vComprobaPendientes[1,4] 
		thisform.vComprobaPendientes[1,1]= .f.
		thisForm.oTbxComptesPendientes.Value=0
		
		CId_Cliente			=	ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value
		nTipoCotizacion     =	ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
		cId_Moneda			=	ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
		nImpTotal_Pendiente =   0
		nImpTotal_PendienteAprobado=0
		nIndice= 1
		
		If !Empty(cId_Cliente)
		   Thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		   thisform.oVnt_Docu.IrPrimero
		   Do While !thisform.oVnt_Docu.EsEof()
		      If thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Panel_Control_Cliente")
		      	*@0423/1@*
		         nImpTotal_Pendiente= thisform.CalcularComprobantesPendientes(cId_Cliente,thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Comproba"),nTipoCotizacion,cId_Moneda,@vCmpPendientes)
		         nImpTotal_PendienteAprobado= Thisform.oCstSistemaVentas.consultarcomprobantespendientesestados(cId_Cliente,thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Comproba"),nTipoCotizacion,cId_Moneda,0,@vCmpPendientes,.t.)         
		         
		*!*	         If !empty(thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("id_estado_cred_disponible"))
		*!*		         nImpTotal_PendienteAprobado= thisform.CalcularComprobantesPendientes(cId_Cliente,thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Comproba"),nTipoCotizacion,cId_Moneda,@vCmpPendientes,thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("id_estado_cred_disponible"))         
		*!*		     Else    
		*!*			     nImpTotal_PendienteAprobado=nImpTotal_Pendiente
		*!*		     Endif    
		        *@0423/1@* 
		      
		         ThisForm.oTbxComptesPendientes.Value=	ThisForm.oTbxComptesPendientes.Value + nImpTotal_PendienteAprobado
			     if Type("thisform.vComprobaPendientes[1,1]") <> "L"
		            nIndice= Alen(thisform.vComprobaPendientes,1)+1
		            Dimension thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 4] 
		         endif    
		        
		         thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 1]= thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Nombre")
		         thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 2]= nImpTotal_Pendiente
		         thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 3]= thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		         thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 4]= nImpTotal_PendienteAprobado
		      Endif
		      thisform.oVnt_Docu.IrSiguiente
		   Enddo
		   Thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		Endif	
		
		*@0423/1@*
		If Type("vCmpPendientes") <> "L"
			Dimension Thisform.vCmpPendientes[Alen(vCmpPendientes)]
			=Acopy(vCmpPendientes,Thisform.vCmpPendientes)
		Else
			Dimension Thisform.vCmpPendientes[1] 
			Thisform.vCmpPendientes[1] = .f.
		Endif
		*@0423/1@*
		
		thisform.RefrescarListaPendientes()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE deshabilitarbotones
		ThisForm.oCmdDatos.enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.oCmdCtaCorriente.enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.enabled=.f.
		Thisform.PonerSaldosCero()
		ThisForm.oLbxValoresPendientes.Clear
		ThisForm.olbxComprobaPendientes.Clear
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutar
		Local cId_Cliente,cId_moneda,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,nTipoCotizacion
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		
		dFechaHasta =     oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()
		dFechaDesde =     Ctod(" ")
		cId_Moneda	=     ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
		cId_Cliente	=     ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value
		nTipoCotizacion = ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
		
		ThisForm.oTbxCred_Maximo.Value     = Thisform.oCstConvMonUniversal.Convertir(Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("credito_maximo"),Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("id_moneda_cta"),0,ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value,0,,)	
		
		Thisform.CalcularSaldoCliente(cId_Cliente,cId_moneda,dFechaHasta,dFechaDesde)
		Thisform.CalcularValoresPendientes(cId_Cliente,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,ThisForm.oSpnCorrimiento.Value )
		Thisform.ControlarCambiosComprobante()
		Thisform.CalcularCreditoPendiente()
		*Thisform.GrabarGrilla()
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabargrilla
		Local vDatos[1,2],vVec[5],i,cTexto
		
		
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.Revertir()
		
		*@0423/1@
		vVec[1] = "Credito maximo:            " +Str(ThisForm.oTbxCred_Maximo.Value,15,2)
		vVec[2] = "Saldo:                     " +Str(ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.Value,15,2)
		vVec[3] = "Valores pendientes:        " +Str(ThisForm.oTbxVal_Pendientes.Value,15,2)
		vVec[4] = "Comprobantes pendientes:   " +Str(ThisForm.oTbxComptesPendientes.Value,15,2)
		vVec[5] = "Credito disponible:        " +Str(ThisForm.oTbxCred_Disponible.Value,15,2)
		
		
		For i= 1 To Alen(vVec,1)
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto", vVec[i] )
			thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		Next
		**** Valores Pendientes
		
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto", Space(120) )
		thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		
		thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Refrescar(ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value,ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),2)
		
		
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto", Replicate("-",120) )
		thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto", "Pendientes Cuenta Corriente" )
		thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto", Replicate("-",120) )
		thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		
		thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.IrPrimero()
			
		cTexto = "Suc Cmp Referencia  Nro Externo    Fecha         Debe      Haber    Pendiente"
			
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto",  cTexto )
		thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
				
		Do While Not thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.EsEof()
			cTexto = thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Sucursal") + " " + thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Id_Comproba") +" "+ ;
					Str(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),10) + " "+ thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Nro_Externo") + " " + ;
					Dtoc(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Fecha"))+ " "+ Str(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Debe"),12,2) + " " +;
					Str(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("Haber"),12,2)+ " " + Str(thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.Leer("ImpPendiente"),12,2)
							
				
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto", cTexto )
			thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
				
			thisform.oViewCtaCorrienteClientes.IrSiguiente()
		EndDo
		
		
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto", Space(120) )
		thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto", Replicate("-",120) )
		thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto", "Valores pendientes " )
		thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto", Replicate("-",120) )
		thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		If Type("Thisform.vValores[1]") <> "L"
			*!*	cDato  =id_sucursal+" "+id_sistema+" "+id_Comproba+" "+ Nro_Externo + " " +;
			*!*	  Fecha + " " + orden +" " + Id_Valor +" "+ Id_moneda + " " + monto + " " +NombreEstado
		
		
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto",  "Suc S Cmp      Nro Externo      Fecha     Orden    Valor     Monto      Venc     Estado" )
			thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
			
			For i= 1 to Alen(Thisform.vValores)
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto",  Thisform.vValores[i] )
				thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
			Next
		Else
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto", "No se registran valores pendientes" )
			thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto", Space(120) )
			thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		Endif
		
		*** Comprobantes Pendientes
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto", Replicate("-",120) )
		thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto", "Comprobantes pendientes " )
		thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto", Replicate("-",120) )
		thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		If Type("Thisform.vCmpPendientes[1]") <> "L"
		*!*		cDato =	This.Leer("id_sucursal")+" "+;
		*!*				This.Leer("id_sistema")+" "+;
		*!*				This.Leer("id_comproba")+" "+;
		*!*				This.Leer("nro_externo")+" "+;
		*!*				Dtoc(This.Leer("fecha"))+" "+;
		*!*				This.Leer("id_mon_deuda")+" "+;
		*!*				Str(This.Leer("Pendiente"),15,4)+" "+;
		*!*				Dtoc(This.Leer("Vencimiento"))
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto",  "Suc S Cmp  Nro Externo    Fecha   Mon.    Pendiente   Fec.Venc.  " )
			thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
			For i= 1 to Alen(Thisform.vCmpPendientes)
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto",  Thisform.vCmpPendientes[i] )
				thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
			Next
		Else
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto", "No se registran comprobantes pendientes" )
			thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
			=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Texto", Space(120) )
			thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		Endif
		*@0423/1@
		
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE habilitarbotones
		ThisForm.oCmdDatos.enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.oCmdCtaCorriente.enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.enabled=.t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DoDefault()
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblClientes"    ,"Tg_Tabla","Clientes","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros"  ,"Tg_Tabla","Parametros")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCaj_Valores" ,"Tg_Tabla","Caj_Valores","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCaj_Estados" ,"tg_Tabla","Caj_Estados","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_Docu"       ,"Tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oCstSistemaVentas","Tg_SistemaVentas")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewCtaCorrienteClientes","Tg_ViewCtaCorrienteClientes")
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_PanelClientes","Tg_Tabla","Aux_PanelClientes")
		Thisform.AddObject("oCstConvMonUniversal","tg_ConvMonUniversal")
		
		
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.SetearProp("BOT")
		Thisform.PonerSaldosCero()
		Thisform.DesHabilitarBotones()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ponersaldoscero
		ThisForm.oTbxCred_Maximo.Value=     0
		ThisForm.oTbxVal_Pendientes.Value=  0
		ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.Value=           0
		ThisForm.oTbxCred_Disponible.Value= 0
		ThisForm.oTbxComptesPendientes.Value= 0
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.Revertir()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.IrPrimero()
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.Alias
		
		*@0423/1@
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.controlSource= Thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.Alias + ".Texto"
		*@0423/1@
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
		Thisform.Lockscreen=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarlistapendientes
		Local i
		
		ThisForm.oLbxComprobaPendientes.clear
		
		if Type("thisform.vComprobaPendientes") <> "L"
			For i= 1 to Alen(thisform.vComprobaPendientes,1)
				ThisForm.oLbxComprobaPendientes.AddItem(thisform.vComprobaPendientes[i,1])
				ThisForm.oLbxComprobaPendientes.List( i,2)= Str(thisform.vComprobaPendientes[i,2],10,2)
				ThisForm.oLbxComprobaPendientes.List( i,3)= Str(thisform.vComprobaPendientes[i,4],10,2)
				
			Next
		*!*		ThisForm.oLbxComprobaPendientes.SetFocus()
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarlistavalores
		Local i
		
		ThisForm.oLbxValoresPendientes.clear
		
		if Type("Thisform.vResultado") <> "L"
			For i= 1 to Alen(Thisform.vResultado,1)
				ThisForm.oLbxValoresPendientes.AddItem(	Thisform.vResultado[i,2])
				ThisForm.oLbxValoresPendientes.List( i,2)= Thisform.vResultado[i,4]
				ThisForm.oLbxValoresPendientes.List( i,3)= Thisform.vResultado[i,5]
			Next
			*Str(Thisform.vResultado[i,5],10,2)
		*!*		ThisForm.oLbxValoresPendientes.SetFocus()
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE salir
		Thisform.Release
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validarcliente
		LParameters cId_Cliente
		ThisForm.oTbxCred_Maximo.Value       = 0
		ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.Value             = 0
		ThisForm.oTbxVal_Pendientes.Value    = 0
		ThisForm.oTbxCred_Disponible.Value   = 0
		ThisForm.oTbxComptesPendientes.Value = 0
		
		If Thisform.oTblClientes.Buscar(cId_Cliente,.f.,"Clave")
		
			ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value=ThisForm.oTblClientes.Leer("id_moneda_cta")
			Thisform.Old_Moneda		=	ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
			Thisform.OldTipoCotiza	=	ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
		
			If Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("Bloqueo")
				Thisform.oTbBloqueo.Visible = .t.
			else
				Thisform.oTbBloqueo.Visible = .f.
			endif
			ThisForm.oLblNombreCliente.Caption = Thisform.oTblClientes.Leer("razon_social")
			
		
					
			Thisform.Ejecutar()
			
			Thisform.HabilitarBotones()
		Else
			=fMensAceptar("Cliente inexistente!")
			ThisForm.oLblNombreCliente.Caption = ""
			Thisform.DesHabilitarBotones()
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE visualizar
		LParameters nIndice
		
		Local cId_Cliente,cId_moneda,nTipoCotizacion,cId_ValorUnico,cId_EstadoUnico
		
		If nIndice <> 0 .and. !Empty(Thisform.vResultado[nindice,1])
			cId_Cliente		= ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value 
			cId_moneda		= ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
			nTipoCotizacion	= ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
		
			If Upper(Thisform.vResultado[nindice,1]) <> Upper("TD")
				cId_ValorUnico  = Thisform.vResultado[nindice,1]
				cId_EstadoUnico	= Thisform.vResultado[nindice,3]
			Endif
		
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsulta")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsulta","tg_consvaloresentregados",cId_Cliente,cId_moneda,nTipoCotizacion,cId_ValorUnico,cId_EstadoUnico,.t.)				
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsulta.EjecutarConsulta(cId_Cliente,cId_moneda,nTipoCotizacion,cId_ValorUnico,cId_EstadoUnico,.t.)			
			Endif	
			thisform.oFrmConsulta.Show()
		
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE visualizarcomprobapendiente
		LParameters nIndice
		
		Local cId_Cliente,cId_moneda,nTipoCotizacion,cId_Comproba
		
		If nIndice <> 0 
		   cId_Cliente	= ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value 
		   cId_moneda	= ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
		
		   If Type("thisform.vComprobaPendientes[1,1]") <> "L"
			  cId_Comproba = thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nindice,3]
		   else
		      cId_Comproba = " "
		   Endif
		
		   If Type("thisform.oFrmConsComprobaPendiente")<>T_OBJECT			 
			  thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsComprobaPendiente","tg_ComaDescargarCliente",cId_Cliente,cId_Comproba,cId_moneda )				
		   Else
		      Thisform.oFrmConsComprobaPendiente.EjecutarSeleccion(cId_Cliente,cId_Comproba,cId_moneda)			
		  Endif	
		  thisform.oFrmConsComprobaPendiente.Show()
		
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCtaCorriente.Click
		thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsCtaCorriente","tg_ctacorrienteclientes",ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value)				
		thisform.oFrmConsCtaCorriente.Show()
		
		
	ENDPROC

		Local oAbmGen

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutar.Click
		Thisform.Ejecutar()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE olbxComprobaPendientes.DblClick

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oLbxValoresPendientes.DblClick
		Thisform.Visualizar(This.ListIndex)
	ENDPROC

		If Empty(ThisForm.Tg_clientes1.Value)
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled = .t.
		Endif
	ENDPROC

			 Endif
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

			 Thisform.Old_Moneda =	ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
			 If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			 		Thisform.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=.t.
			 Endif
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularcomprobantespendientes
		LParameters cId_GrupoEmpresario,cId_Comproba,nTipoCotizacion,cId_Moneda,vSaldo
		
		Thisform.oCstSistemaVentas.ConsultarComprobantesPendientesGrupoEmpresario(cId_GrupoEmpresario,cId_Comproba,nTipoCotizacion,cId_Moneda,@vSaldo)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularcreditopendiente
		Local nSaldo
		
		nSaldo=ThisForm.oTbxCred_Maximo.Value
		
		nSaldo=nSaldo - ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.Value
		
		nSaldo=nSaldo - ThisForm.oTbxVal_Pendientes.Value
		nSaldo=nSaldo - ThisForm.oTbxComptesPendientes.Value
		If nSaldo > 0
			ThisForm.oTbxCred_Disponible.Value =nSaldo
		Else
			ThisForm.oTbxCred_Disponible.Value =0
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularsaldogrupo
		LParameters cId_GrupoEmpresario,cId_Moneda
		
		Local nSaldo
		
		nSaldo=Thisform.oCstSistemaVentas.ConsultarSaldoGrupoEmpresario(cId_GrupoEmpresario,cId_Moneda)
		
		ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.Value=nSaldo
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE calcularvalorespendientes
		lParameters cId_GrupoEmpresario,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion
		
		Local nSaldo,vResultado,i
		
		Thisform.oCstSistemaVentas.ConsultarValoresPendientesGrupoEmpresario(cId_GrupoEmpresario,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,@nSaldo,@vResultado)
		ThisForm.oTbxVal_Pendientes.Value=nSaldo
		Thisform.vResultado=.f.
		
		If Type("vResultado") <> "L"
			Dimension Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1) ,7]
		
			For i= 1 to Alen(vResultado,1)
				
				Thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Buscar(vResultado[i,1],.f.,"Clave")
				Thisform.oTblCaj_Estados.Buscar(vResultado[i,2],.f.,"Clave")
			
				Thisform.vResultado[i,1] = vResultado[i,1]
				Thisform.vResultado[i,2] = Thisform.oTblCaj_Valores.Leer("Nombre")
				Thisform.vResultado[i,3] = vResultado[i,2]
				Thisform.vResultado[i,4] = Left(Thisform.oTblCaj_Estados.Leer("Nombre"),10)
				Thisform.vResultado[i,5] = STR(vResultado[i,3],10,2)
				Thisform.vResultado[i,6] = vResultado[i,4]
				Thisform.vResultado[i,7] = vResultado[i,5]	
			Next
		    
		    Dimension Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+2 ,7]
		    
		  Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+1,1] = " "
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+1,2] = " "
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+1,3] = " "
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+1,4] = space(10)
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+1,5] = space(10)
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+1,6] = Space(5)
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+1,7] = Space(40)
		
		  Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+2,1] = "TD"
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+2,2] = "Total" 
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+2,3] = " "
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+2,4] = space(10)
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+2,5] = STR(nSaldo,10,2)
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+2,6] = Space(5)
			Thisform.vResultado[Alen(vResultado,1)+2,7] = Space(40)
		
		Endif
		
		Thisform.RefrescarListaValores()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE controlarcambioscomprobante
		Local cId_GrupoEmpresario,nTipoCotizacion,cId_Moneda, nImpTotal_Pendiente, nIndice
		Local vSaldo,i
		
		Dimension thisform.vComprobaPendientes[1,5] 
		thisform.vComprobaPendientes[1,1]= .f.
		
		cId_GrupoEmpresario	=	ThisForm.Tg_gruposempresarios1.Value
		nTipoCotizacion     =	ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
		cId_Moneda			=	ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
		nImpTotal_Pendiente =   0
		nIndice= 1
		
		If !Empty(cId_GrupoEmpresario)
		   Thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		   thisform.oVnt_Docu.IrPrimero
		   Do While !thisform.oVnt_Docu.EsEof()
		      If thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("List_Com_Pen")
		      	 vSaldo = .f.
		      
		       thisform.CalcularComprobantesPendientes(cId_GrupoEmpresario,thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Comproba"),nTipoCotizacion,cId_Moneda,@vSaldo)
		      
		      	If Type("vSaldo") <> "L"
		      		For i = 1 to Alen(vSaldo,1)
		*!*		            vSaldo[1,1] = Id_cliente
		*!*	   	            vSaldo[1,2] = Nombre
		*!*		            vSaldo[1,3] = Saldo    
			            
			            ThisForm.oTbxComptesPendientes.Value=	ThisForm.oTbxComptesPendientes.Value + vSaldo[i,3]
			            
					     if Type("thisform.vComprobaPendientes[1,1]") <> "L"
			        	    nIndice= Alen(thisform.vComprobaPendientes,1)+1
				            Dimension thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 5] 
				         Endif    
		        
				         thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 1]= thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Nombre")
		        		 thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 2]= vSaldo[i,3]
				         thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 3]= thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		   		         thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 4]= vSaldo[i,1]
		  		         thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 5]= vSaldo[i,2]
				    Next
				Else
					if Type("thisform.vComprobaPendientes[1,1]") <> "L"
		        	    nIndice= Alen(thisform.vComprobaPendientes,1)+1
			            Dimension thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 5] 
			         Endif    
		        
			         thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 1]= thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Nombre")
		       		 thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 2]= 0
			         thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 3]= thisform.oVnt_Docu.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		   	         thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 4]= space(5)
		  	         thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 5]= Space(40)
				Endif   
		      Endif
		      
		      thisform.oVnt_Docu.IrSiguiente()
		   Enddo
		   Thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		Endif	
		
		thisform.RefrescarListaPendientes()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE deshabilitarbotones
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutar
		Local cId_GrupoEmpresario,cId_moneda,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,nTipoCotizacion
		
		dFechaHasta = oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()
		dFechaDesde = Ctod(" ")
		cId_Moneda	=	ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
		cId_GrupoEmpresario	= ThisForm.Tg_gruposempresarios1.Value
		nTipoCotizacion=ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		
		Thisform.CalcularSaldoGrupo(cId_GrupoEmpresario,cId_moneda)
		Thisform.CalcularValoresPendientes(cId_GrupoEmpresario,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion)
		Thisform.ControlarCambiosComprobante()
		Thisform.CalcularCreditoPendiente()
		Thisform.GrabarGrilla()
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabargrilla
		Local vDatos[1,2]
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.Revertir()
		
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Cred_Maximo"			,ThisForm.oTbxCred_Maximo.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Saldo"				,ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Val_Pendientes"		,ThisForm.oTbxVal_Pendientes.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"ComptesPendientes"	,ThisForm.oTbxComptesPendientes.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Cred_Disponible"		,thisForm.oTbxCred_Disponible.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Moneda"				,ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value)
		=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Historica"			,iif(ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value=1,.t.,.f.) )
		
		thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE habilitarbotones
		ThisForm.oCmdDatos.enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.oCmdCtaCorriente.enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.enabled=.t.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DoDefault()
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblGruposEmpresarios","Tg_Tabla","GruposEmpresarios","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","Tg_Tabla","Parametros")
		Thisform.AddObject("oCstSistemaVentas","Tg_SistemaVentas")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCaj_Valores","Tg_Tabla","Caj_Valores","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCaj_Estados","tg_Tabla","Caj_Estados","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oVnt_Docu","Tg_tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		**** Martin
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_PanelClientes","Tg_Tabla","Aux_PanelClientes")
		**** Martin
		
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value=ThisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("mon_def")
		Thisform.Old_Moneda			=	ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
		Thisform.OldTipoCotiza	=	ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
		
		**** Martin
		Thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.SetearProp("BOT")
		**** Martin
		Thisform.PonerSaldosCero()
		Thisform.DesHabilitarBotones()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ponersaldoscero
		ThisForm.oTbxCred_Maximo.Value=     0
		ThisForm.oTbxVal_Pendientes.Value=  0
		ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.Value=           0
		ThisForm.oTbxCred_Disponible.Value= 0
		ThisForm.oTbxComptesPendientes.Value= 0
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.Revertir()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.IrPrimero()
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.Alias
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.controlSource= Thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.Alias + ".Cred_Maximo"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource= Thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.Alias + ".Saldo"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource= Thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.Alias + ".Val_Pendientes"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource= Thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.Alias + ".ComptesPendientes"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource= Thisform.oTblAux_PanelClientes.Alias + ".Cred_Disponible"
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
		Thisform.Lockscreen=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarlistapendientes
		Local i
		
		ThisForm.oLbxComprobaPendientes.clear
		
		if Type("thisform.vComprobaPendientes") <> "L"
			For i= 1 to Alen(thisform.vComprobaPendientes,1)
				ThisForm.oLbxComprobaPendientes.AddItem(thisform.vComprobaPendientes[i,1])
				ThisForm.oLbxComprobaPendientes.List( i,2)= Str(thisform.vComprobaPendientes[i,2],10,2)
				ThisForm.oLbxComprobaPendientes.List( i,3)= thisform.vComprobaPendientes[i,4]
				ThisForm.oLbxComprobaPendientes.List( i,4)= thisform.vComprobaPendientes[i,5]
		
			Next
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarlistavalores
		Local i
		
		ThisForm.oLbxValoresPendientes.clear
		
		if Type("Thisform.vResultado") <> "L"
			For i= 1 to Alen(Thisform.vResultado,1)
				ThisForm.oLbxValoresPendientes.AddItem(	Thisform.vResultado[i,2])
				ThisForm.oLbxValoresPendientes.List( i,2)= Thisform.vResultado[i,4]
				ThisForm.oLbxValoresPendientes.List( i,3)= Thisform.vResultado[i,5]
				ThisForm.oLbxValoresPendientes.List( i,4)= Thisform.vResultado[i,6]
				ThisForm.oLbxValoresPendientes.List( i,5)= Thisform.vResultado[i,7]
		
		
			Next
			*Str(Thisform.vResultado[i,5],10,2)
		*!*		ThisForm.oLbxValoresPendientes.SetFocus()
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE salir
		Thisform.Release
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validargrupo
		LParameters cId_GrupoEmpresario
		
		ThisForm.oTbxCred_Maximo.Value= 0
		ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.Value= 0
		ThisForm.oTbxVal_Pendientes.Value= 0
		ThisForm.oTbxCred_Disponible.Value= 0
		ThisForm.oTbxComptesPendientes.Value= 0
		
		If Thisform.oTblGruposEmpresarios.Buscar(cId_GrupoEmpresario,.f.,"Clave")
			ThisForm.oLblNombreGrupoEmpresario.Caption = Thisform.oTblGruposEmpresarios.Leer("nombre")
			ThisForm.oTbxCred_Maximo.Value   = Thisform.oTblGruposEmpresarios.Leer("monto_credito")	
				
			Thisform.Ejecutar()
			
			Thisform.HabilitarBotones()
		Else
			=fMensAceptar("Grupo inexistente!")
			ThisForm.oLblNombreGrupoEmpresario.Caption = ""
			Thisform.DesHabilitarBotones()
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE visualizar
		LParameters nIndice
		
		Local cId_Cliente,cId_moneda,nTipoCotizacion,cId_ValorUnico,cId_EstadoUnico
		
		If nIndice <> 0 .and. !Empty(Thisform.vResultado[nindice,1])
		
			cId_moneda		= ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
			nTipoCotizacion	= ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
		
			If Upper(Thisform.vResultado[nindice,1]) <> Upper("TD")
				cId_ValorUnico  = Thisform.vResultado[nindice,1]
				cId_EstadoUnico	= Thisform.vResultado[nindice,3]
				cId_Cliente		= Thisform.vResultado[nIndice,6]
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsulta")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsulta","tg_consvaloresentregados",cId_Cliente,cId_moneda,nTipoCotizacion,cId_ValorUnico,cId_EstadoUnico,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsulta.EjecutarConsulta(cId_Cliente,cId_moneda,nTipoCotizacion,cId_ValorUnico,cId_EstadoUnico,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsulta.Show()
			Endif
		
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE visualizarcomprobapendiente
		LParameters nIndice
		
		Local cId_Cliente,cId_moneda,nTipoCotizacion,cId_Comproba
		
		If nIndice <> 0 
		   cId_moneda	= ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
		
		   If Type("thisform.vComprobaPendientes[1,1]") <> "L"
			  cId_Comproba 	= thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nindice,3]
			  cId_Cliente	= thisform.vComprobaPendientes[nIndice, 4]
		   else
		      cId_Comproba = " "
		      cId_Cliente =  Space(5)
		   Endif
			
			If Not Empty(cId_Cliente)
			   If Type("thisform.oFrmConsComprobaPendiente")<>T_OBJECT			 
				  thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsComprobaPendiente","tg_ComaDescargarCliente",cId_Cliente,cId_Comproba,cId_moneda )				
			   Else
			      Thisform.oFrmConsComprobaPendiente.EjecutarSeleccion(cId_Cliente,cId_Comproba,cId_moneda)			
			  Endif	
			  thisform.oFrmConsComprobaPendiente.Show()
			Endif
		
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCtaCorriente.Click
		If Type("thisform.oFrmGruposEmpresarios")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmGruposEmpresarios","TG_ConsGruposEmpresarios",ThisForm.Tg_gruposempresarios1.Value,.t.,ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmGruposEmpresarios.Consultar(ThisForm.Tg_gruposempresarios1.Value,.t.,ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value)			
		Endif	
		thisform.oFrmGruposEmpresarios.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdDatos.Click
		Local oAbmGen
		
		oAbmGen=CreateObject("tg_FormConsulta","GruposEmpresarios",.f.,ThisForm.Tg_gruposempresarios1.Value)
		oAbmGen.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutar.Click
		Thisform.Ejecutar()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE olbxComprobaPendientes.DblClick
		Thisform.VisualizarComprobaPendiente(This.ListIndex)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oLbxValoresPendientes.DblClick
		Thisform.Visualizar(This.ListIndex)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		Dimension this.vTitulos [3,2]
		this.vTitulos[1,1] = "Grupo Empresario:"
		this.vTitulos[1,2] = Alltrim(ThisForm.oLblNombreGrupoEmpresario.Caption) + " (" +;
											ThisForm.Tg_gruposempresarios1.Value + ") "
		this.vTitulos[2,1] = "Moneda: "
		this.vTitulos[2,2] = ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
		this.vTitulos[3,1] = "Cotizacion moneda: "
		this.vTitulos[3,2] = iif(ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value=1,"historica","actual")
		
		dodefault()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_gruposempresarios1.KeyPress
		LPARAMETERS nKeyCode, nShiftAltCtrl
		
		If nKeyCode = 13
			Thisform.ValidarGrupo(This.Value)
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_gruposempresarios1.ProgrammaticChange
		Thisform.ValidarGrupo(This.Value)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.InteractiveChange
		If  Thisform.OldTipoCotiza	<>	ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
			 Thisform.OldTipoCotiza	=	ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
			 If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			 		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=.t.
			 Endif
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.InteractiveChange
		If Thisform.Old_Moneda <>	ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
			 Thisform.Old_Moneda =	ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
			 If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			 		Thisform.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=.t.
			 Endif
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		dodefault()
		
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewArtADescargarDetallado","Tg_ViewArtADescargarDetallado")
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias
		
		thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos","Tg_Tabla","Articulos","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMarcas","Tg_Tabla","Marcas","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblRubros","Tg_Tabla","Rubros","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblSubRubros","Tg_Tabla","SubRubros","Clave")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		
		IF ThisForm.oOpgTipoComprobante.Value=2
		
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			Else
				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
			Endif	
			
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Id_Sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".ID_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Nro_Externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Id_Cliente"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Vencimiento"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Cantidad"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Cant_Cancelada"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias+".Cant_Pendiente"
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
			
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearconsulta
		lParameters cId_articulo,vComprobantes,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,cId_Vendedor,cId_Sucursal
		
		thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cId_articulo)
		thisform.oTblMarcas.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Marca"))
		thisform.oTblRubros.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_Rubro"))
		thisform.oTblSubRubros.Buscar(thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Id_SubRubro"))
		
		ThisForm.oLblNombreArtículo.Caption=thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre") +"   "+"("+alltrim(cId_Articulo)+")" 
		ThisForm.oLblNombreMarca.Caption=thisform.oTblMarcas.Leer("Nombre")
		ThisForm.oLblNombreRubro.Caption=thisform.oTblRubros.Leer("Nombre")
		ThisForm.oLblNombreSubRubro.Caption=thisform.oTblSubRubros.Leer("Nombre")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,"",cId_Sucursal,cId_vendedor,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,cId_articulo,cId_Articulo,"","","","",0)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewArtADescargarDetallado.Alias
		
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btncancelar1.Click
		thisform.Release
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC
